D. 他抱怨對方因為隱性偏見而在交流活動中不公允。
normal.explain: 英文原句為「He admitted that his implicit bias had influenced his judgment during the cultural exchange program.」。implicit bias 意為「隱性偏見」，選項 A 完全正確。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The media reported that a massive scandal had completely ruined his political career.
options: A. 醜聞
B. 辯論
C. 選舉
D. 政策
normal.explain: 英文原句為「The media reported that a massive scandal had completely ruined his political career.」（媒體報導一樁巨大的醜聞徹底毀了他的政治生涯）。scandal 意為「醜聞」。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: If the bank required a higher premium, I wouldn't be able to afford the insurance.
options: A. The bank opens at 9 AM every day.
B. Then you should look for a cheaper policy elsewhere.
C. Premium gasoline is better for your car engine.
D. I have already applied for a credit card.
normal.explain: 英文原句為「If the bank required a higher premium, I wouldn't be able to afford the insurance.」（如果銀行要求更高的保費，我就負擔不起這項保險了）。選項 B「那你就該去別處找便宜一點的保單」最合適。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: They concluded that if the contract had been transparent enough, the legal dispute would not have occurred.
options: A. 他們推論如果合約條件能夠再好一點，就不會引起糾紛。
B. 他們認為如果合約夠透明，這場法律糾紛就不會發生。
C. 他們相信只要公開透明，雙方就能和平解決法律問題。
D. 他們抱怨合約內容不夠公開，導致最後必須走上法庭。
normal.explain: 英文原句為「They concluded that if the contract had been transparent enough, the legal dispute would not have occurred.」。transparent 意指「透明的」，選項 B 是標準翻譯。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: She mentioned that studying abroad had made her fluent in three different languages.
options: A. 流利的
B. 結巴的
C. 困惑的
D. 猶豫的
normal.explain: 英文原句為「She mentioned that studying abroad had made her fluent in three different languages.」（她提到出國留學讓她精通三種不同的語言）。fluent 意為「流利的」。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: The board resolved that they would terminate the merger to avoid further losses.
options: A. When will they sign the merger agreement?
B. It sounds like a difficult but necessary decision.
C. The board of directors usually meets on Tuesdays.
D. They have successfully acquired the company.
normal.explain: 英文原句為「The board resolved that they would terminate the merger to avoid further losses.」（董事會決議他們將終止合併案以避免進一步損失）。選項 B「聽起來是個艱難但必要的決定」合乎情理。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: If the tenant had reported the broken pipe immediately, the apartment wouldn't have flooded.
options: A. 房客若是提早報修水管，公寓就不會淹水了。
B. 房東因為房客沒有立刻修理水管而感到非常生氣。
C. 只要房客通知水電工，公寓的淹水問題就能解決。
D. 如果公寓沒有淹水，房客就不會發現水管破裂了。
normal.explain: 英文原句為「If the tenant had reported the broken pipe immediately, the apartment wouldn't have flooded.」。這是一個標準的第三類條件句，選項 A 表達正確。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: He stated that the explicit images in the report had shocked the committee members.
options: A. 模糊的
B. 露骨的/明確的
C. 虛假的
D. 歷史的
normal.explain: 英文原句為「He stated that the explicit images in the report had shocked the committee members.」（他說報告中露骨的照片震驚了委員會成員）。explicit 意為「明確的/露骨的」。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: The manager said that she had isolated the problem in the accounting software.
options: A. I hope the IT team can patch it soon.
B. The software is very expensive to purchase.
C. She feels very lonely at work these days.
D. Accounting is a very stable profession.
normal.explain: 英文原句為「The manager said that she had isolated the problem in the accounting software.」（經理說她已經找出了會計軟體中的問題癥結）。isolate 在此指「找出/隔離（問題）」，選項 A 最適合。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: If he were more open-minded, he wouldn't believe in those cultural stereotypes.
options: A. 如果他心胸更開闊一點，就不會相信那些文化刻板印象。
B. 他因為心胸狹窄，所以總是受到別人的刻板印象攻擊。
C. 即使他思想開放，也很難完全擺脫傳統的文化觀念。
D. 如果他能拋棄刻板印象，他就能更好地了解當地文化。
normal.explain: 英文原句為「If he were more open-minded, he wouldn't believe in those cultural stereotypes.」。stereotype 意為「刻板印象」，這是一個第二類條件句，選項 A 為正解。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: She argued that the rigid hierarchy in the office had suppressed creativity.
options: A. 薪資結構
B. 階級制度
C. 獎懲條例
D. 考核標準
normal.explain: 英文原句為「She argued that the rigid hierarchy in the office had suppressed creativity.」（她主張辦公室裡僵化的階級制度壓抑了創造力）。hierarchy 意為「階級制度」。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: If the counselor hadn't intervened, the conflict between the team members would have escalated.
options: A. The team is currently recruiting new members.
B. I'm glad he stepped in to cool things down.
C. The counselor's office is on the third floor.
D. We should escalate the issue to the director.
normal.explain: 英文原句為「If the counselor hadn't intervened, the conflict between the team members would have escalated.」（如果諮商師沒有介入，團隊成員間的衝突就會升級）。選項 B「我很高興他出面平息了局面」最合理。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The PR director announced that they had drafted a comprehensive statement to address the scandal.
options: A. 公關總監宣布他們已草擬了一份詳盡的聲明來回應醜聞。
B. 公關總監表示這樁醜聞完全是競爭對手捏造的謊言。
C. 公關總監拒絕對最近的財務醜聞發表任何相關評論。
D. 公關總監承認他們在處理這起醜聞時犯了嚴重的錯誤。
normal.explain: 英文原句為「The PR director announced that they had drafted a comprehensive statement to address the scandal.」。statement 意為「聲明」，選項 A 完全正確翻譯。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: He confessed that he had struggled to maintain his mental wellbeing under such pressure.
options: A. 身體健康
B. 心理健康
C. 財務狀況
D. 人際關係
normal.explain: 英文原句為「He confessed that he had struggled to maintain his mental wellbeing under such pressure.」（他坦承在這種壓力下，他很難維持心理健康）。mental wellbeing 意為「心理健康」。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: If I were the landlord, I would renovate the old apartment before renting it out.
options: A. But renovations can be quite costly nowadays.
B. The landlord will raise the rent next year.
C. I have already signed the lease agreement.
D. The apartment is located in a quiet neighborhood.
normal.explain: 英文原句為「If I were the landlord, I would renovate the old apartment before renting it out.」（如果我是房東，我會在出租前翻修這間舊公寓）。選項 A「但現在翻修可能相當昂貴」是合理的回應。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: She inquired whether the cultural immersion program had broadened his worldview.
options: A. 她問這個文化沉浸計畫是否拓展了他的世界觀。
B. 她覺得這個文化交流活動完全改變了她的想法。
C. 她詢問他是否願意參加下一次的世界文化論壇。
D. 她表示這次出國留學讓她見識到了更廣闊的世界。
normal.explain: 英文原句為「She inquired whether the cultural immersion program had broadened his worldview.」。inquire whether 意為「詢問是否」，選項 A 為正確翻譯。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The accountant warned that if the trend continued, we would face bankruptcy.
options: A. 破產
B. 併購
C. 轉型
D. 擴編
normal.explain: 英文原句為「The accountant warned that if the trend continued, we would face bankruptcy.」（會計師警告如果這趨勢繼續下去，我們將面臨破產）。bankruptcy 意為「破產」。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: He admitted that dealing with aggressive journalists had always made him defensive.
options: A. Journalists write articles for newspapers.
B. It's understandable, given how tough their questions can be.
C. He has a very strong defense mechanism.
D. The press conference will start in ten minutes.
normal.explain: 英文原句為「He admitted that dealing with aggressive journalists had always made him defensive.」（他承認應付具攻擊性的記者總是讓他充滿防備）。選項 B「考慮到他們的問題有多尖銳，這是可以理解的」最適合。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: If the real estate broker had disclosed the defect, I wouldn't have bought the property.
options: A. 若是房仲有透露這項瑕疵，我就不會買下這棟房產了。
B. 因為房產有嚴重的瑕疵，房仲不建議我買下這個物件。
C. 即使房仲早就告訴我瑕疵，我還是決定買下這間房子。
D. 如果這間房子沒有任何瑕疵，我一定會向房仲買下來。
normal.explain: 英文原句為「If the real estate broker had disclosed the defect, I wouldn't have bought the property.」。這是一個標準的第三類條件句，選項 A 完全正確。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The psychologist suggested that cognitive behavioral therapy might alleviate his symptoms.
options: A. 加重
B. 緩解
C. 隱藏
D. 觸發
normal.explain: 英文原句為「The psychologist suggested that cognitive behavioral therapy might alleviate his symptoms.」（心理學家建議認知行為療法可能有助於緩解他的症狀）。alleviate 意為「減輕/緩解」。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: She mentioned that she had felt totally overwhelmed during her first week abroad.
options: A. Culture shock is very common for international students.
B. The university offers a variety of language courses.
C. She has a very strong academic background.
D. The flight abroad takes about twelve hours.
normal.explain: 英文原句為「She mentioned that she had felt totally overwhelmed during her first week abroad.」（她提到在國外的第一週她感到完全無法招架/不知所措）。選項 A「文化衝擊對國際學生來說很常見」是合理的同理回應。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The board resolved that they had to liquidate their assets to pay off the debt.
options: A. 董事會決議必須清算資產來償還債務。
B. 董事會宣布他們已經成功還清了所有貸款。
C. 董事會認為購買更多資產有助於減少債務。
D. 董事會拒絕為了還債而變賣公司的核心資產。
normal.explain: 英文原句為「The board resolved that they had to liquidate their assets to pay off the debt.」。liquidate assets 意為「清算/變賣資產」，選項 A 正確。

normal.desc: 【AI與工作-時態】By the time the manager arrived, the AI software ___ all the raw data.
options: A. had processed
B. has processed
C. was processing
D. processes
normal.explain: 本題測驗過去完成式。句首的「By the time + 過去式」表示在過去某個時間點之前，因此主要子句必須使用過去完成式（had + p.p.）來表達「已經完成」的動作。選項 A 為正確答案。B 為現在完成式，C 為過去進行式，D 為現在簡單式，時態皆不符。

normal.desc: 【AI與工作-假設】If the software ___ cheaper, more small businesses would adopt it.
options: A. is
B. were
C. has been
D. will be
normal.explain: 本題測驗與現在事實相反的假設語氣（第二類條件句）。句型為「If + 過去式動詞, 主詞 + would/could/might + 原形動詞」。在假設語氣中，be 動詞不論人稱通常都用 were，因此選 B。

normal.desc: 【AI與工作-字彙】The new program can ___ human conversations very well, making customer service faster.
options: A. stimulate
B. calculate
C. simulate
D. operate
normal.explain: 空格處需要填入符合句意的動詞。simulate 意為「模擬」，符合「模擬人類對話」的情境。stimulate 為刺激，calculate 為計算，operate 為操作，皆不符合句意。

normal.desc: 【AI與工作-間接引語】The engineer explained that the system ___ a major update the following week.
options: A. will require
B. requires
C. has required
D. would require
normal.explain: 本題測驗間接引語的時態一致性。主要子句的動詞 explained 是過去式，且句尾有 the following week（原為 next week），表示未來的動作在間接引語中需退一步退成過去未來式（would + 原形動詞），故選 D。

normal.desc: 【AI與工作-字彙】Because of ___, many repetitive tasks in the factory are now done by robots instead of humans.
options: A. automation
B. negotiation
C. permission
D. translation
normal.explain: 句意為「因為自動化，工廠裡許多重複性的工作現在都由機器人取代人類來完成」。automation 意為「自動化」，符合語境。negotiation 為談判，permission 為允許，translation 為翻譯。

normal.desc: 【AI與工作-對話】A: 「Why did the project fail?」 B: 「If we had tested the AI model properly, we ___ this issue.」
options: A. wouldn't avoid
B. would have avoided
C. will avoid
D. avoided
normal.explain: 本題測驗與過去事實相反的假設語氣（第三類條件句）。If 子句使用過去完成式 (had tested)，主要子句需搭配「would/could/might + have + p.p.」，表示「當時就能避免這個問題」，故選 B。

normal.desc: 【AI與工作-字彙】The director decided to ___ more funds to the research department for AI development.
options: A. locate
B. violate
C. allocate
D. isolate
normal.explain: 句意為「主管決定分配更多資金給研究部門以開發人工智慧」。allocate 意為「分配、撥出」，為正確答案。locate 為定位，violate 為違反，isolate 為隔離。

normal.desc: 【公衛政策-假設】If the clinic had ordered more supplies, they ___ out of masks during the outbreak.
options: A. don't run
B. wouldn't run
C. wouldn't have run
D. didn't run
normal.explain: 本題測驗第三類條件句（與過去事實相反）。If 子句使用 had ordered，主要子句需使用 would have + p.p.，加上否定即為 wouldn't have run out of（就不會耗盡），故選 C。

normal.desc: 【公衛政策-字彙】Wearing a mask is now ___ in all hospitals to protect patients and medical staff.
options: A. temporary
B. imaginary
C. satisfactory
D. mandatory
normal.explain: 句意為「現在所有醫院都強制要求戴口罩以保護病患和醫護人員」。mandatory 意為「強制的、義務的」，符合句意。temporary 為暫時的，imaginary 為想像的，satisfactory 為令人滿意的。

normal.desc: 【公衛政策-間接引語】The doctor warned the patient that he ___ taking the medicine immediately.
options: A. had to stop
B. has to stop
C. must stop
D. will stop
normal.explain: 本題為間接引語。引述動詞 warned 是過去式，後方的名詞子句時態需要退一步。原本的 must 或是 have to 退一步成為過去式 had to，故選 A。

normal.desc: 【公衛政策-時態】By the time the ambulance reached the scene, the volunteers ___ first aid to the victims.
options: A. give
B. had given
C. have given
D. will give
normal.explain: 由 By the time 加上過去式動詞 reached 可知，志工給予急救的動作發生在救護車抵達之前，屬於「過去的過去」，因此必須使用過去完成式 (had given)。

normal.desc: 【公衛政策-字彙】A large ___ of the city's budget will be spent on improving public health facilities this year.
options: A. prevention
B. profession
C. proportion
D. protection
normal.explain: 句意為「今年本市很大比例的預算將花在改善公共衛生設施上」。proportion 意為「比例、部分」，符合語境。prevention 為預防，profession 為職業，protection 為保護。

normal.desc: 【公衛政策-對話】A: 「The hospital is understaffed.」 B: 「If they offered better salaries, more nurses ___ willing to join.」
options: A. are
B. had been
C. will be
D. would be
normal.explain: 對話中的假設語氣 If they offered... 使用過去式，表示與現在事實相反的假設（第二類條件句），主要子句應使用 would + 原形動詞，故選 D。

normal.desc: 【公衛政策-字彙】The new policy aims to protect the most ___ groups, such as the elderly and those with chronic illnesses.
options: A. vulnerable
B. valuable
C. variable
D. visible
normal.explain: 句意為「這項新政策旨在保護最脆弱的族群，例如長者和慢性病患」。vulnerable 意為「脆弱的、易受傷的」，符合句意。valuable 為有價值的，variable 為多變的，visible 為看得見的。

normal.desc: 【短文】Health Alert: To prevent the spread of the virus, the government announced that all international travelers must undergo a rapid test upon arrival. Those who test positive will be sent to a designated hotel for a seven-day quarantine. Q: What happens if a traveler tests positive?
options: A. They must return to their home country immediately.
B. They are required to stay at a specific hotel for a week.
C. They have to pay a fine to the government.
D. They will be taken to a local hospital for surgery.
normal.explain: 題目問若旅客檢測呈陽性會發生什麼事。文中提到「Those who test positive will be sent to a designated hotel for a seven-day quarantine.」，即送往指定飯店隔離七天，與選項 B「要求在特定飯店待一週」相符。

normal.desc: 【旅遊轉型-字彙】The small fishing village has managed to ___ itself into a popular resort destination.
options: A. transform
B. transmit
C. transport
D. translate
normal.explain: 句意為「這座小漁村成功地將自己轉變為受歡迎的度假勝地」。transform 意為「使改變、轉換」，常搭配 into，為正確答案。transmit 為傳送，transport 為運輸，translate 為翻譯。

normal.desc: 【旅遊轉型-時態】The tour guide realized that he ___ the tickets at the hotel counter before boarding the bus.
options: A. leaves
B. had left
C. has left
D. is leaving
normal.explain: 句子表達導遊在「意識到（過去式 realized）」時，把票留在飯店櫃檯這個動作已經發生過了。描述過去某時間點之前已發生的動作，需使用過去完成式 (had left)。

normal.desc: 【旅遊轉型-假設】If the town ___ more cultural festivals, it would attract a lot more international tourists.
options: A. hosts
B. has hosted
C. hosted
D. will host
normal.explain: 主要子句使用了 would attract，表示這是一個與現在事實相反的假設語氣（第二類條件句）。If 子句中的動詞必須使用過去式，因此選 C (hosted)。

normal.desc: 【旅遊轉型-間接引語】The hotel receptionist told us that our room ___ ready in about thirty minutes.
options: A. is
B. will be
C. has been
D. would be
normal.explain: 間接引語的時態變化題。因為引述動詞 told 為過去式，名詞子句原本的未來式 will be 必須退一步變成過去未來式 would be，故選 D。

normal.desc: 【旅遊轉型-字彙】To ___ the historical buildings, the city council decided to limit the number of daily visitors.
options: A. preserve
B. reserve
C. observe
D. deserve
normal.explain: 句意為「為了保存歷史建築，市議會決定限制每日遊客數量」。preserve 意為「保存、維護」，符合句意。reserve 為預訂，observe 為觀察，deserve 為應得。

normal.desc: 【旅遊轉型-對話】A: 「The flight was delayed for six hours!」 B: 「If we had checked the weather forecast, we ___ a different travel date.」
options: A. could choose
B. could have chosen
C. can choose
D. chose
normal.explain: 本題為第三類條件句（與過去事實相反）。If 子句使用過去完成式 (had checked)，主要子句需使用 would/could/might + have + p.p.，表示「當時本來可以選擇其他日期」，故選 B。

normal.desc: 【旅遊轉型-字彙】Many travelers nowadays prefer ___ local experiences rather than visiting typical tourist traps.
options: A. athletic
B. automatic
C. authentic
D. artistic
normal.explain: 句意為「現在許多旅客偏好道地的在地體驗，而不是去典型的觀光陷阱」。authentic 意為「真實的、道地的」，符合語境。athletic 為運動的，automatic 為自動的，artistic 為藝術的。

normal.desc: 【短文】Travel Blog: Ecotourism is on the rise. Instead of massive cruise ships, visitors are opting for small-group tours that support local businesses and protect the environment. This shift helps communities thrive without destroying their natural resources. Q: What is the main purpose of ecotourism according to the text?
options: A. To promote the building of larger cruise ships.
B. To lower the travel costs for international tourists.
C. To exploit natural resources for maximum profit.
D. To benefit local communities while protecting nature.
normal.explain: 題目詢問生態旅遊的主要目的。短文中提到生態旅遊支持當地企業、保護環境 (protect the environment)，並幫助社區繁榮 (helps communities thrive)，因此選項 D 最符合文章主旨。

normal.desc: 【食安標示-間接引語】The inspector announced that the new labeling regulations ___ into effect next month.
options: A. go
B. have gone
C. would go
D. are going
normal.explain: 引述動詞 announced 為過去式，從屬子句中描述未來的動作 (next month) 應將 will go 退一步為 would go，符合間接引語的時態規則。

normal.desc: 【食安標示-字彙】Consumers should carefully read the list of ___ to avoid allergic reactions.
options: A. instruments
B. instructions
C. investments
D. ingredients
normal.explain: 句意為「消費者應仔細閱讀成分表以避免過敏反應」。ingredients 意為「成分、原料」，是正確答案。instruments 為樂器/儀器，instructions 為指示，investments 為投資。

normal.desc: 【食安標示-假設】If the company had printed clear expiry dates, they ___ the massive product recall.
options: A. would have avoided
B. will avoid
C. wouldn't avoid
D. avoid
normal.explain: 這是與過去事實相反的假設語氣。條件子句使用 had printed (過去完成式)，主要子句必須使用 would/could/might + have + p.p.，因此選 A (本來就可以避免產品召回)。

normal.desc: 【食安標示-時態】The authorities found that the factory ___ expired meat for several months before the inspection.
options: A. uses
B. had used
C. will use
D. is using
normal.explain: 政府發現 (found) 是一個過去式的動作，而工廠使用過期肉類是發生在檢查「之前」好幾個月的事，屬於過去的過去，必須使用過去完成式 (had used)。

normal.desc: 【食安標示-字彙】The use of artificial food coloring is ___ prohibited in organic products.
options: A. shortly
B. smoothly
C. strictly
D. slightly
normal.explain: 句意為「有機產品中嚴格禁止使用人工食用色素」。strictly 意為「嚴格地」，修飾 prohibited 非常自然。shortly 為不久，smoothly 為順利地，slightly 為輕微地。

normal.desc: 【食安標示-對話】A: 「The font on this nutrition label is too small.」 B: 「If the text were larger, it ___ much easier for elderly people to read.」
options: A. is
B. will be
C. has been
D. would be
normal.explain: 這句對話使用了第二類條件句 (If the text were larger)，表示與現在事實相反，因此主要子句需要用 would + 原形動詞 (would be)。

normal.desc: 【食安標示-字彙】The government plans to establish a new agency to ___ the production and distribution of dietary supplements.
options: A. regulate
B. calculate
C. formulate
D. stimulate
normal.explain: 句意為「政府計劃成立一個新機構來規範膳食補充劑的生產與銷售」。regulate 意為「規範、管理」，符合句意。calculate 為計算，formulate 為制定，stimulate 為刺激。

normal.desc: 【短文】Consumer Advice: When buying imported snacks, always look for the official safety certification mark. Products without this sticker have not been tested for harmful chemicals and could pose a risk to your health. Q: What should buyers do according to the advice?
options: A. Avoid buying any imported snacks.
B. Check for a specific safety sticker on the packaging.
C. Test the snacks for chemicals themselves.
D. Only purchase snacks that are brightly colored.
normal.explain: 短文中建議消費者在購買進口零食時，應尋找官方的安全認證標誌 (look for the official safety certification mark)，並提到沒有這張貼紙的產品可能會有風險，因此選 B。

normal.desc: 【城市交通-字彙】The city is promoting electric buses to reduce greenhouse gas ___ in downtown areas.
options: A. emissions
B. commissions
C. admissions
D. submissions
normal.explain: 句意為「該市正在推廣電動公車，以減少市中心的溫室氣體排放」。emissions 意為「排放、排放物」，常與溫室氣體連用。commissions 為佣金，admissions 為入場費，submissions 為提交物。

normal.desc: 【城市交通-時態】By the time the new subway line opened, the construction budget ___ by twenty percent.
options: A. increases
B. had increased
C. has increased
D. will increase
normal.explain: By the time 加上過去式 opened 點出過去的時間基準。預算增加的動作發生在地鐵開通「之前」，屬於過去的過去，需使用過去完成式 (had increased)。

normal.desc: 【城市交通-間接引語】The mayor promised that the city council ___ more bike lanes by the end of the year.
options: A. build
B. has built
C. would build
D. is building
normal.explain: 主要子句動詞 promised 為過去式，名詞子句中描述「年底前將會建造」的未來動作，需要依據時態一致性退一步，將 will 轉成 would，故選 C。

normal.desc: 【城市交通-假設】If public transportation were completely free, fewer people ___ their cars to work.
options: A. drive
B. will drive
C. had driven
D. would drive
normal.explain: 條件子句 If public transportation were... 顯示為第二類條件句，表示與現在事實相反的假設，主要子句要搭配 would + 原形動詞，所以選 would drive。

normal.desc: 【城市交通-字彙】To ___ the transition to green energy, the government is offering subsidies for purchasing electric vehicles.
options: A. accelerate
B. calculate
C. decorate
D. celebrate
normal.explain: 句意為「為了加速向綠能轉型，政府針對購買電動車提供補助」。accelerate 意為「加速、促進」，符合句意。calculate 為計算，decorate 為裝飾，celebrate 為慶祝。

normal.desc: 【城市交通-對話】A: 「The traffic jam was terrible this morning.」 B: 「If you had taken the train, you ___ late for the meeting.」
options: A. weren't
B. wouldn't have been
C. won't be
D. haven't been
normal.explain: 對話討論的是今天早上已經發生的塞車，為與過去事實相反的假設語氣（第三類條件句）。If 子句用 had taken，主要子句應搭配 would have + p.p.，故選 B。

normal.desc: 【城市交通-字彙】The new bridge was designed specifically for ___ and cyclists, so cars are not allowed to enter.
options: A. politicians
B. physicians
C. pedestrians
D. technicians
normal.explain: 句意為「這座新橋是專為行人和自行車騎士設計的，所以禁止汽車進入」。pedestrians 意為「行人」，為正確答案。politicians 為政治家，physicians 為內科醫生，technicians 為技術人員。

🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: If I were you, I would meet all the criteria before applying.
options: A. 申請後再確認條件也沒關係。
B. 這些準則不適用於目前的申請。
C. 我建議你在申請前先符合所有標準。
D. 你已經符合了所有的申請資格。
normal.explain: 這句話的意思是「如果我是你，我會在申請前符合所有的標準。」（If I were you, I would meet all the criteria before applying.），這是一個第二類條件句，表達假設性的建議。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The director said she had finalized the assessment.
options: A. 總監說她剛開始進行評估。
B. 總監提到評估報告遺失了。
C. 總監拒絕參與這次的評估。
D. 總監表示她已經完成了評估。
normal.explain: 這句話的意思是「總監說她已經完成了評估。」（The director said she had finalized the assessment.），運用了過去完成式表示在說話之前已經完成的動作。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: Had he delegated the tasks, the project would have finished early.
options: A. 因為他把工作分派出去，專案提早結束了。
B. 如果他有把任務分派出去，專案早就完成了。
C. 他正在考慮是否要把專案的工作分派給別人。
D. 他把任務分派出去後，專案卻延遲了。
normal.explain: 這句話的意思是「如果他當時有把任務分派出去，專案早就提早完成了。」（Had he delegated the tasks, the project would have finished early.），這是第三類條件句的倒裝用法，表示與過去事實相反。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: She asked if the new incentive program had boosted morale.
options: A. 她肯定新的獎勵計畫會帶來好處。
B. 她問新的獎勵計畫是否提升了士氣。
C. 她宣布新的獎勵計畫已經取消。
D. 她懷疑員工的士氣是否過於低落。
normal.explain: 這句話的意思是「她問新的獎勵計畫是否提升了士氣。」（She asked if the new incentive program had boosted morale.），是包含過去完成式的間接問句。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: If the candidate had given his consent, we would have run the background check.
options: A. 因為候選人同意了，我們進行了背景調查。
B. 候選人正在考慮是否同意接受背景調查。
C. 如果候選人當初同意，我們就會進行背景調查。
D. 如果候選人不同意，我們還是會進行調查。
normal.explain: 這句話的意思是「如果候選人當初有同意，我們就會進行背景調查了。」（If the candidate had given his consent, we would have run the background check.），為第三類條件句，代表事實上對方並未同意。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: He mentioned that he had felt overwhelmed during the final assessment.
options: A. He will start the assessment tomorrow.
B. The criteria were exceptionally easy.
C. She delegates tasks very well.
D. Yes, he seemed very stressed out that day.
normal.explain: 原句意為「他提到他在最終評估時感到不勝負荷。」（He mentioned that he had felt overwhelmed during the final assessment.）；(D) 回應「是的，那天他看起來壓力很大。」最符合情境。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: If the management offered better incentives, would you stay longer?
options: A. Yes, a bonus would definitely convince me.
B. I have already offered my resignation.
C. The management had finalized it.
D. They are leaving early today.
normal.explain: 原句意為「如果管理層提供更好的獎勵，你會留久一點嗎？」這是一個假設語氣；(A) 回應「是的，獎金絕對能說服我。」最為合適。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The guide stated that the itinerary had been completely modified.
options: A. 導遊說行程已經稍微調整過。
B. 導遊認為行程沒有修改的必要。
C. 導遊表示行程已經完全修改了。
D. 導遊提到大家都很滿意新行程。
normal.explain: 這句話的意思是「導遊表示行程已經完全被修改了。」（The guide stated that the itinerary had been completely modified.），運用間接引語與過去完成被動態。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: If the excursion had not been canceled, we would have seen the ruins.
options: A. 短途旅行雖然取消了，我們還是看到了遺跡。
B. 既然短途旅行沒有取消，我們應該去看遺跡。
C. 我們是因為不想看遺跡才取消旅行的。
D. 如果短途旅行沒有取消，我們就會看到遺跡了。
normal.explain: 這句話的意思是「如果這趟短途旅行沒有被取消，我們就會看到遺跡了。」（If the excursion had not been canceled, we would have seen the ruins.），這是一個與過去事實相反的第三類條件句。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: They announced that a substitute bus had arrived at the station.
options: A. 他們宣布車站正在進行公車維修。
B. 他們宣布替代公車已經抵達車站。
C. 他們提醒大家公車即將延誤。
D. 他們表示不需要安排替代公車。
normal.explain: 這句話的意思是「他們宣布一輛替代公車已經抵達車站。」（They announced that a substitute bus had arrived at the station.），運用了間接引語和過去完成式。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: He warned us that smoking was strictly prohibited on the premises.
options: A. 他提醒我們建築物內允許吸菸。
B. 他警告我們該場所內嚴禁吸菸。
C. 他建議我們到室外去吸菸。
D. 他表示這裡沒有吸菸區的規定。
normal.explain: 這句話的意思是「他警告我們在該場所（建築物內）嚴禁吸菸。」（He warned us that smoking was strictly prohibited on the premises.），premises 指建築及附屬場地。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: If there were less congestion, the transfer would be much faster.
options: A. 因為沒有塞車，轉乘非常順利。
B. 如果交通比較不壅塞，轉乘就會快很多。
C. 就算塞車，轉乘速度也不受影響。
D. 這裡一直都很壅塞，所以無法轉乘。
normal.explain: 這句話的意思是「如果交通比較不壅塞，轉乘就會快很多。」（If there were less congestion, the transfer would be much faster.），這是與現在事實相反的第二類條件句。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: She explained that the sudden storm had ruined the outdoor excursion.
options: A. 她說短途旅行並未受到暴風雨的影響。
B. 她表示大家在暴風雨中玩得很開心。
C. 她解釋突然的暴風雨毀了這趟戶外短途旅行。
D. 她提醒大家明天可能會有暴風雨。
normal.explain: 這句話的意思是「她解釋突然的暴風雨毀了這趟戶外的短途旅行。」（She explained that the sudden storm had ruined the outdoor excursion.），間接引語中描述已發生的事件用過去完成式。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: If the agency had provided a substitute flight, we wouldn't have complained.
options: A. 旅行社提供了替代航班，所以我們沒有抱怨。
B. 就算旅行社提供替代航班，我們還是會抱怨。
C. 我們向旅行社抱怨為何沒有取消航班。
D. 如果旅行社有提供替代航班，我們就不會抱怨了。
normal.explain: 這句話的意思是「如果旅行社當時有提供替代航班，我們就不會抱怨了。」（If the agency had provided a substitute flight, we wouldn't have complained.），代表實際上並沒有提供，所以大家抱怨了。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The host explained that the phenomenon had puzzled scientists for decades.
options: A. 主持人解釋這個現象讓科學家困惑了數十年。
B. 主持人說科學家已經完全破解了這個現象。
C. 主持人認為這個現象一點也不特別。
D. 主持人提到科學家對這個現象不感興趣。
normal.explain: 這句話的意思是「主持人解釋說這個現象已經讓科學家困惑了數十年。」（The host explained that the phenomenon had puzzled scientists for decades.）

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: If we could simulate the environment, we would understand the process.
options: A. 因為我們已經模擬了環境，所以完全了解過程。
B. 如果我們能模擬那個環境，我們就會了解整個過程。
C. 我們不想模擬環境，所以不了解過程。
D. 即使模擬了環境，過程依然難以理解。
normal.explain: 這句話的意思是「如果我們能模擬那個環境，我們就會了解整個過程。」（If we could simulate the environment, we would understand the process.），表示現階段還無法模擬。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: He testified that sustainable energy had significantly reduced pollution.
options: A. 他認為永續能源對減少汙染沒有幫助。
B. 他懷疑永續能源是否真的能減少汙染。
C. 他作證表示永續能源大幅減少了汙染。
D. 他指出汙染主要是由永續能源造成的。
normal.explain: 這句話的意思是「他作證表示永續能源已經大幅減少了汙染。」（He testified that sustainable energy had significantly reduced pollution.），這裡 testifiy 指提出證詞或證明。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: She noted that the genetic mutation had occurred quite rapidly.
options: A. 她提到基因突變發生得非常緩慢。
B. 她發現這個基因並未發生任何突變。
C. 她指出基因突變發生得相當快速。
D. 她認為基因突變的發生是可以預測的。
normal.explain: 這句話的意思是「她指出該基因突變發生得相當快速。」（She noted that the genetic mutation had occurred quite rapidly.），note 在此有特別指出、注意到的意思。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: If the ecological balance had been maintained, the species would have survived.
options: A. 因為生態平衡得以維持，該物種存活了下來。
B. 如果生態平衡有維持住，該物種就會存活下來。
C. 無論生態是否平衡，該物種都會滅絕。
D. 該物種的存活破壞了當地的生態平衡。
normal.explain: 這句話的意思是「如果生態平衡當時有維持住，該物種就會存活下來了。」（If the ecological balance had been maintained, the species would have survived.），事實是生態失衡導致物種未能存活。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: The professor stated that they had successfully simulated a black hole.
options: A. I didn't know they had that kind of technology.
B. Black holes are completely theoretical.
C. The environment is heavily polluted.
D. He is studying ecological balance.
normal.explain: 原句意為「教授表示他們已經成功模擬了黑洞。」（The professor stated that they had successfully simulated a black hole.）；(A) 回應「我不知道他們有那種技術」是針對此成就的自然反應。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: If this phenomenon were common, researchers wouldn't be so surprised.
options: A. 因為這個現象很常見，所以研究人員非常驚訝。
B. 如果這個現象很常見，研究人員就不會這麼驚訝了。
C. 研究人員對這個常見的現象感到十分驚訝。
D. 這個現象非常罕見，但研究人員一點也不驚訝。
normal.explain: 這句話的意思是「如果這個現象很常見，研究人員就不會這麼驚訝了。」（If this phenomenon were common, researchers wouldn't be so surprised.），表示此現象其實並不常見。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The lawyer confirmed that the clause had been removed from the document.
options: A. 律師建議在文件中加入新條款。
B. 律師表示該條款仍保留在文件中。
C. 律師確認該條款已從文件中刪除。
D. 律師指出文件中的條款有錯誤。
normal.explain: 這句話的意思是「律師確認該條款已從文件中被刪除。」（The lawyer confirmed that the clause had been removed from the document.），clause 指合約或法律文件中的條款。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: If they had committed a breach, we would have sued them.
options: A. 因為他們違約了，所以我們已經提告。
B. 就算他們違約，我們也不打算提告。
C. 我們即將因為違約而面臨對方的提告。
D. 如果他們當時有違約，我們就會對他們提告。
normal.explain: 這句話的意思是「如果他們當時有違約，我們就會對他們提告了。」（If they had committed a breach, we would have sued them.），表示事實上對方並未違約。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: She asked if the verbal agreement was legally binding.
options: A. 她確認口頭協議已經正式生效。
B. 她問口頭協議是否具有法律約束力。
C. 她認為口頭協議沒有任何法律效力。
D. 她要求將口頭協議改為書面文件。
normal.explain: 這句話的意思是「她問口頭協議是否具有法律約束力。」（She asked if the verbal agreement was legally binding.），binding 指具約束力的。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: He admitted that the lawsuit had drained all his savings.
options: A. 他承認這場訴訟讓他賺了不少錢。
B. 他否認這場訴訟對他造成經濟影響。
C. 他承認這場訴訟耗盡了他所有的積蓄。
D. 他表示他為了訴訟正在努力存錢。
normal.explain: 這句話的意思是「他承認這場訴訟耗盡了他所有的積蓄。」（He admitted that the lawsuit had drained all his savings.），lawsuit 即為訴訟，drain 指耗盡。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: If the regulation were stricter, this breach would not happen.
options: A. 由於規定很嚴格，所以沒有發生違約。
B. 雖然規定很嚴格，但違約還是發生了。
C. 規定已經放寬，因此違約行為增加。
D. 如果規定更嚴格一點，就不會發生這種違約行為。
normal.explain: 這句話的意思是「如果規定更嚴格一點，就不會發生這種違約行為了。」（If the regulation were stricter, this breach would not happen.），暗指現在的規定不夠嚴格。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: The attorney warned that ignoring the clause would lead to severe consequences.
options: A. Yes, we should review the document carefully.
B. He won the lawsuit yesterday.
C. The verbal agreement is binding.
D. They are drafting a new regulation.
normal.explain: 原句意為「律師警告說，忽略這個條款將會導致嚴重的後果。」；(A) 回應「是的，我們應該仔細審查這份文件。」最為合理。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: If the document were truly binding, they wouldn't dare to challenge it.
options: A. 因為這份文件具約束力，所以他們不敢挑戰。
B. 即使文件具約束力，他們還是不斷挑戰。
C. 如果這份文件真的具有約束力，他們就不敢去挑戰它了。
D. 這份文件完全沒有約束力，所以大家都來挑戰。
normal.explain: 這句話的意思是「如果這份文件真的具有約束力，他們就不敢去挑戰它了。」（If the document were truly binding, they wouldn't dare to challenge it.），暗示這份文件的約束力可能備受質疑。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The mayor stated that the infrastructure had been severely neglected.
options: A. 市長表示基礎設施受到了妥善的維護。
B. 市長說基礎設施已經嚴重被忽視。
C. 市長承諾將投資更多的基礎設施。
D. 市長認為基礎設施的狀況良好。
normal.explain: 這句話的意思是「市長表示基礎設施已經嚴重被忽視。」（The mayor stated that the infrastructure had been severely neglected.），infrastructure 為基礎設施，neglect 是忽視。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: If the new ordinance were passed, parking would be restricted.
options: A. 因為新法令通過了，停車已被全面禁止。
B. 新法令的目的是為了解除停車限制。
C. 儘管新法令通過，停車依然不受影響。
D. 如果新法令通過，停車將會受到限制。
normal.explain: 這句話的意思是「如果新法令通過，停車將會受到限制。」（If the new ordinance were passed, parking would be restricted.），這是在討論未來的假設情況。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: He promised that they had secured funds to restore the park.
options: A. 他提到修復公園的資金目前嚴重不足。
B. 他保證他們已經確保了修復公園的資金。
C. 他希望大家能踴躍捐款來修復公園。
D. 他否認政府有編列預算修復公園。
normal.explain: 這句話的意思是「他保證他們已經確保了修復公園的資金。」（He promised that they had secured funds to restore the park.），restore 意指修復或恢復原狀。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: She complained that her daily commute had become a nightmare.
options: A. 她覺得她每天的通勤非常輕鬆愉快。
B. 她表示最近通勤的時間縮短了許多。
C. 她抱怨說她的日常通勤已經變成一場惡夢。
D. 她考慮搬到離公司近一點的地方通勤。
normal.explain: 這句話的意思是「她抱怨說她的日常通勤已經變成一場惡夢。」（She complained that her daily commute had become a nightmare.），commute 是指上下班的通勤。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: If the neighborhood had better amenities, property values would rise.
options: A. 因為社區有更好的便利設施，所以房價上漲了。
B. 就算社區增加便利設施，房價也不會改變。
C. 社區缺乏便利設施是房價下跌的主因。
D. 如果社區有更好的便利設施，房地產價值就會上升。
normal.explain: 這句話的意思是「如果社區有更好的便利設施，房地產價值就會上升。」（If the neighborhood had better amenities, property values would rise.），amenities 指生活便利設施。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The council announced that they had upgraded the local infrastructure.
options: A. 議會考慮明年才升級當地的基礎設施。
B. 議會對當地基礎設施的落後感到抱歉。
C. 議會宣布他們已經升級了當地的基礎設施。
D. 議會表示基礎設施的升級計畫已經取消。
normal.explain: 這句話的意思是「議會宣布他們已經升級了當地的基礎設施。」（The council announced that they had upgraded the local infrastructure.），這是間接引語的用法。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: If the old theater had been restored, it would have attracted more tourists.
options: A. 老劇院已經修復完畢，並吸引了許多遊客。
B. 如果當初有修復那座老劇院，就會吸引更多遊客了。
C. 即使修復了老劇院，也不會吸引遊客。
D. 遊客們抱怨老劇院沒有得到妥善修復。
normal.explain: 這句話的意思是「如果當初有修復那座老劇院，就會吸引更多遊客了。」（If the old theater had been restored, it would have attracted more tourists.），表示老劇院最終並未被修復。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: I heard the recruiter had already verified all the academic credentials.
options: A. She wants to commute by train.
B. That's great, it means we can hire her soon.
C. The incentive program is successful.
D. He restored the building beautifully.
normal.explain: 原句意為「我聽說招募人員已經核實了所有的學歷證明。」（I heard the recruiter had already verified all the academic credentials.）；(B) 回應「太好了，這意味著我們很快就能錄用她。」最符合語境。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: Did the receptionist say why the complimentary breakfast had been canceled?
options: A. Yes, they had an issue with the kitchen staff.
B. The infrastructure needs an upgrade.
C. The lawsuit is still ongoing.
D. I always read the latest ordinance.
normal.explain: 原句意為「櫃檯人員有說為什麼免費早餐被取消了嗎？」；(A) 回應「有，他們的廚房員工出了點狀況。」符合邏輯。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: If the radiation level had exceeded the limit, the alarm would have sounded.
options: A. 因為輻射量超標，警報器響了起來。
B. 就算輻射量超標，警報器也不會響。
C. 我們不知道輻射量是否超標，但警報器沒響。
D. 如果當時輻射量有超過標準，警報器就會響了。
normal.explain: 這句話的意思是「如果當時輻射量有超過標準，警報器就會響了。」（If the radiation level had exceeded the limit, the alarm would have sounded.），因為警報器沒響，代表輻射量未超標。

normal.desc: 【企業社會責任-時態】The corporation ___ a new recycling program before the environmental law was passed.
options: A. has established
B. had established
C. will establish
D. establishes
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：句中有 before 引導的過去時間點，主要子句的動作發生在更早之前，需使用過去完成式 (had + p.p.)。

normal.desc: 【企業社會責任-假設】If the factory ___ its chemical waste properly, the local river would not have been polluted.
options: A. manages
B. will manage
C. had managed
D. is managing
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：主要子句為 would not have been (與過去事實相反)，條件句應使用過去完成式 If + had + p.p.。

normal.desc: 【企業社會責任-間接引語】The CEO stated that they ___ ten percent of their annual earnings to local charities the previous year.
options: A. had donated
B. donate
C. have donated
D. will donate
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：間接引語中，主要動詞 stated 為過去式，且有 the previous year，表示動作發生在更早之前，應退一步使用過去完成式。

normal.desc: 【企業社會責任-字彙】Implementing ___ practices ensures that a business can operate long-term without harming future generations.
options: A. superficial
B. temporary
C. sustainable
D. outdated
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：sustainable 意為「永續的、可持續的」，符合企業長遠營運且不危害後代的主題。

normal.desc: 【企業社會責任-對話】A: 「Did the company release the carbon footprint report?」 B: 「Yes, they ___ it before the annual board meeting started.」
options: A. publish
B. are publishing
C. have published
D. had published
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：在 past tense 事件 (started) 發生前就已經完成的動作，須用過去完成式 had published。

normal.desc: 【企業社會責任-對話】A: 「Their public image is ruined because of the scandal.」 B: 「If they were truly ethical, they ___ such toxic materials.」
options: A. do not use
B. would not use
C. will not use
D. have not used
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：If 條件句使用過去式 (were) 表示與現在事實相反的假設，主要子句應配 would/could/might + 原形動詞。

normal.desc: 【企業社會責任-對話】A: 「What did the board decide regarding the labor dispute?」 B: 「The chairman announced that they ___ all ties with the controversial supplier.」
options: A. sever
B. have severed
C. would sever
D. are severing
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：間接引語中，主要動詞 announced 為過去式，原本的未來式 will sever 要依時態一致性退成 would sever。

normal.desc: 【數位隱私-時態】By the time the security breach was detected, the hackers ___ thousands of user passwords.
options: A. had extracted
B. extract
C. have extracted
D. will extract
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：By the time + 過去式，表示在過去某時點前已完成的事，搭配過去完成式。

normal.desc: 【數位隱私-假設】If the messaging application ___ end-to-end encryption, our private conversations would be much safer.
options: A. features
B. featured
C. had featured
D. is featuring
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：主要子句為 would be (與現在事實相反)，If 條件句需用過去簡單式 featured。

normal.desc: 【數位隱私-間接引語】The developer warned the users that the outdated software ___ serious security vulnerabilities.
options: A. contains
B. will contain
C. is containing
D. contained
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：引述動詞 warned 為過去式，名詞子句中的動詞也要隨之退成過去式 contained。

normal.desc: 【數位隱私-字彙】Users must give explicit ___ before the application can legally access their microphone or camera.
options: A. consent
B. obstacle
C. resistance
D. illusion
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：consent 意為「同意、許可」，符合應用程式存取硬體前需要取得使用者明確同意的情境。

normal.desc: 【數位隱私-對話】A: 「Why was the central server taken offline so suddenly?」 B: 「Because the IT team found out that someone ___ the firewall overnight.」
options: A. bypasses
B. has bypassed
C. had bypassed
D. is bypassing
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：發現 (found out) 已經是過去式，突破防火牆發生在發現之前，必須用過去完成式。

normal.desc: 【數位隱私-對話】A: 「I lost all my personal photos after the hard drive crashed.」 B: 「If you had backed up your data to the cloud, you ___ them.」
options: A. would not have lost
B. will not lose
C. do not lose
D. would not lose
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：條件句為 If you had backed up (與過去事實相反)，主要子句應配 would have + p.p.。

normal.desc: 【數位隱私-對話】A: 「Is my personal data secure with this platform?」 B: 「The representative assured me that they ___ user information with third parties.」
options: A. do not share
B. did not share
C. will not share
D. have not shared
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：assured 為過去式，依照時態一致性，名詞子句中的動作需轉換為過去式 did not share。

normal.desc: 【運動科學-時態】The professional athlete ___ completely from her severe leg injury before she started training for the Olympics.
options: A. recovers
B. has recovered
C. had recovered
D. will recover
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：在過去時間點 (started training) 之前已經完成的動作，需用過去完成式。

normal.desc: 【運動科學-假設】If the coach had analyzed the biomechanical data carefully, he ___ the runner's awkward posture sooner.
options: A. corrects
B. will correct
C. would correct
D. would have corrected
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：If 條件句使用 had analyzed (與過去相反)，主要子句需用 would have + p.p. 表過去可能的結果。

normal.desc: 【運動科學-間接引語】The physiotherapist explained that a persistent lack of sleep ___ the natural muscle recovery process.
options: A. hindered
B. hinders
C. will hinder
D. has hindered
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：引述動詞 explained 為過去式，子句動詞也應退一步成為過去式 hindered。

normal.desc: 【運動科學-字彙】Marathon runners need immense physical ___ to maintain a steady and fast pace for over two hours.
options: A. hesitation
B. arrogance
C. compromise
D. endurance
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：endurance 意為「耐力、持久力」，適合描述馬拉松跑者維持步伐所需的身體素質。

normal.desc: 【運動科學-對話】A: 「Did he pass the rigorous physical test?」 B: 「No, his stamina ___ significantly by the time the final round began.」
options: A. decreases
B. had decreased
C. has decreased
D. is decreasing
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：by the time + 過去式，表示在 final round 開始前，體力已經下降，故選過去完成式。

normal.desc: 【運動科學-對話】A: 「Her sprint times are already amazing.」 B: 「If she changed her daily diet slightly, she ___ even faster.」
options: A. runs
B. ran
C. will run
D. could run
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：條件句用 changed (與現在事實相反)，主要子句配 would/could/might + 原形動詞。

normal.desc: 【運動科學-對話】A: 「What did the sports nutritionist say about my meal plan?」 B: 「She emphasized that athletes ___ to consume more protein after intense workouts.」
options: A. needed
B. need
C. will need
D. have needed
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：emphasized 是過去式，因此子句的動詞需跟著轉換為過去式 needed。

normal.desc: 【移民與多元文化-時態】The suburban neighborhood ___ a vibrant cultural hub long before the city officially recognized it.
options: A. becomes
B. had become
C. has become
D. will become
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：long before + 過去式 (recognized)，表示在政府認可前早已成為文化中心，使用過去完成式。

normal.desc: 【移民與多元文化-假設】If the host country ___ more inclusive employment policies, the newcomers would feel much more welcome.
options: A. promote
B. will promote
C. promoted
D. had promoted
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：主要子句為 would feel (與現在相反的假設)，條件句需使用過去式 promoted。

normal.desc: 【移民與多元文化-間接引語】The sociologist observed that diverse communities ___ more creative solutions to local administrative problems.
options: A. produce
B. will produce
C. have produced
D. produced
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：observed 為過去式引述動詞，子句需維持時態一致，使用過去式 produced。

normal.desc: 【移民與多元文化-字彙】Language programs play a crucial role in helping children from different backgrounds ___ into the local society.
options: A. manipulate
B. violate
C. assimilate
D. isolate
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：assimilate into 意指「融入、同化於」，符合幫助不同背景的孩童適應當地社會的語境。

normal.desc: 【移民與多元文化-對話】A: 「Did she struggle with the language barrier when she relocated?」 B: 「Not really, she ___ fluent English before moving abroad.」
options: A. had mastered
B. masters
C. has mastered
D. will master
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：在過去動作 (moving abroad) 之前已精通英文，須用過去完成式。

normal.desc: 【移民與多元文化-對話】A: 「Social integration can be extremely challenging for new immigrants.」 B: 「If they had access to free language classes, the transition ___ much smoother.」
options: A. is
B. will be
C. would be
D. would have been
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：If 條件句使用 had (過去式，表擁有)，這是與現在事實相反的假設，主要子句應配 would be。

normal.desc: 【移民與多元文化-對話】A: 「What did the mayor promise the minority groups?」 B: 「He announced that the council ___ the annual multicultural festival next month.」
options: A. fund
B. would fund
C. has funded
D. will fund
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：主要動詞 announced 是過去式，原本表示未來的 will fund 在間接引語中需退成 would fund。

normal.desc: 【創業與新創公司-時態】The ambitious founders ___ their business model three times before they finally secured the initial funding.
options: A. pivot
B. have pivoted
C. will pivot
D. had pivoted
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：before 引導過去式 (secured)，在獲得資金前已經轉換(pivot)過商業模式，用過去完成式。

normal.desc: 【創業與新創公司-假設】If the startup had launched its mobile application in the summer, they ___ a significantly larger user base.
options: A. might have captured
B. might capture
C. capture
D. will capture
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：If 子句用 had launched (與過去相反)，主要子句應搭配 might have + p.p. 表過去可能的推測。

normal.desc: 【創業與新創公司-間接引語】The venture capitalist stated that he ___ in early-stage companies with strong and experienced leadership teams.
options: A. only invests
B. only invested
C. will only invest
D. has only invested
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：stated 為過去式，引述的子句動詞也必須退一步成為過去式 invested。

normal.desc: 【創業與新創公司-字彙】The young software engineer built a working ___ of her device to present to potential investors at the tech conference.
options: A. prototype
B. illusion
C. liability
D. barrier
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：prototype 意為「原型」，指展示給投資人看的初期產品模型，符合新創募資情境。

normal.desc: 【創業與新創公司-對話】A: 「Why did the highly anticipated tech startup fail so quickly?」 B: 「Because they ___ all their seed money before the final product was even finished.」
options: A. spend
B. are spending
C. had spent
D. will spend
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：在產品完成(過去式)之前就把資金花光了，屬於過去的過去，必須用過去完成式。

normal.desc: 【創業與新創公司-對話】A: 「We simply don't have enough capital to scale our operations globally.」 B: 「If our product were more unique, angel investors ___ us immediately.」
options: A. would approach
B. will approach
C. approach
D. had approached
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：條件句用 were 表示與現在事實相反，主要子句應使用 would + 原形動詞。

normal.desc: 【創業與新創公司-對話】A: 「What did the marketing advisor suggest during the consultation?」 B: 「She recommended that we ___ our target audience before spending a fortune on digital ads.」
options: A. narrowing
B. to narrow
C. will narrow
D. should narrow
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：recommended 引導的名詞子句表示建議，應使用 (should) + 原形動詞。

normal.desc: 【短文】Tech News Brief: A major cybersecurity firm reported that they had warned the social network about the critical flaw months before the massive data leak occurred. Unfortunately, the warning was largely ignored by the management team. Q: What happened before the data leak occurred?
options: A. The management team fixed the critical flaw.
B. A massive data leak was successfully prevented.
C. The social network filed a lawsuit against the firm.
D. A cybersecurity firm issued a warning about a flaw.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：文章提到資安公司在資料外洩的數個月前就已經警告(had warned)了該社群網路，故選 D。

normal.desc: 【短文】Privacy Blog: Modern data collection is out of control. The author argues that if governments established stricter data protection laws globally, tech giants would not be able to exploit user profiles for targeted advertising without explicit permission. Q: What is necessary to stop tech giants from exploiting user profiles?
options: A. Better targeted advertising.
B. Stricter data protection laws.
C. More modern data collection methods.
D. A global agreement on internet speeds.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：作者提出「如果政府建立更嚴格的資料保護法(stricter data protection laws)，科技巨頭就無法濫用用戶資料」，故選 B。

normal.desc: 【短文】Congressional Hearing Notes: The atmosphere was tense during yesterday's session. Under intense questioning, the tech executive finally admitted that his company had tracked users' geographical locations even when the mobile application was closed. Q: What did the tech executive confess?
options: A. The company had lost thousands of user profiles.
B. The application was closed down permanently.
C. The company had monitored users' locations secretly.
D. The company refused to answer congressional questions.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：高層承認他們在應用程式關閉時，依然追蹤了用戶的地理位置(tracked users' geographical locations)，故選 C。

🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: I am sorry, I think my internet just disconnected for a second.
options: A. 我的網路剛剛好像斷線了一秒鐘。
B. 我的麥克風剛剛壞了一秒鐘。
C. 我的檔案剛剛不小心刪除了。
D. 我的螢幕剛剛閃爍了一下。
normal.explain: 英文原句：I am sorry, I think my internet just disconnected for a second. 意思：抱歉，我覺得我的網路剛剛好像斷線了一秒鐘。disconnect 表示「斷線」。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: He mentioned that the time zone difference had caused some confusion.
options: A. 他說行程延誤造成了很大的損失。
B. 他提到時差造成了一些混淆。
C. 他認為文化差異導致了這次失敗。
D. 他抱怨氣候變遷影響了班機。
normal.explain: 英文原句：He mentioned that the time zone difference had caused some confusion. 意思：他提到時差造成了一些混淆。使用過去完成式 (had caused) 表達在提及之前已經發生的事。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: If I had known your microphone was muted, I would have paused the presentation.
options: A. I will present the slide tomorrow.
B. We had finished the report on time.
C. Yes, I forgot to click the unmute button.
D. No, I haven't seen the final version.
normal.explain: 英文原句：If I had known your microphone was muted, I would have paused the presentation. 意思：如果我早知道你的麥克風被靜音了，我就會暫停簡報。選項 C「對，我忘了點擊取消靜音的按鈕」是最合理的回應。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: She asked if we had downloaded the latest software update.
options: A. 她確認我們已經刪除了舊檔案。
B. 她抱怨我們忘記儲存會議紀錄。
C. 她詢問我們是否重開了數據機。
D. 她問我們是否下載了最新的軟體更新。
normal.explain: 英文原句：She asked if we had downloaded the latest software update. 意思：她問我們是否下載了最新的軟體更新。為間接引語句型。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: Could you prepare some visual aids for the online conference?
options: A. 你能為線上會議準備一些視覺輔助工具嗎？
B. 你能幫線上會議安排一些口譯人員嗎？
C. 你能為線上會議設計新的邀請函嗎？
D. 你能幫線上會議設定麥克風音量嗎？
normal.explain: 英文原句：Could you prepare some visual aids for the online conference? 意思：你能為線上會議準備一些視覺輔助工具嗎？visual aids 指「視覺輔助工具」。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: If the connection were stable, we wouldn't hear that annoying echo.
options: A. The agenda is on the second page.
B. Let me try rejoining the meeting.
C. She told us she had left the office.
D. I prefer working from home on Fridays.
normal.explain: 英文原句：If the connection were stable, we wouldn't hear that annoying echo. 意思：如果連線穩定，我們就不會聽到那個煩人的回音。選項 B「讓我嘗試重新加入會議」是為了解決連線問題的合理回應。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The host explained that a power outage had interrupted the broadcast.
options: A. 主辦方承認預算不足導致了活動取消。
B. 主持人抱怨收音設備一直發出雜音。
C. 主持人解釋停電打斷了廣播。
D. 主辦方宣布天氣不佳延後了賽事。
normal.explain: 英文原句：The host explained that a power outage had interrupted the broadcast. 意思：主持人解釋停電打斷了廣播。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: They told us that the virtual meeting had been recorded for future reference.
options: A. 他們保證會議記錄會在明天早上前寄出。
B. 他們警告線上會議可能會面臨資安風險。
C. 他們要求我們把虛擬背景換成公司標誌。
D. 他們告訴我們虛擬會議已被錄下以供未來參考。
normal.explain: 英文原句：They told us that the virtual meeting had been recorded for future reference. 意思：他們告訴我們虛擬會議已被錄下以供未來參考。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: Please make sure your microphone is on mute when you are not speaking.
options: A. 當你不發言時，請確保你的麥克風是靜音的。
B. 當你不發言時，請關閉你的視訊鏡頭。
C. 當你要發言時，請記得先舉手。
D. 當你要發言時，請靠近麥克風一點。
normal.explain: 英文原句：Please make sure your microphone is on mute when you are not speaking. 意思：當你不發言時，請確保你的麥克風是靜音的。mute 指「靜音」。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: If he shared his screen, everyone would see the chart clearly.
options: A. 如果他把檔案寄出，大家就能馬上閱讀。
B. 如果他分享螢幕，每個人就能看清楚圖表。
C. 如果他放大字體，後排的人就能看清楚。
D. 如果他打開鏡頭，我們就能看到他的表情。
normal.explain: 英文原句：If he shared his screen, everyone would see the chart clearly. 意思：如果他分享螢幕，每個人就能看清楚圖表。這是第二類條件句，表達與現在事實相反或假設的情況。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: Customers who bought the defective batch can claim a full refund.
options: A. 購買限量版產品的顧客可以獲得折扣。
B. 購買過季商品的顧客可以要求換貨。
C. 買到有缺陷批次產品的顧客可以申請全額退款。
D. 買到包裝破損產品的顧客可以免費退貨。
normal.explain: 英文原句：Customers who bought the defective batch can claim a full refund. 意思：買到有缺陷批次產品的顧客可以申請全額退款。defective 表示「有缺陷的」。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The manufacturer admitted that they had ignored the initial warning signs.
options: A. 供應商拒絕透露原物料的確切來源。
B. 經銷商否認他們曾收到顧客的投訴。
C. 零售商表示他們已經下架了所有商品。
D. 製造商承認他們忽略了最初的警告跡象。
normal.explain: 英文原句：The manufacturer admitted that they had ignored the initial warning signs. 意思：製造商承認他們忽略了最初的警告跡象。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: If the battery had not overheated, we wouldn't have recalled the entire batch.
options: A. It was definitely a costly design flaw.
B. The shipment is scheduled for next week.
C. She told me she had ordered the wrong size.
D. We will install the new battery tomorrow.
normal.explain: 英文原句：If the battery had not overheated, we wouldn't have recalled the entire batch. 意思：如果電池沒有過熱，我們就不會召回整批產品。選項 A「這絕對是一個代價高昂的設計瑕疵」是最合適的評論。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: She announced that the company had offered a full refund to all buyers.
options: A. 她警告公司可能會因為這起事件破產。
B. 她宣布公司已向所有買家提供全額退款。
C. 她證實公司已經支付了所有的罰款。
D. 她透露公司將對所有供應商提起訴訟。
normal.explain: 英文原句：She announced that the company had offered a full refund to all buyers. 意思：她宣布公司已向所有買家提供全額退款。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The software update caused a serious malfunction in the braking system.
options: A. 軟體更新導致了導航系統嚴重延遲。
B. 軟體更新導致了儀表板顯示錯誤。
C. 軟體更新導致了煞車系統嚴重故障。
D. 軟體更新導致了警報系統誤報。
normal.explain: 英文原句：The software update caused a serious malfunction in the braking system. 意思：軟體更新導致了煞車系統嚴重故障。malfunction 指「故障」。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: If we ignored this safety hazard, our reputation would be completely destroyed.
options: A. I have never used this product before.
B. The factory had closed down by then.
C. He asked if the delivery was on time.
D. You are right, we must act immediately.
normal.explain: 英文原句：If we ignored this safety hazard, our reputation would be completely destroyed. 意思：如果我們忽略這個安全隱患，我們的聲譽將被徹底毀滅。選項 D「你說得對，我們必須立刻採取行動」最為符合。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: They confirmed that a mechanical failure had caused the engine to stall.
options: A. 他們確認機械故障導致引擎熄火。
B. 他們發現人為疏失導致了撞車意外。
C. 他們報告天氣惡劣導致了班機延誤。
D. 他們推測油料不足導致了系統停機。
normal.explain: 英文原句：They confirmed that a mechanical failure had caused the engine to stall. 意思：他們確認機械故障導致引擎熄火。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The CEO stated that they had recalled the items voluntarily to ensure safety.
options: A. 執行長否認產品曾對消費者造成傷害。
B. 執行長聲明他們為了確保安全而自願召回這些產品。
C. 執行長強調他們已經開除了負責這個專案的主管。
D. 執行長承諾未來會降低產品的售價以補償客戶。
normal.explain: 英文原句：The CEO stated that they had recalled the items voluntarily to ensure safety. 意思：執行長聲明他們為了確保安全而自願召回這些產品。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The workers demanded fair compensation for the extra hours they worked.
options: A. 工人們要求對危險的工作環境進行調查。
B. 工人們要求管理層給予更多的假期。
C. 工人們要求對他們額外加班的時間給予合理的賠償。
D. 工人們要求公司改善現有的醫療福利。
normal.explain: 英文原句：The workers demanded fair compensation for the extra hours they worked. 意思：工人們要求對他們額外加班的時間給予合理的賠償或報酬。compensation 指「補償；賠償」。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: If the factory had tested it thoroughly, this disaster would not have happened.
options: A. 如果工廠提早交貨，我們就不會失去客戶。
B. 如果工廠能降低成本，這款產品就會大賣。
C. 如果工廠更換了零件，機器的壽命會更長。
D. 如果工廠有徹底測試，這場災難就不會發生。
normal.explain: 英文原句：If the factory had tested it thoroughly, this disaster would not have happened. 意思：如果工廠有徹底測試，這場災難就不會發生。這是第三類條件句，描述與過去事實相反的假設。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The company has a zero-tolerance policy for workplace harassment.
options: A. 公司對職場騷擾採取零容忍政策。
B. 公司對遲到早退有嚴格的懲罰制度。
C. 公司不允許員工在辦公室內飲食。
D. 公司禁止員工隨意使用公務車輛。
normal.explain: 英文原句：The company has a zero-tolerance policy for workplace harassment. 意思：公司對職場騷擾採取零容忍政策。harassment 指「騷擾」。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The victim reported that her supervisor had constantly belittled her efforts.
options: A. 員工抱怨她的主管經常把工作推給她。
B. 受害者報告她的主管不斷貶低她的努力。
C. 助理指出她的主管總是忘記重要會議。
D. 新人提到她的主管從來不給予明確指示。
normal.explain: 英文原句：The victim reported that her supervisor had constantly belittled her efforts. 意思：受害者報告她的主管不斷貶低她的努力。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: If HR had taken her complaint seriously, she wouldn't have sued the company.
options: A. I think the new policy is quite effective.
B. She said she had forgotten the password.
C. They definitely mishandled the whole situation.
D. If I were you, I would ask for a raise.
normal.explain: 英文原句：If HR had taken her complaint seriously, she wouldn't have sued the company. 意思：如果人資部門認真對待她的投訴，她就不會控告公司了。選項 C「他們絕對是處理失當了」最適當。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: He claimed that his colleagues had deliberately excluded him from the project.
options: A. 他坦承自己不小心洩漏了專案的機密。
B. 他抱怨同事們總是把最難的工作交給他。
C. 他認為他的主管對他有不公平的偏見。
D. 他聲稱同事們故意將他排除在專案之外。
normal.explain: 英文原句：He claimed that his colleagues had deliberately excluded him from the project. 意思：他聲稱同事們故意將他排除在專案之外。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: Working in such a hostile environment made her very depressed.
options: A. 在如此充滿敵意的環境中工作讓她非常沮喪。
B. 在如此吵雜的環境中工作讓她無法專心。
C. 在如此封閉的空間裡工作讓她感到窒息。
D. 在如此競爭的業界裡工作讓她壓力很大。
normal.explain: 英文原句：Working in such a hostile environment made her very depressed. 意思：在如此充滿敵意的環境中工作讓她非常沮喪。hostile 表示「充滿敵意的」。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: If I were the manager, I would never tolerate such toxic behavior in the office.
options: A. Yes, she had finished the assignment early.
B. Unfortunately, he just turns a blind eye to it.
C. I will forward the email to the entire team.
D. The printer has been out of paper since morning.
normal.explain: 英文原句：If I were the manager, I would never tolerate such toxic behavior in the office. 意思：如果我是經理，我絕不會容忍辦公室裡有這種有毒的行為。選項 B「不幸的是，他對此只是視而不見」最合邏輯。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: She testified that the constant verbal abuse had ruined her mental health.
options: A. 她作證說繁重的工作負擔壓垮了她的身體。
B. 她作證說長期的睡眠不足影響了她的判斷。
C. 她作證說不斷的言語暴力毀了她的心理健康。
D. 她作證說不公平的待遇讓她失去了工作熱情。
normal.explain: 英文原句：She testified that the constant verbal abuse had ruined her mental health. 意思：她作證說不斷的言語暴力毀了她的心理健康。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: He asked if anyone had witnessed the argument in the break room.
options: A. I think the coffee machine is broken again.
B. She said she would bring some snacks today.
C. The meeting was rescheduled to Friday afternoon.
D. I was there, but I only heard shouting.
normal.explain: 英文原句：He asked if anyone had witnessed the argument in the break room. 意思：他問是否有人目擊了休息室裡的爭執。選項 D「當時我在場，但我只聽到大吼大叫」為最佳回應。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: They tried to intimidate him into dropping the lawsuit.
options: A. 他們試圖恐嚇他以迫使他撤回訴訟。
B. 他們試圖賄賂他以換取商業機密。
C. 他們試圖說服他接受這份新合約。
D. 他們試圖欺騙他以獲取更多資金。
normal.explain: 英文原句：They tried to intimidate him into dropping the lawsuit. 意思：他們試圖恐嚇他以迫使他撤回訴訟。intimidate 指「恐嚇；威脅」。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: If you had spoken up earlier, the bullying would have stopped sooner.
options: A. 如果你早點出發，我們就不會遲到了。
B. 如果你早點發聲，霸凌就會更早停止。
C. 如果你早點交件，主管就會更高興。
D. 如果你早點拒絕，事情就不會這麼複雜。
normal.explain: 英文原句：If you had spoken up earlier, the bullying would have stopped sooner. 意思：如果你早點發聲，霸凌就會更早停止。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: We must find ways to reduce our carbon emission immediately.
options: A. 我們必須立刻尋找降低生產成本的方法。
B. 我們必須立刻想辦法減少水資源浪費。
C. 我們必須立刻找到減少碳排放物的方法。
D. 我們必須立刻提出提高能源效率的方案。
normal.explain: 英文原句：We must find ways to reduce our carbon emission immediately. 意思：我們必須立刻找到減少碳排放的方法。emission 指「排放；排放物」。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The activist argued that our plastic usage had polluted the entire ocean.
options: A. 專家認為工業廢水已經破壞了地下水層。
B. 教授警告農藥殘留已經影響了土壤肥力。
C. 官員表示空氣汙染已經危害了市民健康。
D. 倡議人士主張我們的塑膠用量已經汙染了整個海洋。
normal.explain: 英文原句：The activist argued that our plastic usage had polluted the entire ocean. 意思：倡議人士主張我們的塑膠用量已經汙染了整個海洋。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: If we invested more in renewable energy, we could slow down global warming.
options: A. That's why solar panels are becoming popular.
B. He told us he had sold his old car yesterday.
C. The new marketing strategy was highly effective.
D. If I were a doctor, I would treat those patients.
normal.explain: 英文原句：If we invested more in renewable energy, we could slow down global warming. 意思：如果我們在再生能源上投資更多，我們就能減緩全球暖化。選項 A「那就是為什麼太陽能板變得受歡迎」是合適的延伸討論。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: She warned that illegal logging had destroyed countless natural habitats.
options: A. 她強調過度捕撈已經讓許多魚類瀕臨絕種。
B. 她警告非法伐木已經摧毀了無數自然棲息地。
C. 她指出大量開發已經導致了嚴重的土石流。
D. 她聲明外來物種已經威脅了本地生態平衡。
normal.explain: 英文原句：She warned that illegal logging had destroyed countless natural habitats. 意思：她警告非法伐木已經摧毀了無數自然棲息地。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: Wildlife conservation requires a lot of funding and public support.
options: A. 城市建設需要大量的勞動力與資金投入。
B. 醫療研究需要很多經費與政府補助。
C. 野生動物保育需要大量資金與大眾支持。
D. 森林復育需要很長的時間與專業技術。
normal.explain: 英文原句：Wildlife conservation requires a lot of funding and public support. 意思：野生動物保育需要大量資金與大眾支持。conservation 指「保育；保護」。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: If they had protected the rainforest, those rare species would not have gone extinct.
options: A. I think the presentation was too long.
B. They said the flight had been canceled due to rain.
C. We should print fewer documents in the office.
D. It is truly a tragic loss for biodiversity.
normal.explain: 英文原句：If they had protected the rainforest, those rare species would not have gone extinct. 意思：如果他們當初有保護雨林，那些稀有物種就不會滅絕。選項 D「這對生物多樣性來說真是一大悲劇損失」最適當。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The scientist noted that the toxic waste had contaminated the local river.
options: A. 科學家指出有毒廢棄物已汙染了當地河流。
B. 研究員發現化學肥料已滲入地下水源。
C. 檢驗員報告重金屬已超標嚴重。
D. 觀察員提到工業排放已影響了空氣品質。
normal.explain: 英文原句：The scientist noted that the toxic waste had contaminated the local river. 意思：科學家指出有毒廢棄物已汙染了當地河流。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: He explained that relying heavily on fossil fuels had led to a climate crisis.
options: A. The museum was built three hundred years ago.
B. We really need to transition to green energy.
C. She asked if the engine was running smoothly.
D. If I were you, I would take the bus instead.
normal.explain: 英文原句：He explained that relying heavily on fossil fuels had led to a climate crisis. 意思：他解釋過度依賴化石燃料已經導致了氣候危機。選項 B「我們真的需要轉型使用綠色能源」最合理。

normal.desc: 【字彙】A professional must maintain strict ___ when dealing with clients' sensitive financial data.
options: A. integrity
B. integration
C. interaction
D. intellect
normal.explain: 本題測驗字彙。integrity 意為「誠實正直；操守」，符合處理敏感財務資料時應有的專業態度。integration (整合)、interaction (互動)、intellect (智力) 皆不符合語意。

normal.desc: 【假設語氣】If the director ___ about the illegal transactions, she would have fired the accountant immediately.
options: A. knows
B. had known
C. knew
D. has known
normal.explain: 本題測驗 If 第三類條件句（與過去事實相反）。主要子句使用 would have fired，條件子句需使用過去完成式 had known，故選 (B)。

normal.desc: 【間接引語】The HR manager stated that the company ___ a zero-tolerance policy for harassment the previous year.
options: A. implements
B. has implemented
C. had implemented
D. will implement
normal.explain: 本題測驗間接引語與時態。引述動詞 stated 為過去式，且句末有 the previous year (前一年)，表示該動作在 stated 之前已經發生，應使用過去完成式 had implemented。

normal.desc: 【時態】By the time the auditor arrived, the ambitious executive ___ all the questionable documents.
options: A. shreds
B. is shredding
C. has shredded
D. had shredded
normal.explain: 本題測驗時態。By the time 引導的子句為過去式 (arrived)，表示在過去某個時間點之前已經完成的動作，主要子句需使用過去完成式 had shredded (已經銷毀)。

normal.desc: 【短文】Workplace Memo: To promote transparency, we have established a new whistleblowing channel. Employees can now report unethical behavior anonymously without fear of retaliation. All reports will be handled by an independent committee. Q: What is the main purpose of the new channel?
options: A. To allow staff to report misconduct safely.
B. To help the independent committee find new members.
C. To announce the promotion of an ambitious executive.
D. To discourage employees from remaining anonymous.
normal.explain: 本題測驗短文主旨。文中提到設立新管道是為了讓員工能匿名舉報不道德行為且免於報復 (without fear of retaliation)，故 (A) 讓員工安全地報告不當行為為正確答案。

normal.desc: 【字彙】It is a huge ethical ___ to accept expensive gifts from suppliers right before a contract renewal.
options: A. dimension
B. dilemma
C. diagnose
D. distribution
normal.explain: 本題測驗字彙。dilemma 意為「困境；進退兩難的局面」，ethical dilemma 指倫理上的兩難或道德爭議。dimension (維度)、diagnose (診斷，動詞)、distribution (分配) 皆不符合。

normal.desc: 【字彙】The board members held the CEO ___ for the severe environmental damage caused by the factory's chemical waste.
options: A. absolute
B. accessible
C. accountable
D. affordable
normal.explain: 本題測驗字彙。hold someone accountable 為固定用法，意指「要求某人負責」。董事會要求執行長對環境破壞負責。absolute (絕對的)、accessible (可進入的)、affordable (負擔得起的) 語意不符。

normal.desc: 【對話-間接引語】A: "Why did he resign from the board of directors so suddenly?" B: "He told me that he ___ to sign the fraudulent financial report."
options: A. refuses
B. had refused
C. is refusing
D. will refuse
normal.explain: 本題測驗間接引語與時態。B 的回答中 told me 為過去式，拒絕簽署這件事發生在告訴我之前，因此需使用過去完成式 had refused。

normal.desc: 【字彙】The astronomers used a powerful telescope to observe the distant ___ bodies in the newly discovered galaxy.
options: A. central
B. casual
C. celestial
D. clinical
normal.explain: 本題測驗字彙。celestial bodies 意為「天體；星體」，與天文學家 (astronomers) 和星系 (galaxy) 的語境相符。central (中央的)、casual (休閒的)、clinical (臨床的) 皆不合邏輯。

normal.desc: 【時態】The spacecraft ___ the planet's orbit long before the ground control on Earth lost the communication signal.
options: A. enters
B. is entering
C. will enter
D. had entered
normal.explain: 本題測驗時態。地面控制中心失去訊號 (lost) 是過去發生的事，太空船進入軌道發生在失去訊號之前 (long before)，故需使用過去完成式 had entered。

normal.desc: 【假設語氣】If the engineers had detected the fuel leak earlier, the rocket ___ during the launch sequence.
options: A. would not have exploded
B. will not explode
C. does not explode
D. had not exploded
normal.explain: 本題測驗與過去事實相反的假設語氣 (If 第三類)。If 子句用 had detected，主要子句需用 would (not) have + p.p.，表示「當時就不會爆炸」，故選 (A)。

normal.desc: 【間接引語】The lead scientist proudly announced that his team ___ liquid water beneath the Martian surface the week before.
options: A. discovers
B. had discovered
C. has discovered
D. will discover
normal.explain: 本題測驗間接引語。announced 為過去式，且句末有 the week before (前一週)，表示發現液態水發生在宣布之前，必須退一步時態使用過去完成式 had discovered。

normal.desc: 【短文】Space Weekly: Earth's orbit is becoming dangerously crowded. Millions of pieces of space debris, from old satellites to discarded rocket stages, pose a significant threat to functioning spacecraft. Researchers emphasize that tracking this junk is crucial for future missions. Q: What is the primary concern mentioned in the text?
options: A. The high cost of launching new satellites into orbit.
B. The lack of funding for tracking discarded rockets.
C. The danger that orbiting trash poses to active missions.
D. The discovery of unknown satellites near Earth.
normal.explain: 本題測驗主旨理解。短文主要討論地球軌道上大量的太空垃圾 (space debris) 對運作中的太空船構成威脅 (pose a significant threat)，故選 (C)。

normal.desc: 【字彙】Building a permanent, self-sustaining base on the Moon is a monumental ___ that requires global cooperation.
options: A. encounter
B. envelope
C. equipment
D. endeavor
normal.explain: 本題測驗字彙。endeavor 意為「努力；艱鉅的任務或計畫」，符合在月球建立基地的語境。encounter (遭遇)、envelope (信封)、equipment (設備) 不符合句意。

normal.desc: 【字彙】The unmanned probe was sent to ___ the thick atmosphere of Venus for signs of specific chemical elements.
options: A. investigate
B. illustrate
C. interfere
D. install
normal.explain: 本題測驗字彙。investigate 意為「調查；探測」，太空探測器 (probe) 被送去探測金星的大氣層。illustrate (說明；畫插圖)、interfere (干涉)、install (安裝) 語意皆不符。

normal.desc: 【對話-時態】A: "Did she manage to take photos of the meteor shower last night?" B: "No, heavy clouds ___ the entire sky by the time she went outside."
options: A. cover
B. are covering
C. have covered
D. had covered
normal.explain: 本題測驗時態。by the time she went outside (到她出門時) 為過去的時間點，烏雲遮住天空是在她出門前就已經完成的狀態，故使用過去完成式 had covered。

normal.desc: 【字彙】The government is raising the retirement age because the national ___ fund is rapidly running out of money.
options: A. pension
B. penalty
C. passion
D. pattern
normal.explain: 本題測驗字彙。pension 意指「退休金；養老金」，pension fund (退休基金) 快要耗盡符合延後退休年齡的語境。penalty (罰款)、passion (熱情)、pattern (模式) 錯誤。

normal.desc: 【假設語氣】If nursing homes ___ more affordable, many working-class families would not suffer from such heavy financial burdens.
options: A. is
B. were
C. has been
D. will be
normal.explain: 本題測驗與現在事實相反的假設語氣 (If 第二類)。主要子句使用 would not suffer，If 子句中的動詞不論人稱皆應使用過去式 were，故選 (B)。

normal.desc: 【間接引語】The sociologist warned that the continuously declining birth rate ___ a severe labor shortage in the following decade.
options: A. causes
B. has caused
C. would cause
D. to cause
normal.explain: 本題測驗間接引語與時態。warned 為過去式，原句的將來時態 (will cause) 轉為間接引語時需退一步成為過去未來式 would cause。

normal.desc: 【時態】Before the new healthcare bill was finally passed, many elderly citizens ___ to pay for their essential medications.
options: A. struggle
B. are struggling
C. have struggled
D. had struggled
normal.explain: 本題測驗時態。法案通過 (was passed) 是過去發生的事，而老年人在此之前一直掙扎於支付藥費，發生在過去的過去，需使用過去完成式 had struggled。

normal.desc: 【短文】Social News: Taiwan is experiencing a rapid demographic shift. With a growing proportion of senior citizens, urban planners must redesign public spaces to include more ramps, benches, and accessible restrooms. These changes are essential for creating an age-friendly environment. Q: What is the main reason for redesigning public spaces?
options: A. The increasing number of elderly people in the population.
B. A sudden decrease in the overall birth rate in cities.
C. A new law that punishes cities without accessible restrooms.
D. The demand from young families for more urban parks.
normal.explain: 本題測驗細節推論。文中指出由於「老年人口比例增加 (growing proportion of senior citizens)」，都市計畫者必須重新設計公共空間以建立高齡友善環境，故答案為 (A)。

normal.desc: 【字彙】Providing adequate daily care for seniors suffering from dementia requires a tremendous amount of patience and ___.
options: A. compromise
B. compassion
C. competition
D. composition
normal.explain: 本題測驗字彙。compassion 意指「同情心；憐憫」，照顧失智症長者需要極大的耐心與同情心。compromise (妥協)、competition (競爭)、composition (成分；作文) 不符合題意。

normal.desc: 【字彙】To prevent the elderly from feeling completely ___, the local community center organizes various weekly social events.
options: A. identified
B. inflated
C. isolated
D. issued
normal.explain: 本題測驗字彙。isolated 意為「孤立的；感到孤獨的」，舉辦社交活動是為了防止老人感到孤立。identified (被認出的)、inflated (膨脹的)、issued (發行的) 語意不通。

normal.desc: 【對話-間接引語】A: "Did the doctor have any good news about your grandmother?" B: "Yes, he stated that her health ___ significantly since the previous checkup."
options: A. improves
B. had improved
C. is improving
D. will improve
normal.explain: 本題測驗間接引語時態。stated 為過去式，而且自從上一次檢查 (since the previous checkup) 到醫生說話時，健康狀況已經改善，故應將現在完成式退一步轉為過去完成式 had improved。

normal.desc: 【字彙】Fast fashion encourages consumers to simply ___ clothing after wearing it only a few times, leading to massive textile waste.
options: A. dismiss
B. dispute
C. discard
D. dissolve
normal.explain: 本題測驗字彙。discard 意為「丟棄；拋棄」，符合快時尚讓人穿幾次就丟掉衣服的描述。dismiss (解散；駁回)、dispute (爭論)、dissolve (溶解) 皆錯誤。

normal.desc: 【時態】The famous European brand ___ organic cotton for years before sustainability became a mainstream consumer trend.
options: A. utilizes
B. is utilizing
C. has utilized
D. had utilized
normal.explain: 本題測驗時態。永續性成為主流趨勢 (became) 是過去式，而該品牌在此之前已經使用有機棉多年，屬於過去的過去，故選用過去完成式 had utilized。

normal.desc: 【假設語氣】If the lead designer had known about the toxic synthetic dyes, he ___ them in his latest summer collection.
options: A. would not have used
B. will not use
C. does not use
D. had not used
normal.explain: 本題測驗與過去事實相反的假設語氣。If 子句為 had known (過去完成式)，主要子句需使用 would/could/might (not) have + p.p.，表示「當時就不會使用」，故選 (A)。

normal.desc: 【間接引語】The environmental activist claimed during the conference that the fashion industry ___ one of the biggest global polluters.
options: A. is
B. was
C. has been
D. will be
normal.explain: 本題測驗間接引語時態一致性。引述動詞 claimed 為過去式，原句中的現在式 (is) 應退一步轉為過去式 was。

normal.desc: 【短文】Style Blog: Second-hand shopping is more than just a passing trend. By purchasing thrifted clothes, you extend the lifespan of garments and reduce the demand for new production. It is a simple yet powerful way to build an eco-friendly wardrobe. Q: Why does the author encourage buying thrifted clothes?
options: A. They are usually made of higher quality materials than new clothes.
B. They are the only way to find unique designer brands.
C. They help minimize environmental impact by reducing waste.
D. They guarantee that local charities receive financial support.
normal.explain: 本題測驗短文細節。文中提到買二手衣可以延長衣物壽命並減少新製造的需求，是一種環保 (eco-friendly) 的做法，這與 (C) 減少浪費以降低環境影響的語意相符。

normal.desc: 【字彙】To lower carbon emissions, the apparel company is heavily researching more ___ materials like hemp and bamboo.
options: A. subjective
B. superficial
C. suspicious
D. sustainable
normal.explain: 本題測驗字彙。sustainable 意為「可持續的；環保的」，研發漢麻和竹子等永續材質以降低碳排放符合邏輯。subjective (主觀的)、superficial (表面的)、suspicious (可疑的) 皆不符。

normal.desc: 【字彙】The award-winning documentary exposes the extremely harsh working conditions in overseas ___ factories where cheap garments are mass-produced.
options: A. textile
B. terminal
C. terrain
D. texture
normal.explain: 本題測驗字彙。textile 意指「紡織品」，textile factories 即為紡織廠，與生產廉價衣物 (garments) 的語境吻合。terminal (終點站)、terrain (地形)、texture (質地) 錯誤。

normal.desc: 【字彙】Constant exposure to idealized and heavily edited images on social networks can severely damage a teenager's self-___.
options: A. esteem
B. estate
C. estimate
D. escort
normal.explain: 本題測驗字彙與搭配詞。self-esteem 意為「自尊心」，過度接觸社群媒體上修圖過的照片會損害青少年的自尊心。estate (房地產)、estimate (估計)、escort (護送) 皆不通。

normal.desc: 【假設語氣】If teenage users ___ their daily screen time, they would likely experience much better sleep quality and reduced anxiety.
options: A. limit
B. limited
C. have limited
D. will limit
normal.explain: 本題測驗與現在事實相反的假設語氣。主要子句使用 would (likely) experience，條件句的動詞需使用過去式 limited。

normal.desc: 【間接引語】The clinical psychologist explained that constant digital notifications ___ a state of chronic stress in many young adults.
options: A. trigger
B. are triggering
C. had triggered
D. to trigger
normal.explain: 本題測驗間接引語。explained 為過去式，引述的內容發生在解釋之前或要維持時態退一步的原則，原為現在完成式或過去式的動作退為過去完成式 had triggered 最為恰當。

normal.desc: 【時態】By the time the school authorities finally noticed the cyberbullying, the victim ___ all of his social media accounts.
options: A. deletes
B. is deleting
C. has deleted
D. had deleted
normal.explain: 本題測驗過去完成式。校方注意到 (noticed) 是過去式，受害者刪除帳號發生在此之前，故使用過去完成式 had deleted。

normal.desc: 【短文】Tech News: Social media platforms are designed to be addictive. The core algorithm constantly analyzes user behavior to serve content that triggers emotional reactions, keeping people scrolling for hours rather than interacting with the real world. Q: What is the main function of the platform's algorithm?
options: A. To keep users engaged on the application for as long as possible.
B. To protect users from seeing emotionally distressing content.
C. To encourage people to spend more time outdoors.
D. To limit the amount of time users spend scrolling daily.
normal.explain: 本題測驗主旨與細節。文中提到演算法不斷分析使用者行為以提供觸發情緒反應的內容，目的是「讓他們滑上好幾個小時 (keeping people scrolling for hours)」，即(A)盡可能讓用戶長時間停留在應用程式上。

normal.desc: 【字彙】Many influencers portray a flawless lifestyle online simply to seek external ___ from their millions of anonymous followers.
options: A. appeal
B. approval
C. approach
D. appetite
normal.explain: 本題測驗字彙。approval 意為「認可；贊同」，seek external approval 指尋求外界的認可。appeal (吸引力；呼籲)、approach (方法；接近)、appetite (胃口) 皆不符語境。

normal.desc: 【字彙】The popular social platform uses massive amounts of behavioral data to ___ exactly what type of content keeps users engaged the longest.
options: A. pretend
B. prevent
C. predict
D. precede
normal.explain: 本題測驗字彙。predict 意為「預測」，社群平台利用大量數據來「預測」哪種內容能讓用戶停留最久。pretend (假裝)、prevent (預防)、precede (在...之前) 皆不合邏輯。
