🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The anchor reported that the recession had hit the retail sector hard.
options: A. 主播預測零售業將會迎來經濟復甦。
B. 主播指出零售業已成功度過經濟危機。
C. 主播聲稱經濟繁榮帶動了零售業發展。
D. 主播報導經濟衰退嚴重打擊了零售業。
normal.explain: 主播報導經濟衰退 (recession) 已經嚴重打擊了零售業 (had hit the retail sector hard)。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: If the stakeholders had agreed to the terms, the acquisition would have been completed.
options: A. 只要利益相關者同意條件，收購就能順利進行。
B. 利益相關者已經同意條件，因此收購案圓滿落幕。
C. 如果利益相關者當時同意條件，收購早就完成了。
D. 由於利益相關者同意了條件，併購即將完成。
normal.explain: If ... had agreed, ... would have been completed. 代表與過去事實相反：如果當時同意了，收購早就完成了（實際上未同意，也未完成）。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: He noted that the company had distributed an impressive dividend last quarter.
options: A. 他提到公司上季面臨了嚴重的虧損。
B. 他指出公司上個季度發放了可觀的股息。
C. 他認為公司未來的股息將會穩定成長。
D. 他抱怨公司上季並未發放任何獎金。
normal.explain: 他指出公司上季已經發放 (had distributed) 了可觀的股息 (dividend)。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: She clarified that the sudden depreciation had completely altered their investment strategy.
options: A. 她說明貨幣升值已經改變了他們的投資策略。
B. 她指出投資策略的改變導致了貨幣快速貶值。
C. 她強調即使貨幣貶值，投資策略也不會改變。
D. 她澄清貨幣突然貶值完全改變了他們的投資策略。
normal.explain: 她澄清 (clarified) 突然的貶值 (depreciation) 已經完全改變了 (had completely altered) 他們的投資策略。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: They admitted that the internal audit had uncovered several undocumented expenses.
options: A. 他們承認內部審計發現了幾筆未記錄的開銷。
B. 他們否認內部審計查出了任何財務問題。
C. 他們要求內部審計必須記錄所有額外開銷。
D. 他們宣布內部審計已經順利結案並無異狀。
normal.explain: 他們承認 (admitted) 內部審計 (internal audit) 已經發現了 (had uncovered) 幾筆未記錄的開銷。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The manager said he had allocated extra resources to the marketing department.
options: A. 經理說行銷部門需要分配更多資源。
B. 經理抱怨行銷部門消耗了太多資源。
C. 經理表示他已經分配了額外資源給行銷部門。
D. 經理計畫從行銷部門抽調部分資源。
normal.explain: 經理表示他已經分配 (had allocated) 額外資源給行銷部門。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The head nurse stated that the surgeon had completed the operation successfully.
options: A. 護理長表示外科醫生將會負責這次的手術。
B. 護理長指出外科醫生已經成功完成了手術。
C. 護理長宣佈手術因外科醫生缺席而延後。
D. 護理長要求外科醫生必須盡快完成手術。
normal.explain: 護理長說明 (stated) 外科醫生 (surgeon) 已經成功完成 (had completed) 手術。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: If the patient had followed the strict diet, his blood pressure would not have spiked.
options: A. 只要病患控制飲食，血壓就不會再次升高。
B. 因為病患沒有控制飲食，所以血壓正在逐漸下降。
C. 即使病患遵循嚴格飲食，血壓依然無法控制。
D. 如果病患當時遵循嚴格飲食，他的血壓就不會飆升。
normal.explain: 與過去事實相反的假設：如果當時遵循了嚴格飲食 (had followed)，血壓就不會飆升 (would not have spiked)。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The specialist confirmed that her chronic pain had been triggered by severe stress.
options: A. 專科醫師建議她必須學會與慢性疼痛共存。
B. 專科醫師確認她的慢性疼痛是由嚴重壓力引起的。
C. 專科醫師認為壓力並不是造成慢性疼痛的主因。
D. 專科醫師警告嚴重的壓力會導致未來的慢性疼痛。
normal.explain: 專科醫師確認 (confirmed) 她的慢性疼痛 (chronic pain) 是被嚴重的壓力所引發的 (had been triggered by)。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The physician explained that the new vaccine had significantly boosted her immune response.
options: A. 醫生解釋新疫苗已經顯著提升了她的免疫反應。
B. 醫生說明新疫苗的副作用會影響免疫系統。
C. 醫生警告她的免疫反應對新疫苗產生了排斥。
D. 醫生強調新疫苗需要更強的免疫反應才能見效。
normal.explain: 內科醫生解釋 (explained) 新疫苗已經顯著提升了 (had significantly boosted) 她的免疫 (immune) 反應。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: She mentioned that the intensive rehabilitation had restored his mobility entirely.
options: A. 她建議他應該參加密集的復健以恢復行動力。
B. 她指出復健雖然密集，但對恢復行動力幫助不大。
C. 她抱怨密集的復健反而讓他失去了行動能力。
D. 她提到密集的復健已經完全恢復了他的行動能力。
normal.explain: 她提到密集的復健 (rehabilitation) 已經完全恢復了 (had restored) 他的行動能力。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: I told the receptionist that my doctor had renewed my prescription online.
options: A. 我跟櫃台人員要求，請醫生在線上幫我開立處方。
B. 櫃台人員告訴我，醫生無法在線上更新處方。
C. 我跟櫃台人員說，我的醫生已經在線上更新了我的處方。
D. 醫生告訴我，櫃台人員已經取消了我的線上處方。
normal.explain: 我告訴櫃台人員，我的醫生已經在線上更新了 (had renewed) 我的處方 (prescription)。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The scholar noted that the outdated methodology had severely flawed the experiment.
options: A. 學者認為這個實驗需要一套全新的方法論。
B. 學者指出過時的方法論已經嚴重破壞了這個實驗。
C. 學者強調過時的方法論仍然適用於某些實驗。
D. 學者批評這個實驗完全沒有使用任何方法論。
normal.explain: 學者指出過時的方法論 (methodology) 已經嚴重使這個實驗產生瑕疵 (had severely flawed)。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: If the peers had reviewed the paper thoroughly, the fundamental error would have been spotted.
options: A. 如果同行當時有仔細審查這篇論文，這個基本錯誤就會被發現。
B. 同行仔細審查了這篇論文，所以找出了所有基本錯誤。
C. 即使同行仔細審查論文，也很難發現這個基本錯誤。
D. 如果論文出現基本錯誤，同行就會仔細審查它。
normal.explain: 與過去事實相反的假設：如果當時同行仔細審查了 (had reviewed)，基本錯誤就會被發現 (would have been spotted)。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: He confessed that his entire thesis had been built on a false premise.
options: A. 他認為他的論文成功推翻了一個錯誤的前提。
B. 他指責別人的論文使用了完全錯誤的前提。
C. 他解釋論文中的錯誤前提已經被修正了。
D. 他承認他的整篇論文都是建立在錯誤的前提上。
normal.explain: 他承認 (confessed) 他的整篇論文都是建立在 (had been built on) 錯誤的前提 (premise) 上。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The researcher stated that the survey respondents had remained completely anonymous.
options: A. 研究員表示問卷受訪者一直保持完全匿名。
B. 研究員要求問卷受訪者必須保持完全匿名。
C. 研究員透露有些問卷受訪者拒絕保持匿名。
D. 研究員承諾未來的問卷受訪者將會保持匿名。
normal.explain: 研究員說明問卷受訪者已經一直保持 (had remained) 完全匿名。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: She announced that all the historical data had been digitized and moved to the archive.
options: A. 她計畫將所有的歷史數據數位化並存入檔案庫。
B. 她宣佈所有的歷史數據已經數位化並移至檔案庫。
C. 她抱怨檔案庫的歷史數據尚未完全數位化。
D. 她表示檔案庫裡的數位歷史數據已經遺失。
normal.explain: 她宣布所有歷史數據都已經被數位化並移至 (had been moved to) 檔案庫 (archive)。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The committee warned that publishing the private interviews had crossed an ethical boundary.
options: A. 委員會規定，所有私人訪談都必須符合倫理界線。
B. 委員會認為，發表私人訪談並沒有違反倫理界線。
C. 委員會警告，發表私人訪談已經越過了倫理界線。
D. 委員會要求，在越過倫理界線前必須停止私人訪談。
normal.explain: 委員會警告發表私人訪談已經越過了 (had crossed) 倫理的 (ethical) 界線。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The official confirmed that the abandoned factory had been demolished last week.
options: A. 官員確認那座廢棄工廠已經在滿意度調查後拆除。
B. 官員宣布那座廢棄工廠將於下週開始拆除。
C. 官員確認那座廢棄工廠已經在上週被拆除了。
D. 官員否認那座廢棄工廠已經遭到違法拆除。
normal.explain: 官員確認那座廢棄工廠已經在上週被拆除 (had been demolished)。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: If the city council had held a public hearing, the residents would not have felt so ignored.
options: A. 市議會舉辦了公聽會，所以居民沒有感到被忽視。
B. 即使市議會舉辦公聽會，居民依然會覺得被忽視。
C. 因為居民覺得被忽視，市議會才決定舉辦公聽會。
D. 如果市議會當時舉辦過公聽會，居民就不會覺得如此被忽視。
normal.explain: 與過去事實相反：如果當時市議會辦過 (had held) 公聽會，居民當時就不會覺得 (would not have felt) 如此被忽視。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The lead architect stated that she had revised the foundation blueprint twice.
options: A. 首席建築師表示她將會再次修改地基藍圖。
B. 首席建築師抱怨地基藍圖被其他人修改了兩次。
C. 首席建築師說明她已經修改了兩次地基藍圖。
D. 首席建築師承認她不小心弄丟了兩份地基藍圖。
normal.explain: 首席建築師說明她已經修改過兩次 (had revised... twice) 地基藍圖 (blueprint)。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The contractor complained that the sudden bad weather had severely delayed the concrete pouring.
options: A. 承包商抱怨突如其來的惡劣天氣已經嚴重延誤了混凝土澆築。
B. 承包商警告突如其來的惡劣天氣將會導致混凝土澆築延誤。
C. 承包商解釋惡劣天氣雖然突然，但沒有影響混凝土澆築。
D. 承包商指出混凝土澆築的延誤導致了更嚴重的工程落後。
normal.explain: 承包商 (contractor) 抱怨突如其來的惡劣天氣已經嚴重延誤了 (had severely delayed) 混凝土澆築。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: He noted that the old theater had been beautifully renovated into a modern gallery.
options: A. 他提議將這座舊劇院精美地翻新成現代畫廊。
B. 他指出這座舊劇院已經被精美地翻新成現代畫廊。
C. 他認為這座舊劇院不應該被翻新成現代畫廊。
D. 他提到這座現代畫廊即遇被改建回原本的劇院。
normal.explain: 他指出這座舊劇院已經被精美地翻新 (had been renovated) 成現代畫廊。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: They announced that the commercial district had officially been rezoned for residential use.
options: A. 他們宣佈該商業區即將申請變更為住宅用途。
B. 他們宣佈該住宅區已經被重新規劃為商業用途。
C. 他們宣佈該區域的住宅與商業活動都已被嚴格限制。
D. 他們宣佈該商業區已經正式被重新規劃為住宅用途。
normal.explain: 他們宣布商業區已經正式被重新劃分 (had officially been rezoned) 為住宅的 (residential) 用途。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The organizer reported that the annual fundraising gala had surpassed its original goal.
options: A. 主辦人報告年度募款晚會的目標設定得太高。
B. 主辦人預測年度募款晚會將會超越原訂目標。
C. 主辦人報告年度募款晚會已經超越了原訂目標。
D. 主辦人承認年度募款晚會並未達到原訂目標。
normal.explain: 主辦人報告年度募款 (fundraising) 晚會已經超越了 (had surpassed) 它的原訂目標。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: If the volunteers had not distributed the supplies quickly, the refugees would have starved.
options: A. 如果志工當時沒有迅速分發物資，難民就會挨餓。
B. 志工沒有迅速分發物資，導致難民正在挨餓。
C. 即使志工迅速分發物資，難民依然會挨餓。
D. 因為難民快要挨餓，志工才開始迅速分發物資。
normal.explain: 與過去事實相反：如果當時志工沒有迅速分發 (had not distributed)，難民當時就會挨餓 (would have starved)。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: She explained that their community outreach program had significantly reduced juvenile crime.
options: A. 她說明他們的社區外展計畫旨在預防未來的青少年犯罪。
B. 她解釋他們的社區外展計畫已經顯著減少了青少年犯罪。
C. 她指出即使有社區外展計畫，青少年犯罪依然嚴重。
D. 她承認社區外展計畫在減少青少年犯罪上成效不彰。
normal.explain: 她解釋他們的社區外展服務 (outreach) 計畫已經顯著地減少了 (had significantly reduced) 青少年犯罪。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The activist stated that the non-profit organization had fought for human rights for decades.
options: A. 社會運動家承諾該非營利組織將會為人權奮鬥數十年。
B. 社會運動家呼籲大家支持為人權奮鬥了數十年的組織。
C. 社會運動家表示該非營利組織已經為人權奮鬥了數十年。
D. 社會運動家否認該非營利組織曾經為人權奮鬥過。
normal.explain: 社會運動家說明該非營利組織已經為人權奮鬥了 (had fought for) 數十年。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The leader proudly announced that they had mobilized over a thousand supporters in one day.
options: A. 領導者驕傲地宣布他們計畫在一天內動員超過一千名支持者。
B. 領導者遺憾地宣布他們在一天內只動員了不到一千名支持者。
C. 領導者驕傲地宣布有超過一千名支持者自發性地進行了動員。
D. 領導者驕傲地宣布他們已經在一天內動員了超過一千名支持者。
normal.explain: 領導者驕傲地宣布他們已經動員了 (had mobilized) 超過一千名支持者。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The millionaire claimed that his passion for philanthropy had completely changed his outlook on life.
options: A. 這位百萬富翁表示他的人生觀改變後才開始對慈善事業產生熱情。
B. 這位百萬富翁聲稱他對慈善事業的熱情已經徹底改變了他的人生觀。
C. 這位百萬富翁認為只有改變人生觀，才能真正投入慈善事業。
D. 這位百萬富翁抱怨投入慈善事業讓他原本的人生觀徹底幻滅。
normal.explain: 百萬富翁聲稱他對慈善事業 (philanthropy) 的熱情已經徹底改變了 (had completely changed) 他的人生觀。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: The board announced that they had secured a new pension provider for all employees.
options: A. I am sorry to hear that the pension fund was completely depleted.
B. They should announce the retirement age as soon as possible.
C. That's great news! Will the new plan offer better retirement benefits?
D. Yes, the board is still looking for a suitable provider.
normal.explain: 原句：董事會宣布他們已經為所有員工找到了新的退休金提供者。回應C：「太棒了！新方案會提供更好的退休福利嗎？」最合理。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: He asked if the pharmacist had prepared the exact prescription for his grandfather.
options: A. No, the grandfather has not visited the pharmacy yet.
B. The prescription is only available for online orders.
C. He should ask the pharmacist to prepare the medication later.
D. Yes, she mentioned it had been ready for pickup since this morning.
normal.explain: 原句：他問藥劑師是否已經為他爺爺準備好正確的處方藥。回應D：「是的，她提到從今天早上就準備好可以取藥了。」最合理。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: The clinical director inquired whether the ward had been disinfected before the transfer.
options: A. Yes, the cleaning staff reported that they had sanitized every corner.
B. The patient will be transferred to a new ward tomorrow.
C. He asked the director to disinfect the hospital room.
D. No, the infection rate has been growing rapidly.
normal.explain: 原句：臨床主任詢問病房在轉院前是否已進行消毒。回應A：「是的，清潔人員報告他們已經對每個角落進行了消毒。」最合理。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: The professor asked if anyone had found a strong correlation between the two variables.
options: A. Yes, I am looking for the two variables right now.
B. Yes, a recent study showed they had been positively linked.
C. I actually submitted my research proposal yesterday.
D. The correlation is completely irrelevant to our current topic.
normal.explain: 原句：教授詢問是否有人發現這兩個變數之間存在強烈的相關性。回應B：「是的，最近的一項研究顯示它們呈正相關。」最合理。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: They admitted that the initial hypothesis had contradicted the actual field data.
options: A. Yes, the field data was collected by a group of undergraduate students.
B. The hypothesis is very accurate and reliable according to the report.
C. No, they didn't collect any field data during the process.
D. That's unfortunate. Did they explain why their assumption was wrong?
normal.explain: 原句：他們承認最初的假設與實際的田野數據相矛盾。回應D：「真遺憾。他們有解釋為什麼他們的假設是錯的嗎？」最合理。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: The developer asked if the new residential complex had met all the safety codes.
options: A. The residential complex is going to be built next year.
B. No, the developer is still drafting the initial proposal.
C. Yes, the inspector confirmed it had passed every required test.
D. He said he would complain about the strict safety regulations.
normal.explain: 原句：開發商詢問新的住宅園區是否符合所有安全規範。回應C：「是的，檢查員確認它通過了所有要求的測試。」最合理。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: She mentioned that the urban renewal project had drastically increased local property taxes.
options: A. That explains why so many long-term residents are deciding to move out.
B. I disagree. The property taxes will definitely decrease next month.
C. The project hasn't started yet due to the lack of sufficient funding.
D. Yes, she told us to pay the taxes as soon as possible.
normal.explain: 原句：她提到都市更新計畫大幅增加了當地的財產稅。回應A：「這就解釋了為什麼有這麼多長期居民決定搬走。」最合理。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: He asked if the local shelter had received the generous donation from the anonymous sponsor.
options: A. No, the sponsor wants to reveal his identity to the public.
B. Yes, the director confirmed the funds were transferred yesterday.
C. The donation is very helpful for the local community.
D. The local shelter is currently looking for more volunteers.
normal.explain: 原句：他詢問當地庇護所是否收到了匿名贊助商的慷慨捐款。回應B：「是的，主任確認資金昨天已經轉帳了。」最合理。

normal.desc: 【時態】The agency ___ the commercial before the product was officially launched in the market.
options: A. has broadcasted
B. had broadcasted
C. is broadcasting
D. broadcasts
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：在產品上市前就已經完成的動作，使用過去完成式。其他選項時態皆不符合「過去的過去」。

normal.desc: 【時態】By the time the rival brand reacted, we ___ our target audience significantly.
options: A. had captured
B. capture
C. are capturing
D. will capture
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：由 By the time 帶出的過去時間點前已完成的狀態，須用過去完成式 (had + p.p.)。

normal.desc: 【假設】If the company ___ its traditional logo, it would attract a much younger demographic.
options: A. modernize
B. modernizes
C. modernized
D. has modernized
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：與現在事實相反的假設語氣（第二類條件句），If 子句需使用過去式動詞。

normal.desc: 【假設】If the director had known about the sudden trend, she ___ the budget differently.
options: A. would allocate
B. will allocate
C. allocates
D. would have allocated
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：與過去事實相反的假設（第三類條件句），主要子句需用 would have + p.p.。

normal.desc: 【間接引語】The PR manager stated that they ___ a new promotional approach the following month.
options: A. would introduce
B. will introduce
C. introduces
D. have introduced
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：間接引語中，原本的未來式 will 隨主要動詞 stated 退一步變為 would。

normal.desc: 【字彙】Celebrity ___ can greatly boost a product's visibility in a highly competitive market.
options: A. endorsements
B. foundations
C. symptoms
D. delegates
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：endorsement 意為代言、背書。B為基金會，C為症狀，D為代表，皆不合語意。

normal.desc: 【短文】Marketing Weekly: Modern consumers are increasingly ignoring standard banner ads. Research indicates that if brands incorporated more storytelling into their campaigns, engagement rates would soar. People want to connect emotionally with what they buy. Q: What does the research suggest brands should do?
options: A. Decrease banner ad prices
B. Include storytelling in campaigns
C. Ignore modern consumers
D. Focus on technical specifications
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：短文中提到「如果品牌在活動中融入更多說故事的元素，參與率將會飆升」，故選B。

normal.desc: 【短文】Email to PR Team: The recent billboard error was embarrassing. By the time someone noticed the typo, thousands of drivers had already seen it. We must ensure all visual assets are double-checked before going live. Q: What had happened before the typo was noticed?
options: A. The billboard was taken down
B. Visual assets were double-checked
C. Thousands of drivers had seen the error
D. The PR team resigned
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：信件指出「在有人注意到錯字之前，數千名駕駛已經看到了」，故選C。

normal.desc: 【時態】The students ___ the online module before the central server unexpectedly crashed.
options: A. have finished
B. will finish
C. finish
D. had finished
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：在系統崩潰（過去式）之前就完成的動作，使用過去完成式。

normal.desc: 【時態】By the time the teacher logged into the portal, most of the class ___ the digital assignment.
options: A. had submitted
B. submit
C. are submitting
D. will submit
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：在老師登入（過去）之前學生已繳交作業，需用過去完成式。

normal.desc: 【假設】If the educational software ___ more engaging, students would participate actively in lessons.
options: A. is
B. were
C. has been
D. will be
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：與現在事實相反的假設，be 動詞無論人稱皆建議用 were。

normal.desc: 【假設】If the school had upgraded the internet infrastructure, the connection ___ during the final exam.
options: A. will not drop
B. did not drop
C. would not have dropped
D. does not drop
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：與過去事實相反的條件句，結果句需使用 would have + p.p.。

normal.desc: 【字彙】The new language application is highly ___, allowing learners to speak and receive instant feedback.
options: A. interactive
B. redundant
C. invisible
D. stationary
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：interactive 意為互動的，符合後文「能說話並獲得即時回饋」的語意。

normal.desc: 【短文】Tech in Schools: Virtual reality is changing education. A recent pilot program showed that students who had used VR headsets to explore ancient Rome retained 30% more historical facts than those who merely read textbooks. Q: What is the main finding of the pilot program?
options: A. Textbooks are completely obsolete
B. VR helps students remember more facts
C. Ancient Rome is the most popular subject
D. VR headsets are too expensive
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：文章指出使用 VR 的學生比只讀課本的學生多記住 30% 的史實，即幫助記憶更多事實。

normal.desc: 【短文】IT Bulletin: Please be advised that the learning management system will be down for maintenance tonight. The head technician assured the faculty yesterday that the update would fix all the grading glitches before midterm week. Q: What is the purpose of the upcoming update?
options: A. To delay the midterm week
B. To cancel faculty accounts
C. To fix errors in the grading system
D. To install new firewall hardware
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：短文提到更新將會修正所有成績評分的故障 (fix all the grading glitches)，故選C。

normal.desc: 【時態】The archaeologists ___ the hidden ruins long before the historical society finally provided funding.
options: A. had excavated
B. excavate
C. will excavate
D. have excavated
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：在提供資金之前就已經挖掘出遺跡，發生在過去的過去，用過去完成式。

normal.desc: 【時態】By the time the historian published her controversial book, other researchers ___ similar conclusions.
options: A. are reaching
B. will reach
C. had reached
D. reach
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：出書是過去式，在此之前研究人員已經得出結論，須用過去完成式。

normal.desc: 【假設】If we ___ access to the original wartime manuscripts, our understanding of the era would be much clearer.
options: A. have
B. had
C. will have
D. had had
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：與現在事實相反的假設，條件句動詞應使用過去式。

normal.desc: 【假設】If the empire had not overexpanded its military operations, it ___ for another century.
options: A. might survive
B. survives
C. might have survived
D. will survive
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：與過去事實相反，條件句用過去完成式，主要子句用 might have + p.p.。

normal.desc: 【字彙】The national museum proudly displayed several rare ___ recovered from the sunken 16th-century Spanish galleon.
options: A. artifacts
B. beverages
C. suburbs
D. prescriptions
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：artifact 意為歷史文物、手工藝品。B飲料，C郊區，D處方，皆不合語意。

normal.desc: 【短文】Historical Journal: The construction of the grand canal was a monumental feat. However, historical records reveal that if the emperor had listened to his engineers, thousands of laborers would not have perished during the monsoon season. Q: What does the text imply about the emperor?
options: A. He built the canal by himself
B. He ignored the advice of his engineers
C. He halted construction during the monsoon
D. He successfully protected his laborers
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：文中提及「如果皇帝聽了工程師的話，勞工就不會死亡」，暗示他當初並未聽從建議。

normal.desc: 【短文】Museum Newsletter: Next month, we will open a new exhibit detailing the Industrial Revolution. The curator mentioned last week that she had spent three years gathering authentic letters from factory workers for this exclusive display. Q: What is the main feature of the new exhibit?
options: A. Modern factory machinery
B. Authentic letters from workers
C. Replicas of medieval weapons
D. Paintings of royal families
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：館長花三年收集了工廠工人的「真實信件」(authentic letters) 作為展出內容。

normal.desc: 【時態】The software engineers ___ the artificial intelligence algorithm several times before the autonomous vehicle was tested on public roads.
options: A. had refined
B. refine
C. will refine
D. are refining
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：在道路測試（過去式）之前已完成多次改良，使用過去完成式。

normal.desc: 【時態】By the time the new safety legislation finally passed, self-driving cars ___ thousands of miles across the country.
options: A. are driving
B. had driven
C. drive
D. will drive
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：法案通過前已經行駛數千英里，需使用過去完成式 had + p.p.。

normal.desc: 【假設】If all vehicles on the highway ___ fully automated, severe traffic jams would likely become a thing of the past.
options: A. are
B. will be
C. have been
D. were
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：與現在/未來狀況相反的假設，be 動詞一律使用 were。

normal.desc: 【假設】If the onboard sensor had detected the pedestrian in the shadows, the car ___ immediately.
options: A. would have stopped
B. stops
C. would stop
D. will stop
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：與過去事實相反（當時沒偵測到），主要子句需用 would have + p.p.。

normal.desc: 【字彙】To prevent a fatal ___, the vehicle's automatic emergency braking system activated instantly.
options: A. digestion
B. collision
C. rehearsal
D. metaphor
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：collision 意為碰撞、車禍，符合緊急煞車系統啟動的情境。

normal.desc: 【短文】Transport News: Autonomous vehicles rely heavily on detailed maps. Yesterday, a self-driving taxi got stuck at a newly constructed intersection. The developer later explained that the car's internal map had not been updated for that specific district. Q: Why did the self-driving taxi get stuck?
options: A. It ran out of electric power
B. The driver fell asleep
C. Its map lacked recent updates
D. The traffic lights were broken
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：開發者解釋車輛內部地圖沒有更新該區域的資訊，導致車輛卡住。

normal.desc: 【短文】Safety Report: The transition to driverless cars requires public trust. A survey indicated that if manufacturers explained the sensor technology more clearly, fewer people would feel anxious about riding in these vehicles. Q: What causes people to feel anxious according to the survey?
options: A. High purchase costs
B. A lack of understanding about the technology
C. Too much traffic on the roads
D. Incomfortable seats
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：若製造商解釋得更清楚，民眾就不會那麼焦慮，推論原因是民眾目前缺乏對科技的了解。

normal.desc: 【時態】The local restaurant ___ its unserved meals to homeless shelters before the new municipal law made it mandatory.
options: A. has donated
B. will donate
C. had donated
D. donates
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：在法律強制規定（過去）之前就已經捐贈，時態應為過去完成式。

normal.desc: 【時態】By the time the weekend food festival ended, the organizers ___ hundreds of kilograms of organic waste.
options: A. had composted
B. compost
C. are composting
D. composts
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：By the time + 過去式，主要子句表示在該時間點前已完成的事，用過去完成式。

normal.desc: 【假設】If major supermarkets ___ imperfect but edible fruits at a discount, much less food would end up in the landfill.
options: A. sell
B. sold
C. have sold
D. are selling
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：與現在事實相反的假設，條件句需使用過去式動詞。

normal.desc: 【假設】If the city council had built the recycling facility earlier, they ___ a circular economy much sooner.
options: A. will establish
B. establish
C. would establish
D. would have established
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：與過去事實相反（未及早建立設施），主要子句需用 would have + p.p.。

normal.desc: 【字彙】Organic materials like vegetable peels and eggshells can easily ___ and return valuable nutrients to the soil.
options: A. decompose
B. negotiate
C. translate
D. commute
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：decompose 意為分解、腐爛，適合用於有機物回歸土壤的描述。

normal.desc: 【短文】Eco-Living Blog: Reducing food waste starts at home. Instead of throwing away bruised apples, you can bake them into pies. If every household adopted this mindset, we would see a drastic drop in municipal garbage. Q: What is the blog's primary suggestion?
options: A. Stop eating apples completely
B. Find creative uses for imperfect food
C. Buy more municipal garbage bins
D. Only eat at restaurants
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：文章建議不要丟棄碰傷的蘋果，而是拿去烤派，意即為不完美的食物尋找創意用途。

normal.desc: 【短文】City Gazette: The new 'Ugly Veggie' initiative has been a huge success. The coordinator stated that local farmers had sold 50% more of their aesthetically imperfect produce since the awareness campaign began last month. Q: What was the result of the initiative?
options: A. Farmers stopped growing vegetables
B. Sales of imperfect produce increased
C. The awareness campaign was cancelled
D. Produce prices doubled
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：協調員表示自從活動開始後，農民賣出的不完美農產品增加了 50%。

normal.desc: 【字彙】The government provides a tax ___ to companies that actively participate in reducing their carbon footprint.
options: A. symptom
B. incentive
C. landscape
D. friction
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：incentive 意為誘因、獎勵。tax incentive 指租稅優惠。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The agent explained that my premium had increased due to the recent accident.
options: A. 代理人解釋我的保費因為最近的車禍調漲了。
B. 代理人說我的理賠金因為車禍減少了。
C. 代理人表示我的保單已經因為意外取消。
D. 代理人提到我的車子因為意外無法維修。
normal.explain: 英文原句：The agent explained that my premium had increased due to the recent accident.（代理人解釋我的保費因為最近的車禍調漲了。）premium 意為保費。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: If I had purchased comprehensive coverage, the repairs would have been fully paid.
options: A. 如果我有買車，修理費就能分期付款。
B. 如果我有買綜合險，修理費就會全額支付。
C. 如果我有提早發現，就能完全避免修理。
D. 如果我有保留收據，就能獲得部分補償。
normal.explain: 英文原句：If I had purchased comprehensive coverage, the repairs would have been fully paid.（如果我有買綜合險，修理費就會全額支付。）這是一個與過去事實相反的第三類條件句。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: He stated that the specialist had already assessed the vehicle damage.
options: A. 他說專家已經修好了這輛車。
B. 他說專家拒絕評估這輛車的價值。
C. 他說專家已經評估過車輛的損壞情況。
D. 他說專家認為這輛車沒有受損。
normal.explain: 英文原句：He stated that the specialist had already assessed the vehicle damage.（他說專家已經評估過車輛的損壞情況。）

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: If your policy were to expire tomorrow, would you renew it immediately?
options: A. Yes, the policy was very clear.
B. No, I haven't received the package.
C. I didn't know it was broken.
D. Yes, I would pay for it right away.
normal.explain: 英文原句：If your policy were to expire tomorrow, would you renew it immediately?（如果你的保單明天到期，你會立刻續約嗎？）選項 D「是的，我會馬上付款」為最合理的回應。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: The caller mentioned she had submitted her medical claim three weeks ago.
options: A. Let me check the status for you.
B. Yes, she is a great doctor.
C. The hospital is closed today.
D. I think she will call back later.
normal.explain: 英文原句：The caller mentioned she had submitted her medical claim three weeks ago.（來電者提到她三週前已經送出醫療理賠申請了。）選項 A「讓我為您查詢進度」最符合客服情境。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: If you had informed us earlier, you would have been eligible for a full payout.
options: A. 如果你提早通知我們，我們就會提早下班。
B. 如果你提早通知我們，你就有資格獲得全額理賠。
C. 如果你早點告訴我們，你就能取消合約。
D. 如果你事先通知，我們就會派人過去。
normal.explain: 英文原句：If you had informed us earlier, you would have been eligible for a full payout.（如果你提早通知我們，你就有資格獲得全額理賠。）eligible 意為有資格的。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: They confirmed that the weather damage had been more severe than expected.
options: A. 他們確認天氣預報比預期的還要準確。
B. 他們確認天氣已經好轉了。
C. 他們確認氣候造成的損害比預期的更嚴重。
D. 他們確認損害是可以預防的。
normal.explain: 英文原句：They confirmed that the weather damage had been more severe than expected.（他們確認氣候造成的損害比預期的更嚴重。）

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: If the hospital had sent the bill directly, I would not have withdrawn my claim.
options: A. 如果醫院直接寄帳單來，我就不會撤回理賠申請。
B. 如果醫院沒有寄帳單，我就不會支付費用。
C. 如果醫院有開立證明，我就能申請理賠。
D. 如果醫院拒絕給帳單，我也無能為力。
normal.explain: 英文原句：If the hospital had sent the bill directly, I would not have withdrawn my claim.（如果醫院直接寄帳單來，我就不會撤回理賠申請。）withdraw 為撤回之意。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The CEO announced that the two tech giants had officially merged last Friday.
options: A. 執行長宣布兩間科技公司上週五倒閉了。
B. 執行長宣布兩家公司上週五簽署了合約。
C. 執行長宣布兩大科技巨頭已於上週五正式合併。
D. 執行長宣布兩家公司將在下週五拆分。
normal.explain: 英文原句：The CEO announced that the two tech giants had officially merged last Friday.（執行長宣布兩大科技巨頭已於上週五正式合併。）

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: If the rumor were true, their shares would plummet instantly.
options: A. The shares are very beautiful.
B. I don't like rumors either.
C. Yes, it flew away.
D. Fortunately, it's just fake news.
normal.explain: 英文原句：If the rumor were true, their shares would plummet instantly.（如果謠言是真的，他們的股價會瞬間暴跌。）選項 D「幸好這只是假新聞」是順應語境的回應。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: Analysts reported that the newly formed group had dominated the Asian market.
options: A. 分析師報告指出，新成立的集團已主導了亞洲市場。
B. 分析師報告指出，新集團在亞洲市場慘遭淘汰。
C. 分析師報告指出，新集團放棄了亞洲市場。
D. 分析師報告指出，新集團正在調查亞洲市場。
normal.explain: 英文原句：Analysts reported that the newly formed group had dominated the Asian market.（分析師報告指出，新成立的集團已主導了亞洲市場。）dominate 意為主導、稱霸。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: If the board had accepted the offer, it wouldn't have turned into a hostile takeover.
options: A. 如果董事會拒絕提議，他們就會面臨破產。
B. 如果董事會接受了該提議，就不會演變成惡意併購。
C. 如果董事會有誠意，就不會提出惡意收購。
D. 如果董事會提出條件，收購案就會順利進行。
normal.explain: 英文原句：If the board had accepted the offer, it wouldn't have turned into a hostile takeover.（如果董事會接受了該提議，就不會演變成惡意併購。）

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: The spokesperson confirmed that the management had restructured the entire sales division.
options: A. The building was constructed last year.
B. They sell very expensive shoes.
C. Did any employees lose their jobs?
D. The speech was very confirming.
normal.explain: 英文原句：The spokesperson confirmed that the management had restructured the entire sales division.（發言人確認管理層已重組了整個銷售部門。）選項 C「有員工因此失業嗎？」符合重組帶來的人事異動話題。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: They admitted that the legal team had negotiated the terms for over six months.
options: A. 他們承認法務團隊已經就條款協商了超過半年。
B. 他們承認法務團隊在六個月前就放棄了談判。
C. 他們承認法務團隊不願意協商這些條款。
D. 他們承認談判條款需要再花六個月的時間。
normal.explain: 英文原句：They admitted that the legal team had negotiated the terms for over six months.（他們承認法務團隊已經就條款協商了超過半年。）

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: The director asked if they had retained the key engineers after the transition.
options: A. The keys are on the desk.
B. Yes, most of them decided to stay.
C. The train is leaving soon.
D. He directed a great movie.
normal.explain: 英文原句：The director asked if they had retained the key engineers after the transition.（主管詢問在過渡期後他們是否留住了關鍵工程師。）選項 B「是的，他們多數決定留下」最為適合。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The agent apologized and said the flight had been severely overbooked.
options: A. 代理人道歉並表示航班已經嚴重超賣。
B. 代理人道歉並表示航班已經被取消。
C. 代理人道歉並說他訂錯了機票。
D. 代理人道歉並表示航班延誤了。
normal.explain: 英文原句：The agent apologized and said the flight had been severely overbooked.（代理人道歉並表示航班已經嚴重超賣。）overbooked 意為超額預訂的。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: If the hotel had refunded our deposit, I wouldn't have left a bad review.
options: A. The review was very long.
B. We apologize for the delay in returning your money.
C. The deposit is usually paid in cash.
D. I don't know how to write a review.
normal.explain: 英文原句：If the hotel had refunded our deposit, I wouldn't have left a bad review.（如果飯店有退還我們的押金，我就不會留負評了。）選項 B「對於延遲退款我們深表歉意」是客服人員的合理回應。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The guest claimed that the bathroom hygiene had been absolutely disgusting.
options: A. 房客聲稱浴室的設備非常先進。
B. 房客抱怨浴室的空間太小了。
C. 房客聲稱浴室的衛生狀況絕對是令人作嘔的。
D. 房客抱怨浴室裡沒有提供盥洗用品。
normal.explain: 英文原句：The guest claimed that the bathroom hygiene had been absolutely disgusting.（房客聲稱浴室的衛生狀況絕對是令人作嘔的。）hygiene 為衛生，disgusting 為令人作嘔的。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: The receptionist asked if I had requested a room upgrade online.
options: A. The room is very large.
B. I don't like using computers.
C. Yes, the internet is fast.
D. No, I just wanted a standard room.
normal.explain: 英文原句：The receptionist asked if I had requested a room upgrade online.（接待員問我是否在網路上要求了客房升級。）選項 D「沒有，我只想要標準房」合理回答了詢問。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: If the airline had provided accommodation, we wouldn't have been stuck at the terminal all night.
options: A. 如果航空公司有提供住宿，我們就不會整晚被困在航廈。
B. 如果航空公司有提供食物，我們就不會餓一整晚。
C. 如果航空公司沒有提供住宿，我們就會被困住。
D. 如果我們早點到航廈，就不會錯過航空公司的住宿。
normal.explain: 英文原句：If the airline had provided accommodation, we wouldn't have been stuck at the terminal all night.（如果航空公司有提供住宿，我們就不會整晚被困在航廈。）accommodation 為住宿。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: The customer complained that she had found a dead bug in her soup.
options: A. The soup is very hot.
B. I am so sorry, I will bring you a new bowl immediately.
C. She likes catching bugs.
D. We don't serve soup today.
normal.explain: 英文原句：The customer complained that she had found a dead bug in her soup.（顧客抱怨她在湯裡發現了一隻死蟲。）選項 B「非常抱歉，我馬上為您換一碗新的」是餐廳的適當處置。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: He stated that the maintenance crew had turned off the hot water without notice.
options: A. 他說維修人員沒有找到熱水開關。
B. 他說維修人員已經把熱水修好了。
C. 他表示維修人員在沒有通知的情況下關掉了熱水。
D. 他表示維修人員警告過熱水會被關閉。
normal.explain: 英文原句：He stated that the maintenance crew had turned off the hot water without notice.（他表示維修人員在沒有通知的情況下關掉了熱水。）

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: If the staff were more courteous, the resort would attract more returning visitors.
options: A. 如果員工更有經驗，度假村就會賺更多錢。
B. 如果度假村更便宜，就會有更多回訪客。
C. 如果員工數量更多，度假村就能接待更多客人。
D. 如果員工更有禮貌，度假村就會吸引更多回訪客。
normal.explain: 英文原句：If the staff were more courteous, the resort would attract more returning visitors.（如果員工更有禮貌，度假村就會吸引更多回訪客。）courteous 意為有禮貌的。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The author mentioned that her trip to India had felt incredibly authentic.
options: A. 作者提到她的印度之旅非常危險。
B. 作者提到她的印度之旅充滿了謊言。
C. 作者提到她的印度之旅感覺非常道地真實。
D. 作者提到她的印度之旅花了很多錢。
normal.explain: 英文原句：The author mentioned that her trip to India had felt incredibly authentic.（作者提到她的印度之旅感覺非常道地真實。）authentic 意為真實的、道地的。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: If you were more vulnerable with your audience, they would connect with you deeper.
options: A. The audience is very loud today.
B. I don't like watching movies alone.
C. The connection is lost.
D. You're right, I should stop hiding my flaws.
normal.explain: 英文原句：If you were more vulnerable with your audience, they would connect with you deeper.（如果你能在觀眾面前表現得更脆弱真實，他們會與你有更深的共鳴。）選項 D「你說得對，我應該停止隱藏我的缺點」是合理的回答。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: He explained that the media had twisted his original narrative.
options: A. 他解釋媒體扭曲了他原本的說法與故事。
B. 他解釋媒體報導了他真實的故事。
C. 他解釋媒體拒絕採訪他的故事。
D. 他解釋他把故事賣給了媒體。
normal.explain: 英文原句：He explained that the media had twisted his original narrative.（他解釋媒體扭曲了他原本的說法與故事。）narrative 意為敘事、故事。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: She shared that practicing mindfulness had completely cured her morning anxiety.
options: A. 她分享正念練習讓她的早晨變得更忙碌。
B. 她分享練習正念已經完全治癒了她的晨間焦慮。
C. 她分享她每天早上都會去健身房練習。
D. 她分享她的焦慮是因為沒有吃早餐。
normal.explain: 英文原句：She shared that practicing mindfulness had completely cured her morning anxiety.（她分享練習正念已經完全治癒了她的晨間焦慮。）mindfulness 為正念，anxiety 為焦慮。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: The host asked if his previous failure had become an inspirational lesson.
options: A. The host is very generous.
B. He failed the math test.
C. Definitely, it taught him to be resilient.
D. I don't want to take any lessons.
normal.explain: 英文原句：The host asked if his previous failure had become an inspirational lesson.（主持人詢問他之前的失敗是否成了激勵人心的教訓。）選項 C「絕對是，這教會他要堅韌不拔」最為呼應。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: If I hadn't taken a gap year, I would have been completely exhausted.
options: A. 如果我沒有去旅行，我就會很有精神。
B. 如果我有休空檔年，我就會非常累。
C. 如果我沒有休假，我就會辭職。
D. 如果我當初沒有休個空檔年，我早就已經徹底筋疲力盡了。
normal.explain: 英文原句：If I hadn't taken a gap year, I would have been completely exhausted.（如果我當初沒有休個空檔年，我早就已經徹底筋疲力盡了。）exhausted 意為筋疲力盡的。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The guest admitted that he had skipped his morning routine for a month.
options: A. 來賓承認他已經一個月沒有做他的晨間常規了。
B. 來賓承認他早上總是很匆忙。
C. 來賓承認他這個月每天都有做晨間運動。
D. 來賓承認他一個月前改變了作息。
normal.explain: 英文原句：The guest admitted that he had skipped his morning routine for a month.（來賓承認他已經一個月沒有做他的晨間常規了。）routine 意為常規、例行公事。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: If we expressed more gratitude daily, our mental health would drastically improve.
options: A. Health insurance is expensive.
B. I completely agree, being thankful changes your mindset.
C. I don't like going to the hospital.
D. Yes, the weather is improving.
normal.explain: 英文原句：If we expressed more gratitude daily, our mental health would drastically improve.（如果我們每天表達更多感激，我們的心理健康會大幅改善。）選項 B「我完全同意，心懷感恩會改變心態」最適合。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The commentator noted that the champion had won the tournament effortlessly.
options: A. 評論員指出冠軍毫不費力地贏得了錦標賽。
B. 評論員指出冠軍在錦標賽中受傷了。
C. 評論員指出冠軍輸掉了這場比賽。
D. 評論員指出冠軍為了錦標賽付出了很多努力。
normal.explain: 英文原句：The commentator noted that the champion had won the tournament effortlessly.（評論員指出冠軍毫不費力地贏得了錦標賽。）tournament 意為錦標賽，effortlessly 意為毫不費力地。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: If the coach had changed his defensive tactic, they wouldn't have lost the match.
options: A. The coach is driving a new car.
B. True, sticking to the same strategy was a huge error.
C. They won the match easily.
D. The defense lawyer is very smart.
normal.explain: 英文原句：If the coach had changed his defensive tactic, they wouldn't have lost the match.（如果教練改變了他的防守戰術，他們就不會輸掉比賽。）選項 B「沒錯，堅持同一策略是個大錯誤」合理延續話題。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: Fans agreed that the final quarter had been absolutely thrilling.
options: A. 球迷同意最後一節非常無聊。
B. 球迷同意最後一節的判決很不公平。
C. 球迷一致認為最後一節絕對是驚心動魄的。
D. 球迷一致認為比賽早就該結束了。
normal.explain: 英文原句：Fans agreed that the final quarter had been absolutely thrilling.（球迷一致認為最後一節絕對是驚心動魄的。）thrilling 意為刺激的、驚心動魄的。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: No one expected that the underdog would have defeated the defending champion.
options: A. 大家預料到弱隊會輸給衛冕冠軍。
B. 大家預計衛冕冠軍會慘敗。
C. 沒有人預料到狗會跑進比賽場地。
D. 沒有人預料到處於劣勢的隊伍竟然擊敗了衛冕冠軍。
normal.explain: 英文原句：No one expected that the underdog would have defeated the defending champion.（沒有人預料到處於劣勢的隊伍竟然擊敗了衛冕冠軍。）underdog 意為不被看好的劣勢方/黑馬。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: The reporter mentioned that thousands of spectators had left the stadium early.
options: A. They probably gave up hope on a comeback.
B. The stadium is made of steel.
C. I bought a new pair of glasses.
D. The report was published yesterday.
normal.explain: 英文原句：The reporter mentioned that thousands of spectators had left the stadium early.（記者提到數千名觀眾提早離開了體育場。）選項 A「他們可能放棄了逆轉勝的希望」解釋了觀眾提早離開的原因。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: If the referee hadn't called that unfair foul, the game would have gone into overtime.
options: A. 如果裁判沒有吹哨，比賽早就結束了。
B. 如果裁判沒有判那個不公平的犯規，比賽就會進入延長賽。
C. 如果裁判吹了犯規，比賽就會暫停。
D. 如果裁判公平判決，我們就不會進入延長賽。
normal.explain: 英文原句：If the referee hadn't called that unfair foul, the game would have gone into overtime.（如果裁判沒有判那個不公平的犯規，比賽就會進入延長賽。）referee 為裁判，overtime 為延長賽。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: The analyst stated that the home team had outplayed their rivals in every aspect.
options: A. The home is very comfortable.
B. I don't know how to play the piano.
C. Yeah, they were dominant in both speed and teamwork.
D. They lost the game by 10 points.
normal.explain: 英文原句：The analyst stated that the home team had outplayed their rivals in every aspect.（分析師表示主場球隊在各個方面都勝過了對手。）選項 C「對，他們在速度和團隊合作上都佔據主導」最符合語境。

normal.desc: 【時態】The hospital ___ the new diagnostic software before the ethical board officially approved it.
options: A. installs
B. had installed
C. has installed
D. is installing
normal.explain: 正確答案是 B。句意：在道德委員會正式批准之前，醫院已經安裝了新的診斷軟體。描述在過去某個時間點（approved）之前就已經發生的動作，必須使用過去完成式（had + p.p.）。選項 A、C、D 時態皆不合乎語境。

normal.desc: 【假設語氣】If the researchers had asked for patient consent, the genetic study ___ so much public outrage.
options: A. will not cause
B. did not cause
C. would not have caused
D. had not caused
normal.explain: 正確答案是 C。句意：如果研究人員有徵求病患同意，這項基因研究就不會引起這麼多公眾憤怒。這是與過去事實相反的第三類條件句（If + 過去完成式, 主詞 + would/could/might have + p.p.），因此選 C。

normal.desc: 【間接引語】The surgeon firmly stated that the robotic arm ___ the precision of complex operations the previous year.
options: A. improves
B. had improved
C. is improving
D. will improve
normal.explain: 正確答案是 B。句意：外科醫生堅定地表示，機械手臂在前一年已經提升了複雜手術的精準度。原話是過去式（improved），轉為間接引語且有 the previous year，時態須退一步變為過去完成式（had improved）。

normal.desc: 【字彙】Doctors must always obtain written ___ from patients before performing any experimental procedures.
options: A. fiction
B. sorrow
C. penalty
D. CONSENT
normal.explain: 正確答案是 D (同意)。句意：醫生在進行任何實驗性程序之前，必須始終取得病患的書面同意。選項 A (虛構小說)、B (悲傷)、C (懲罰) 皆不符合醫療程序的語境。

normal.desc: 【假設語氣】If local governments ___ the number of visitors, the ancient ruins would not suffer from rapid deterioration.
options: A. limited
B. limit
C. will limit
D. have limited
normal.explain: 正確答案是 A。句意：如果地方政府限制遊客數量，古老遺跡就不會遭受快速惡化。主要子句使用了 would not suffer，可知這是與現在事實相反的第二類條件句，If 子句動詞應使用過去式，故選 A。

normal.desc: 【時態】By the time the preservation society intervened, the historic market ___ into a modern shopping mall.
options: A. turns
B. had turned
C. is turning
D. will turn
normal.explain: 正確答案是 B。句意：在保護協會介入之前，這個具歷史意義的市場已經變成了一個現代購物中心。By the time 引導的子句使用過去式（intervened），表示另一個動作在過去這個時間點之前已完成，需用過去完成式。

normal.desc: 【字彙】The village is famous for its ___ crafts, which have been made using the same techniques for centuries.
options: A. desperate
B. careless
C. AUTHENTIC
D. artificial
normal.explain: 正確答案是 C (道地的 / 真實的)。句意：這個村莊以其道地的工藝品聞名，這些工藝品幾個世紀以來一直使用相同的技術製作。選項 A (絕望的)、B (粗心的)、D (人造的) 皆不符文意。

normal.desc: 【間接引語】The HR director mentioned that they ___ a new policy to support working parents the month before.
options: A. introduce
B. had introduced
C. have introduced
D. will introduce
normal.explain: 正確答案是 B。句意：人資主管提到他們在前一個月已經推出了一項支持職場父母的新政策。間接引語中提到 the month before，代表該動作發生在 mentioned 之前，必須使用過去完成式。

normal.desc: 【字彙】The company is trying to remove invisible barriers so that no minority group feels ___ in the workplace.
options: A. decorated
B. EXCLUDED
C. infected
D. cooked
normal.explain: 正確答案是 B (被排除在外的)。句意：公司正試圖消除無形的障礙，以便沒有任何少數群體在職場中感到被排斥。選項 A (被裝飾的)、C (被感染的)、D (被煮熟的) 都不符合職場多元包容的語境。

normal.desc: 【假設語氣】If the recruitment team had used blind resumes, they ___ more female candidates for the engineering roles.
options: A. would have hired
B. will hire
C. hire
D. hired
normal.explain: 正確答案是 A。句意：如果招募團隊使用了盲審履歷，他們就會聘用更多女性候選人來擔任工程職位。這是第三類條件句（與過去事實相反），主要子句應使用 would have + p.p.。

normal.desc: 【時態】Many islanders ___ their homes long before the ocean levels officially covered the coastal roads.
options: A. had abandoned
B. are abandoning
C. have abandoned
D. abandon
normal.explain: 正確答案是 A。句意：早在海平面正式淹沒沿海道路之前，許多島民就已經放棄了他們的家園。在過去某事件（covered）之前早已發生的動作，需使用過去完成式。

normal.desc: 【字彙】After the devastating hurricane, thousands of residents were forced to ___ to safer inland territories.
options: A. predict
B. entertain
C. translate
D. RELOCATE
normal.explain: 正確答案是 D (搬遷)。句意：在毀滅性的颶風之後，成千上萬的居民被迫搬遷到更安全的內陸地區。選項 A (預測)、B (娛樂)、C (翻譯) 語意完全不符。

normal.desc: 【假設語氣】If the wealthy nations ___ more funding, fewer families would be displaced by extreme weather.
options: A. provided
B. provide
C. will provide
D. providing
normal.explain: 正確答案是 A。句意：如果富裕國家提供更多資金，因極端天氣而流離失所的家庭就會減少。主要子句使用了 would be displaced，表明這是與現在事實相反的第二類條件句，條件句動詞應使用過去式 provided。

normal.desc: 【間接引語】The producer complained that the lead singer ___ to sign the new contract during their last meeting.
options: A. refuses
B. is refusing
C. had refused
D. will refuse
normal.explain: 正確答案是 C。句意：製作人抱怨主唱在他們上次會議中拒絕簽署新合約。主句動詞為過去式 complained，且動作發生在上次會議，故子句時態需退一步使用過去完成式 had refused。

normal.desc: 【字彙】The independent artist decided to pull her albums from the ___ platform because the payout rates were too low.
options: A. boiling
B. STREAMING
C. chewing
D. farming
normal.explain: 正確答案是 B (串流)。句意：這位獨立藝術家決定將她的專輯從串流平台上撤下，因為分潤率太低了。選項 A (沸騰的)、C (咀嚼的)、D (耕作的) 在此不具意義。

normal.desc: 【假設語氣】If the band had known about the acoustic problems, they ___ that specific stadium for their reunion tour.
options: A. won't choose
B. didn't choose
C. don't choose
D. wouldn't have chosen
normal.explain: 正確答案是 D。句意：如果樂團早知道有音響問題，他們就不會選擇那個特定的體育場來進行重聚巡迴演唱會。第三類條件句中，主要子句需使用 would(n't) have + p.p.。

normal.desc: 【字彙】Scientists are currently trying to ___ exactly how the human brain processes artificial visual signals.
options: A. COMPREHEND
B. swim
C. bake
D. fold
normal.explain: 正確答案是 A (理解 / 領悟)。句意：科學家目前正試圖確切理解人類大腦如何處理人造視覺訊號。選項 B (游泳)、C (烘烤)、D (摺疊) 完全無關。

normal.desc: 【字彙】The newly elected mayor promised to protect the region's cultural ___ from being destroyed by mass tourism.
options: A. luggage
B. garbage
C. envelope
D. HERITAGE
normal.explain: 正確答案是 D (遺產 / 傳統)。句意：新當選的市長承諾要保護該地區的文化遺產，以免被大眾旅遊業破壞。cultural heritage（文化遺產）是常見的固定搭配搭配。

normal.desc: 【時態】She ___ an inclusive design approach long before it became a standard requirement in the tech industry.
options: A. champions
B. is championing
C. had championed
D. will champion
normal.explain: 正確答案是 C。句意：早在包容性設計成為科技業標準要求之前，她就已經在提倡這種方法了。表示在過去某事（became）之前已經持續或完成的動作，使用過去完成式。

normal.desc: 【間接引語】The activist warned the crowd that global warming ___ a severe threat to global agriculture for decades.
options: A. poses
B. had posed
C. is posing
D. will pose
normal.explain: 正確答案是 B。句意：社運人士警告群眾，幾十年來全球暖化已經對全球農業構成嚴重威脅。直接引語中原為現在完成式 (has posed)，轉為間接引語後需退一步成為過去完成式。

normal.desc: 【對話-時態】A: "Did the patients read the privacy agreement before the trial?" B: "Yes, the nurses made sure everyone ___ the document before any medical data was collected."
options: A. signed
B. signs
C. is signing
D. had signed
normal.explain: 正確答案是 D。對話情境：在收集醫療數據（was collected）之前，護士確保每個人都「已經」簽署了文件。發生在過去動作之前的過去動作，要用過去完成式。

normal.desc: 【對話-間接引語】A: "What did the local guide say about the sacred temple?" B: "He explained that his ancestors ___ the stone structure over four hundred years ago."
options: A. had built
B. built
C. build
D. are building
normal.explain: 正確答案是 A。對話情境中 B 轉述導遊的話。導遊原話應為過去式（built），經 He explained that 轉為間接引語，時態退一步變為過去完成式 had built。

normal.desc: 【對話-假設】A: "It's a pity that John didn't get the promotion." B: "I know. If he had shown more cultural awareness during the interview, the board ___ him."
options: A. selects
B. will select
C. would have selected
D. had selected
normal.explain: 正確答案是 C。句意：如果約翰面試時展現更多文化意識，董事會就會選他了。這是在討論已經發生、無法改變的過去情況（第三類條件句），因此主要子句要用 would have + p.p.。

normal.desc: 【字彙】Due to the rising sea levels, the government must build stronger physical ___ to protect the low-lying coastal cities from regular flooding.
options: A. theories
B. BARRIERS
C. menus
D. pockets
normal.explain: 正確答案是 B (障礙物 / 屏障)。句意：由於海平面上升，政府必須建造更堅固的物理屏障，以保護低窪沿海城市免受經常性洪水的侵襲。選項 A (理論)、C (菜單) 皆不合邏輯。

normal.desc: 【對話-假設】A: "Independent musicians hardly make a living these days." B: "True. If streaming services ___ a fairer percentage of their revenue, these artists wouldn't struggle so much."
options: A. pay
B. have paid
C. will pay
D. paid
normal.explain: 正確答案是 D。對話在討論當下音樂產業的現況（與現在事實相反的假設）。主要子句使用 wouldn't struggle，表示這是第二類條件句，條件句動詞應使用過去式 paid。

normal.desc: 【字彙】The new wearable device can continuously monitor your heart rate and instantly ___ you if it detects any dangerous irregular beats.
options: A. ALERT
B. suspect
C. forgive
D. comfort
normal.explain: 正確答案是 A (警示 / 發出警報)。句意：這款新的穿戴式裝置可持續監測您的心率，如果檢測到危險的不規律跳動，會立即向您發出警示。選項 B (懷疑)、C (原諒)、D (安慰) 不符合科技裝置的功能。

normal.desc: 【時態】The island's unique dialect ___ entirely before the linguistics department launched a massive digital recording project to save it.
options: A. had almost disappeared
B. almost disappears
C. will almost disappear
D. is almost disappearing
normal.explain: 正確答案是 A。句意：在語言學系啟動大型數位錄音計畫拯救它之前，這個島嶼獨特的方言幾乎已經完全消失了。在過去動作 (launched) 之前發生的事情需用過去完成式。

normal.desc: 【字彙】To ensure fairness, the manager decided to ___ the current bonus structure so that part-time employees could also receive holiday rewards.
options: A. steal
B. bury
C. paint
D. REVISE
normal.explain: 正確答案是 D (修訂 / 修改)。句意：為確保公平，經理決定修訂目前的獎金結構，讓兼職員工也能獲得節日獎勵。選項 A (偷竊)、B (埋葬) 在此不具意義。

normal.desc: 【對話-間接引語】A: "Did the weather anchor mention the upcoming storm?" B: "Yes, she warned that the typhoon ___ its direction unexpectedly the night before."
options: A. changes
B. had changed
C. will change
D. has changed
normal.explain: 正確答案是 B。句意：主播警告說颱風在前一晚出乎意料地改變了方向。間接引語搭配 the night before，表示動作發生在報導的更早之前，需用過去完成式。

normal.desc: 【字彙】The entertainment agency signed an ___ contract with the young composer, meaning he cannot write songs for any other companies.
options: A. obvious
B. polite
C. EXCLUSIVE
D. casual
normal.explain: 正確答案是 C (獨家的 / 排他的)。句意：娛樂經紀公司與這位年輕作曲家簽署了獨家合約，意味著他不能為任何其他公司寫歌。exclusive contract 意為獨家合約。

normal.desc: 【短文-推論】TechMed Weekly: Integrating AI into patient care is revolutionary but risky. A recent incident revealed that an algorithm had misdiagnosed a rare skin disease because its training data was largely based on a single ethnic group. If developers had included diverse skin tones, this error would have been completely avoided. Q: What does the article suggest about the AI's training data?
options: A. It lacked racial diversity.
B. It was too expensive to collect.
C. It was manually deleted by mistake.
D. It contained too many rare diseases.
normal.explain: 正確答案是 A (它缺乏種族多樣性)。文章指出演算法誤診是因為其訓練數據大多基於「單一族群」(a single ethnic group)，並提到如果包含多樣膚色就能避免錯誤，推論出數據缺乏種族多樣性。

normal.desc: 【短文-細節】Travel Notice: Visitors to the historical village must park their vehicles outside the main gates. The council announced last month that they had banned all cars in the central plaza to reduce pollution and preserve the fragile cobblestone streets. Q: Why are cars banned in the central plaza?
options: A. To create more space for restaurants.
B. To encourage people to buy new bicycles.
C. To lower the parking fees for tourists.
D. To prevent damage to the old streets.
normal.explain: 正確答案是 D。短文明確寫出禁止車輛是為了「減少污染並保護脆弱的鵝卵石街道 (reduce pollution and preserve the fragile cobblestone streets)」，選項 D 完美對應 preserve (保護/防止損壞)。

normal.desc: 【短文-主旨】Internal Email: We are launching a new mentorship initiative next quarter. Our goal is to connect junior female employees with senior executives. By the time we conducted our annual review, we had realized that female staff lacked adequate guidance for climbing the corporate ladder. Q: What is the main purpose of the new initiative?
options: A. To decrease the salaries of senior executives.
B. To help female employees advance their careers.
C. To change the annual review schedule.
D. To hire more male junior staff.
normal.explain: 正確答案是 B。信件指出這個新的導師計畫旨在連結初階女性員工與高階主管，因為他們發現女性員工缺乏晉升（climbing the corporate ladder）的足夠指導。因此目的是幫助她們的職涯發展。

normal.desc: 【短文-語法】Global News: The small Pacific nation is facing an existential crisis. The prime minister stated during the summit that his people ___ completely their ancestral homes before the international community finally offered financial assistance. Q: Which phrase best fills in the blank?
options: A. will lose
B. lose
C. had lost
D. are losing
normal.explain: 正確答案是 C。間接引語中描述在國際社會提供援助（過去式 offered）之前，他的島民「已經」失去了祖傳家園。過去的過去需使用過去完成式 had lost。

normal.desc: 【短文-細節】Music Biz: Live concerts are becoming increasingly expensive to produce. A famous tour manager noted that if fans understood the massive costs of transporting stage equipment globally, they would not complain so bitterly about the rising ticket prices. Q: According to the tour manager, what contributes to the high ticket prices?
options: A. The cost of moving equipment around the world.
B. The salaries of the background dancers.
C. The high taxes imposed by local governments.
D. The price of printing physical concert tickets.
normal.explain: 正確答案是 A。巡演經理提到，如果粉絲了解「在全球運輸舞台設備的龐大成本 (massive costs of transporting stage equipment globally)」，他們就不會對票價抱怨。因此高票價來自運輸設備的成本。

normal.desc: 【短文-字彙】Medical Ethics Forum: Gene-editing tools like CRISPR offer immense medical potential. However, doctors must ensure that they do not ___ patient DNA for non-medical enhancements, such as changing a child's eye color or physical height. Q: Which word best fills in the blank?
options: A. swallow
B. polish
C. rescue
D. MANIPULATE
normal.explain: 正確答案是 D (操縱)。句意：醫生必須確保他們不會為了非醫療的增強目的（如改變眼睛顏色）去操縱病患的DNA。選項 A (吞嚥)、B (擦亮) 皆不符合科技與倫理的語意。

normal.desc: 【短文-推論】Eco-Travel Blog: Swimming with wild dolphins might seem magical, but it is often harmful to the animals. The marine biologist warned yesterday that frequent human interaction had disrupted the dolphins' natural feeding habits, leading to severe malnutrition in the local pod. Q: What is the blog's attitude toward swimming with wild dolphins?
options: A. It is a highly recommended tourist activity.
B. It can negatively impact the dolphins' health.
C. It is beneficial for the dolphins' diet.
D. It should be heavily taxed by the government.
normal.explain: 正確答案是 B。文章指出這種行為通常對動物有害，且海洋生物學家警告這會擾亂海豚的進食習慣導致營養不良。由此可知文章認為這會對海豚的健康產生負面影響。

normal.desc: 【短文-語法】HR Bulletin: We are committed to creating an accessible workplace. If the building administration ___ wheelchair ramps at all main entrances five years ago, our physically disabled colleagues wouldn't have struggled so much during the fire drill. Q: Which phrase best fills in the blank?
options: A. builds
B. will build
C. had built
D. is building
normal.explain: 正確答案是 C。短文討論五年前未能做到的事導致後來的結果，屬於與過去事實相反的第三類條件句。If 子句的動詞必須是過去完成式 (had built)。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
options: A. 史無前例的爭議
B. 完美的解決方案
C. 預料中的失敗
D. 傳統的慶典
boss.explain: An unprecedented controversy 意思是「史無前例的爭議」。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
options: A. 隨意的承諾
B. 至關重要的義務
C. 昂貴的禮物
D. 可選擇的任務
boss.explain: A vital obligation 意思是「至關重要的義務」。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
options: A. 正在緩慢退步
B. 毫無變化
C. 已經有了實質的改善
D. 需要重新評估
boss.explain: Had substantially improved 意思是「已經有了實質的改善」。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
options: A. 絕對是違法的
B. 沒人會同意
C. 現在是正確的
D. 本來會是名正言順的
boss.explain: Would have been justified 意思是「本來會是名正言順的/有正當理由的」。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
options: A. 一個樂觀的前景
B. 一個悲慘的過去
C. 一個危險的信號
D. 一個複雜的規則
boss.explain: An optimistic prospect 意思是「一個樂觀的前景」。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: Had they not intervened, the casualty rate would have doubled.
options: A. 因為他們介入了，所以傷亡率翻倍了。
B. 要是他們沒有介入，傷亡率就會翻倍。
C. 他們正準備介入，以免傷亡率翻倍。
D. 即使他們介入，傷亡率還是會翻倍。
boss.explain: 原句：Had they not intervened, the casualty rate would have doubled.（等於 If they had not intervened...），意思是「要是他們沒有介入，傷亡率就會翻倍」。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The researcher claimed that empirical evidence had refuted the hypothesis.
options: A. 研究人員認為這個假設不需要證據。
B. 實證證據證明了這個假設是正確的。
C. 研究人員聲稱實證證據已經反駁了該假設。
D. 這個假設將在未來產生實證證據。
boss.explain: 原句：The researcher claimed that empirical evidence had refuted the hypothesis. 意思是「研究人員聲稱實證證據已經反駁了該假設」。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: If the new policy were implemented, it would restrict our freedom.
options: A. 新政策已經實施，我們失去了自由。
B. 為了獲得自由，我們必須實施新政策。
C. 我們不應該討論會限制自由的新政策。
D. 如果實施新政策，它將限制我們的自由。
boss.explain: 原句：If the new policy were implemented, it would restrict our freedom. 意思是「如果實施新政策，它將限制我們的自由」（與現在/未來事實相反的假設）。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: Had you realized the severity of the allegation, would you have acted differently?
options: A. Yes, I would have hired a lawyer immediately.
B. No, I will do the same thing tomorrow.
C. Yes, I realize it is very serious now.
D. No, I am not acting differently today.
boss.explain: 原句：Had you realized the severity of the allegation, would you have acted differently?（要是你當時了解到指控的嚴重性，你的作法會不同嗎？）回應 A「是的，我本來會立刻請律師」符合倒裝句型的假設語氣。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: What was her perspective on the new structural framework?
options: A. She will tell us tomorrow morning.
B. She mentioned that it had provided great insights.
C. She is thinking about the new framework.
D. She wants to build a new house.
boss.explain: 原句：What was her perspective on the new structural framework?（她對新的結構框架有什麼看法？）回應 B「她提到這提供了很棒的見解」使用了間接引語與過去完成式。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: If the tour guide hadn't lost the map, would we be lost now?
options: A. Yes, we had been lost yesterday.
B. No, we will buy a new map.
C. No, we would be enjoying the picturesque village by now.
D. Yes, the tour guide is very friendly.
boss.explain: 原句：If the tour guide hadn't lost the map, would we be lost now?（如果導遊當初沒弄丟地圖，我們現在會迷路嗎？）此為混合條件句，回應 C「不，我們現在應該正在欣賞如畫的村莊」最合理。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: Did the manager explain why he was so reluctant to approve the budget?
options: A. He will approve it as soon as possible.
B. He doesn't like to spend too much money.
C. He is looking at the financial report right now.
D. He said that he had noticed some serious financial risks.
boss.explain: 原句：Did the manager explain why he was so reluctant to approve the budget?（經理有解釋他為什麼這麼不情願批准預算嗎？）回應 D「他說他注意到了一些嚴重的財務風險」完美結合間接引語及過去完成式。

boss.desc: 【間接引語】The consultant emphasized that the new policies ___ mandatory for all staff members moving forward.
options: A. were
B. are being
C. have been
D. will have been
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：主詞動詞 emphasized 為過去式，名詞子句配合時態一致原則應退回過去式 were。

boss.desc: 【時態】Hardly ___ the office when it started pouring rain outside.
options: A. I had left
B. had I left
C. I left
D. did I leave
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：否定副詞 Hardly 置於句首時需倒裝，且搭配過去完成式表示「一...就...」，故選 had I left。

boss.desc: 【假設語氣】But for their expert guidance, our team ___ the ambitious project on time.
options: A. couldn't complete
B. can't complete
C. wouldn't have completed
D. wouldn't complete
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：But for (要不是) 帶出與過去事實相反的假設，主要子句應使用 would/could not have + 過去分詞。

boss.desc: 【時態與語氣】She admitted she ___ the warning signs prior to the system crash, but had chosen to ignore them.
options: A. notices
B. has noticed
C. was noticing
D. had noticed
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：在系統崩潰（the system crash）之前就已經注意到警告標誌，必須使用過去完成式 had noticed。

boss.desc: 【字彙】The CEO expects managers to ___ conflict resolution effectively rather than ignoring underlying tensions.
options: A. initiate
B. facilitate
C. hesitate
D. duplicate
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：facilitate 意為「促進；使便利」，此處指經理應積極促成衝突的解決。

boss.desc: 【短文】A leading tech firm announced a drastic shift in its operations. The spokesperson stated that they had completely redesigned their algorithm to prioritize ethical content. If they hadn't faced public backlash last year, they probably wouldn't have initiated this change. Q: What motivated the firm to redesign its algorithm?
options: A. A desire to maximize profits immediately.
B. Negative reactions from the public in the past.
C. A sudden decrease in user engagement.
D. Government regulations imposed this year.
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：短文中的假設語氣「如果去年沒有面臨大眾強烈反彈（public backlash），他們就不會開始這項變革」，指出原因在於過去大眾的負面反應。

boss.desc: 【短文】In his memoir, the diplomat recalled a tense negotiation. He wrote that if the opposing leader had not shown a willingness to compromise, the peace talks would have collapsed. He also noted that he had prepared extensively for the meeting. Q: What prevented the peace talks from failing?
options: A. The extensive preparation of the diplomat.
B. The opposing leader's readiness to make concessions.
C. The intervention of third-party nations.
D. The strict demands of the diplomat.
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：文中提及若非對方領袖展現 willingness to compromise（妥協意願），和談就會破裂，即對方願意讓步阻止了失敗。concessions 與 compromise 意義相近。

boss.desc: 【短文】Market trends often fluctuate wildly. Last week, an analyst predicted that renewable energy stocks would surge. He explained that investors had grown wary of fossil fuels long before the recent climate summit. Q: What did the analyst say about investors' attitude towards fossil fuels?
options: A. They became concerned only after the climate summit.
B. They had lost interest in fossil fuels before the summit.
C. They consider fossil fuels a safe and growing investment.
D. They want to invest heavily in both sectors evenly.
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：文中指投資者在氣候高峰會前很久（long before）就已對化石燃料感到謹慎/擔憂（grown wary of），故選 B。

boss.desc: 【短文】Subject: Mentorship Program. Hi all, if we were to launch the mentorship program next month, we would need at least twenty senior staff to volunteer. The HR director mentioned yesterday that she had only received five applications so far. Q: What is the current status of the mentorship program?
options: A. It has already successfully launched.
B. It has attracted too many volunteers.
C. It lacks the required number of senior volunteers.
D. It was canceled by the HR director yesterday.
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：需要20名志工，但HR總監說目前只收到5份申請（had only received five applications），表示志工數量不足。

boss.desc: 【短文】The documentary highlights how urban areas can integrate green spaces. The narrator claimed that if city planners considered biodiversity during the design phase, cities would become more sustainable. He argued that they had historically prioritized concrete over nature. Q: What criticism does the narrator have regarding past city planners?
options: A. They focused too much on building with concrete.
B. They spent too much money on green spaces.
C. They integrated too many diverse species.
D. They completely ignored the design phase.
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：文中指出過去的規劃者「historically prioritized concrete over nature」（歷史上優先考慮水泥而非自然），故選 A。

boss.desc: 【短文】During the performance review, Sarah was told that her communication skills were excellent. However, her manager pointed out that if she delegated tasks more often, she wouldn't suffer from burnout. Sarah admitted she had always struggled to trust others with critical work. Q: What is Sarah's main issue according to the text?
options: A. She lacks the ability to communicate clearly.
B. She hesitates to assign important tasks to others.
C. She delegates too much work to her team.
D. She ignores her manager's direct orders.
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：經理建議她多委派任務（delegate），且她承認很難將重要工作交給他人（struggled to trust others with critical work），故選 B。

boss.desc: 【短文】When asked about the sudden delay, the spokesperson insisted that the logistics team had prepared everything properly. The delay, he explained, was due to unpredictable weather patterns. If the weather had remained stable, the shipment would have arrived on Tuesday. Q: Why was the shipment delayed?
options: A. The logistics team made a significant error.
B. The weather was unexpectedly bad.

boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：發言人說延遲是因為 unpredictable weather patterns（不可預測的天氣型態），且若天氣穩定原本週二就會抵達，故選 B。

【時態與語態】The new cognitive tests ___ to the students before the researchers realized there was a flaw in the design.
options: A. administered
B. were administering
C. had been administered
D. have administered
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：正確答案是 C。本題考查過去完成式的被動語態 (had been + p.p.)。認知測驗是被施測的，且動作發生在研究人員「意識到 (realized)」之前，故須同時具備過去完成式與被動語態的結構。

boss.desc: 【假設語氣】If the local government had invested in infrastructure earlier, the recent flood damage ___ much less severe.
options: A. is
B. will be
C. was
D. would have been
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：正確答案是 D。此為第三類條件句，描述與過去事實相反的假設。If 子句用 had invested (過去完成式)，主要子句對應的動詞型態必須是 would have + p.p. (would have been)。

boss.desc: 【間接引語】The politician firmly denied that he ___ the public data to win the re-election.
options: A. had manipulated
B. manipulates
C. is manipulating
D. has manipulated
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：正確答案是 A。句中的 denied (否認) 為過去式，所否認的「操縱數據」這件事發生在更早的過去，因此後方的子句必須使用過去完成式 (had manipulated)。

boss.desc: 【字彙】The ___ marketing strategy caused the company's stock to fluctuate rapidly, making investors very anxious.
options: A. affordable
B. deceptive
C. cognitive
D. resilient
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：正確答案是 B (欺騙的)。句意為「這種欺騙性的行銷策略導致公司股票劇烈波動，讓投資人十分焦慮」。A為負擔得起的，C為認知的，D為有韌性的，皆不符合句意邏輯。

boss.desc: 【對話-時態】A: 「Did you manage to secure a credible source for the article?」 B: 「Yes, but only after I ___ three other anonymous informants.」
options: A. interview
B. was interviewing
C. had interviewed
D. have interviewed
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：正確答案是 C。B回覆說「是的，但這是在我訪問了其他三名匿名線人之後」，因為「成功取得可靠消息來源 (manage to secure)」已是過去式，所以在這之前發生的訪問動作必須使用過去完成式 (had interviewed)。

boss.desc: 【對話-假設】A: 「The curriculum reform is facing a lot of backlash.」 B: 「If they had consulted the teachers first, they ___ this much resistance.」
options: A. won't face
B. don't face
C. wouldn't face
D. wouldn't have faced
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：正確答案是 D。If 子句為 had consulted (過去完成式)，這是一個與過去事實相反的假設，因此主要子句必須使用 would/could/might + have + p.p. 的形式，即 wouldn't have faced。

boss.desc: 【對話-間接引語】A: 「Will the residential density increase next year?」 B: 「The journalist asked the planner if the residential density ___ the following year.」
options: A. would increase
B. will increase
C. increases
D. had increased
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：正確答案是 A。當引述句為過去式 asked 時，原本句子中的未來式 will 必須往後退一步，變成過去未來式 would。B為現在未來式，C為現在式，D為過去完成式，皆錯誤。

boss.desc: 【字彙】To help citizens better ___ the complex tax policies, the government launched a simplified interactive website.
options: A. subsidize
B. comprehend
C. fluctuate
D. commute
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：正確答案是 B (理解)。句意為「為了幫助市民更好地理解複雜的稅收政策，政府推出了一個簡化的互動網站」。A為補助，C為波動，D為通勤，皆不符合語境。

boss.desc: 【短文-推論】Economics Blog: By the time the central bank raised interest rates, the inflation rate had already reached a ten-year high. Critics argued that if the bank had acted two months earlier, consumer expenditure wouldn't have shrunk so drastically. Q: What is the main criticism against the central bank?
options: A. They ignored the inflation data completely.
B. They should have subsidized consumer expenditure.
C. They acted too late to prevent a severe drop in spending.
D. They raised interest rates too high.
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：正確答案是 C。文中批評者指出「如果央行早兩個月行動，消費者支出就不會嚴重縮水」，言下之意就是央行行動得太晚 (acted too late)，導致了支出的劇烈下降。

boss.desc: 【短文-細節】Urban Daily: The transit authority announced that they had finally secured the budget for the new railway. The director noted that if the funds hadn't been delayed by political debates, commuters would be enjoying the new amenity right now. Q: Why aren't commuters using the new railway yet?
options: A. The budget was rejected by the director.
B. Commuters prefer driving their own cars.
C. The construction has been completed early.
D. The funds were delayed by political debates.
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：正確答案是 D。文中的假設語氣「如果資金沒有被政治辯論延誤，通勤者現在就能享受到這項新設施」，反面證明了現實情況是「資金被政治辯論延誤了 (funds were delayed by political debates)」。

boss.desc: 【短文-推論】Media Today: In an era of deceptive content, promoting digital literacy is critical. A recent study found that teenagers who had received specialized instruction were better at identifying sensationalized news. The researchers stated that schools must facilitate such programs immediately. Q: What does the study suggest about teenagers?
options: A. They can improve their ability to spot fake news through instruction.
B. They share sensationalized news more than adults do.
C. They are naturally immune to deceptive content.
D. They manipulate digital media for personal gain.
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：正確答案是 A。文中提到「接受過專門指導的青少年更善於辨識聳動的新聞 (better at identifying sensationalized news)」，代表他們的能力是可以透過教導 (instruction) 來提升的。

boss.desc: 【短文-推論】The psychologist emphasized that resilience is not a fixed trait. In his presentation, he explained that if individuals were exposed to manageable stress, they would develop better coping mechanisms. He added that many patients had shown significant improvement after cognitive therapy. Q: According to the psychologist, how can one develop better coping mechanisms?
options: A. By possessing a fixed trait of resilience.
B. By facing manageable amounts of stress.
C. By avoiding all stressful situations.
D. By reading cognitive psychology books.
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：正確答案是 B。演講中提到「如果人們暴露在可控的壓力下 (were exposed to manageable stress)，他們就能發展出更好的應對機制」，這直接對應選項 B。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
options: A. 非常懷疑的
B. 極度自信的
C. 完全贊同的
D. 充滿熱情的
boss.explain: 英文原句：Highly skeptical。highly 意為「高度地」，skeptical 是「懷疑的」。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
options: A. 昂貴的手術
B. 錯誤的處方
C. 徹底的診斷
D. 定期的回診
boss.explain: 英文原句：A thorough diagnosis。thorough 意為「徹底的；詳細的」，diagnosis 為「診斷」。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
options: A. 發表學位論文
B. 參加學術研討
C. 申請研究經費
D. 取消畢業演講
boss.explain: 英文原句：Publish a dissertation。publish 為「發表；出版」，dissertation 為「學位論文」。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
options: A. 失敗的計畫
B. 模糊的記憶
C. 準確的預測
D. 虛假的報告
boss.explain: 英文原句：An accurate projection。accurate 是「準確的」，projection 指「預測；推測」。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: Had they amended the rules, the issue would have been solved.
options: A. 因為他們修改了規則，所以問題解決了。
B. 他們雖然修改了規則，但問題還是沒解決。
C. 如果他們未來修改規則，問題就能解決。
D. 如果他們當時修改了規則，問題就已經解決了。
boss.explain: 英文原句：Had they amended the rules, the issue would have been solved. 這是省略 If 的第三類假設語氣倒裝句，代表當時並未修改規則，問題也沒解決。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: If the curriculum were updated, students would be more engaged.
options: A. 學生們已經對更新後的課程內容很投入。
B. 除非學生投入，否則課程內容不會更新。
C. 課程已經被更新，因為學生不夠投入。
D. 如果課程內容更新，學生們會更投入。
boss.explain: 英文原句：If the curriculum were updated, students would be more engaged. 這是與現在事實相反的假設語氣，表達對未來的期望或條件假設。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: If the projection had been accurate, we wouldn't face this deficit.
options: A. 預測很準確，所以我們沒有面臨虧損。
B. 如果當時預測準確，我們現在就不會面臨這個虧損。
C. 即使預測準確，我們還是會面臨嚴重的虧損。
D. 我們面臨虧損，是因為我們沒有做任何預測。
boss.explain: 英文原句：If the projection had been accurate, we wouldn't face this deficit. 錯綜時間條件句：如果「過去」預測準確，我們「現在」就不會面臨虧損。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: If the faculty had voted, the changes would have taken effect.
options: A. 全體教職員已經投票，所以變更生效了。
B. 全體教職員不想投票，但變更還是生效了。
C. 如果當時全體教職員投票，變更就會生效了。
D. 即使全體教職員投票，變更也不會生效。
boss.explain: 英文原句：If the faculty had voted, the changes would have taken effect. 第三類條件句，意指當時並未投票，因此變更沒有生效。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: Had the projection been more realistic, we wouldn't have lost money.
options: A. We will make a lot of money soon.
B. I agree, we should have been less optimistic.
C. The projection is usually very accurate.
D. We didn't lose any money last year.
boss.explain: 英文原句：Had the projection been more realistic, we wouldn't have lost money. (如果預測更實際一點，我們就不會賠錢了。) 選項 B「我同意，我們本來應該少一點樂觀」是正確的回應。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The spokesperson stated that if they had incorporated the feedback, the disaster could have been avoided.
options: A. 他們因為納入了回饋，成功避免了災難。
B. 災難本來無法避免，即使他們納入回饋。
C. 其實他們忽略了回饋，這導致了災難發生。
D. 發言人表示未來會納入回饋來避免災難。
boss.explain: 英文原句：...if they had incorporated the feedback, the disaster could have been avoided. (如果當時納入回饋，這場災難本可避免。) 隱含事實是他們沒有納入回饋，所以發生了災難。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: My colleague mentioned that she would have joined the faculty if the salary had been more attractive.
options: A. 因為薪水很優渥，所以她加入了全體教職員。
B. 她正在猶豫是否要因為高薪加入全體教職員。
C. 如果薪水更低，她就絕對不會加入教職員團隊。
D. 她沒有加入教職員團隊，是因為薪水不夠理想。
boss.explain: 英文原句：...she would have joined the faculty if the salary had been more attractive. 第三類條件句表示過去未發生的事，代表薪水不夠吸引人，所以她沒加入。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The reviewer claimed that he had been highly skeptical until he saw the actual performance.
options: A. 評論家看完實際表演後，變得更加懷疑了。
B. 評論家在看完實際表演後，改變了懷疑的態度。
C. 評論家一直都很懷疑，甚至拒絕去看實際表演。
D. 評論家聲稱他對實際表演的品質完全不懷疑。
boss.explain: 英文原句：...he had been highly skeptical until he saw the actual performance. (直到看見實際表演前，他都抱持高度懷疑。) 意味著看完表演後就不再懷疑了。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: She clarified that if the therapy were viable, she would definitely recommend it to the patients.
options: A. 她已經把這個療法推薦給了病患。
B. 即使療法不可行，她也推薦了它。
C. 她覺得這個療法非常可行，正準備推薦。
D. 她還沒有推薦它，因為她不確定它是否可行。
boss.explain: 英文原句：...if the therapy were viable, she would definitely recommend it... (如果這項療法可行，她絕對會推薦它。) 這是第二類假設語氣，表示目前認為不夠可行或不確定，故尚未推薦。
