🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: The insurer confirmed that they had denied the claim due to a glaring discrepancy in the report.
options: A. The claim was fully approved yesterday.
B. I guess they found some mismatched numbers then.
C. The report has no errors at all.
D. We should file the claim tomorrow.
boss.explain: 英文原句：The insurer confirmed that they had denied the claim due to a glaring discrepancy in the report. 意思：保險公司確認他們因報告中有明顯出入而拒絕了理賠。選項 B「我猜他們當時發現了一些對不上的數字」最適合。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: If the new operating system were truly cutting-edge, it wouldn't make our current hardware obsolete.
options: A. 如果新作業系統是尖端科技，它會讓目前的硬體加速淘汰。
B. 因為新作業系統是尖端的，所以我們的硬體沒有被淘汰。
C. 如果新作業系統真的是尖端科技，它就不會讓我們目前的硬體被淘汰。
D. 即使新作業系統不是尖端科技，我們的硬體依然會過時。
boss.explain: 英文原句：If the new operating system were truly cutting-edge, it wouldn't make our current hardware obsolete. 意思：如果新作業系統真的是尖端科技，它就不會讓我們目前的硬體被淘汰。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: The manager admitted that making those experienced workers redundant had been a critical oversight.
options: A. He will recruit them back next year.
B. The workers were very happy to leave.
C. It was definitely a smart strategic move.
D. Indeed, the team's productivity dropped drastically afterward.
boss.explain: 英文原句：The manager admitted that making those experienced workers redundant had been a critical oversight. 意思：經理承認裁掉那些經驗豐富的員工是一個嚴重的疏忽。選項 D「確實，之後團隊的生產力大幅下降」最為契合。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: If the news coverage were not so biased, the public would have a much clearer understanding of the hazard.
options: A. 如果新聞報導沒有那麼偏頗，大眾對這項危險會有更清晰的了解。
B. 如果大眾對危險有清晰的了解，新聞報導就不會偏頗。
C. 雖然新聞報導有偏見，大眾依然很清楚這項危險。
D. 因為新聞報導沒有偏見，所以大眾很了解這項危險。
boss.explain: 英文原句：If the news coverage were not so biased, the public would have a much clearer understanding of the hazard. 意思：如果新聞報導沒有那麼偏頗，大眾對這項危險會有更清晰的了解。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: I was told that the crisis team had successfully mitigated the environmental hazard before the inspection.
options: A. The inspection was canceled.
B. Yes, they managed to clean up the spill just in time.
C. The environmental hazard is still spreading rapidly.
D. They failed to mitigate anything.
boss.explain: 英文原句：I was told that the crisis team had successfully mitigated the environmental hazard before the inspection. 意思：我聽說危機處理團隊在檢查前已經成功減輕了環境危害。選項 B「是的，他們及時清理了外洩物」最符合情境。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: If the airline had addressed the grievance promptly, the passengers would not have sued for liability.
options: A. 航空公司因為及時處理了申訴，所以乘客沒有提告。
B. 即使航空公司處理了申訴，乘客依然會提告要求負責。
C. 如果航空公司當時及時處理了申訴，乘客就不會提告要求承擔責任了。
D. 如果乘客沒有提告，航空公司就會處理他們的申訴。
boss.explain: 英文原句：If the airline had addressed the grievance promptly, the passengers would not have sued for liability. 意思：如果航空公司當時及時處理了申訴，乘客就不會提告要求承擔責任了。典型的第三條件句結構。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: The journalist claimed that the politician had intentionally leaked the revelation to distract the public.
options: A. The politician never leaks any secrets.
B. The public was completely unaware of the event.
C. The journalist works for the politician.
D. That sounds plausible; it certainly shifted everyone's focus away from his scandal.
boss.explain: 英文原句：The journalist claimed that the politician had intentionally leaked the revelation to distract the public. 意思：記者聲稱該政客故意洩露這項真相以轉移公眾注意力。選項 D「這聽起來很合理；這肯定轉移了大家對他醜聞的注意力」最為契合。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: My advisor told me that if I had showcased my aptitude better, I would have secured the senior role.
options: A. 指導老師說，如果我當時能更好地展現才能，我就能拿到那個高階職位了。
B. 指導老師說我如果繼續展現才能，未來就能獲得升遷。
C. 指導老師覺得我目前的表現，已經足以勝任這個高階職位。
D. 如果我沒有展現才能，指導老師就不會推薦我擔任那個職位。
boss.explain: 英文原句：My advisor told me that if I had showcased my aptitude better, I would have secured the senior role. 意思：指導老師說，如果我當時能更好地展現才能，我就能拿到那個高階職位了。結合間接引語與第三條件句。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: If the central server had been less vulnerable, the hackers would not have caused such a massive disruption.
options: A. The hackers are attacking the server now.
B. We definitely learned a hard lesson about cybersecurity that day.
C. The server is completely secure and invincible.
D. The disruption will happen tomorrow.
boss.explain: 英文原句：If the central server had been less vulnerable, the hackers would not have caused such a massive disruption. 意思：如果中央伺服器當時沒那麼脆弱，駭客就不會造成如此大規模的癱瘓。選項 B「那天我們確實在網路安全上學到了慘痛的教訓」最適合。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: Had they implemented the contingency measures earlier, the tourists would not have been stranded on the island.
options: A. 他們很早就實施了應急措施，所以遊客沒有受困。
B. 如果遊客沒有受困在島上，他們就不會實施應急措施。
C. 如果他們當時早點實施應急措施，遊客就不會受困在島上了。
D. 即使實施了應急措施，遊客依然受困在島上。
boss.explain: 英文原句：Had they implemented the contingency measures earlier, the tourists would not have been stranded on the island. 意思：如果他們當時早點實施應急措施，遊客就不會受困在島上了。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: She inquired whether the newly launched prototype was fully compatible with the company's legacy software.
options: A. The legacy software was deleted completely.
B. She has already bought the legacy software.
C. The prototype is not ready yet.
D. I told her that our engineering team was still testing the integration.
boss.explain: 英文原句：She inquired whether the newly launched prototype was fully compatible with the company's legacy software. 意思：她詢問新推出的原型是否與公司的舊版軟體完全相容。選項 D「我告訴她我們的工程團隊還在測試整合狀況」是最自然的回應。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The spokesperson clarified that the company had already rectified the issue before the media speculated about it.
options: A. 發言人澄清公司在媒體揣測之前，就已經糾正了這個問題。
B. 發言人澄清公司是因為媒體的揣測，才開始糾正問題。
C. 發言人表示公司將會在媒體報導前解決這個問題。
D. 發言人說如果媒體沒有揣測，公司就不會糾正問題。
boss.explain: 英文原句：The spokesperson clarified that the company had already rectified the issue before the media speculated about it. 意思：發言人澄清公司在媒體揣測之前，就已經糾正了這個問題。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: If he hadn't taken the necessary precautions, his consecutive mistakes would have eventually cost him his career.
options: A. He lost his job yesterday.
B. It's a good thing he finally started being careful then.
C. He doesn't care about his career at all.
D. Precautions are useless for his mistakes.
boss.explain: 英文原句：If he hadn't taken the necessary precautions, his consecutive mistakes would have eventually cost him his career. 意思：如果他當時沒有採取必要的預防措施，他連續的失誤最終會毀了他的職業生涯。選項 B「還好他後來終於開始小心謹慎了」最為貼切。

boss.desc: 【短文】Email to all staff: 'We understand that working remotely can blur the lines between personal life and duty. Last week, our CEO mentioned that the management had noticed a rising trend in overtime hours. Therefore, a new policy on disconnecting after 6 PM will be introduced.' Q: What did the management notice according to the CEO?
options: A. A decrease in remote workers.
B. A software failure.
C. An increase in overtime hours.
D. A lack of social events.
boss.explain: 【解析】信件中明確寫道「management had noticed a rising trend in overtime hours (管理層注意到加班時數有上升的趨勢)」，故正確答案為 (C)。

boss.desc: 【短文】Remote Work Survey: A recent study on telecommuting revealed surprising facts. Many respondents stated that if they had received proper technical support from their IT departments initially, they would not have experienced so much frustration during the first few months. Q: What caused frustration for the respondents initially?
options: A. Long commute times.
B. Low salary.
C. Too many meetings.
D. Lack of technical support.
boss.explain: 【解析】文中提到「如果一開始有得到適當的技術支援 (had received proper technical support)，就不會經歷這麼多挫折」。這表示最初的挫折來源是缺乏技術支援，選 (D)。

boss.desc: 【短文】Energy Update: To combat climate change, the city council decided to replace all streetlights with solar-powered alternatives. The mayor proudly announced yesterday that the city had reduced its electricity expenses by 20% since the project began. Q: What has the city achieved according to the mayor?
options: A. A 20% reduction in electricity expenses.
B. A ban on all fossil fuels.
C. The invention of new solar panels.
D. A decrease in traffic accidents.
boss.explain: 【解析】市長宣布自從計畫開始後，該城市「had reduced its electricity expenses by 20% (已減少 20% 的電費支出)」，故答案為 (A)。

boss.desc: 【短文】Ecology Blog: Protecting the wetlands is our top priority. An ecologist pointed out that if developers had not drained the northern swamps last decade, the native bird population would not have plummeted so drastically. Action must be taken now. Q: What led to the decline of the native bird population?
options: A. A sudden climate shift.
B. The draining of the northern swamps.
C. The pollution of the local river.
D. An increase in tourists.
boss.explain: 【解析】生態學家指出「如果開發商沒有排乾北部沼澤 (had not drained the northern swamps)，鳥類數量就不會暴跌」。由此推論鳥類減少的原因是排乾了沼澤，選 (B)。

boss.desc: 【短文】Medical News: A new vaccine for the seasonal flu has shown promising results. The lead scientist explained that volunteers who had received the injection exhibited a much stronger immune response compared to the control group. She emphasized the importance of widespread vaccination. Q: What did the volunteers who received the injection show?
options: A. Severe allergic reactions.
B. Symptoms of chronic fatigue.
C. A stronger immune response.
D. A sudden drop in blood pressure.
boss.explain: 【解析】文中提到接受注射的志願者「exhibited a much stronger immune response (展現出強得多的免疫反應)」，與選項 (C) 描述完全相符。

boss.desc: 【短文】Health Magazine: Managing stress is crucial for heart health. A cardiologist noted that if her patients exercised regularly and maintained a balanced diet, their risk of cardiovascular diseases would drop significantly. She advised starting with a simple 30-minute daily walk. Q: How can patients lower their risk of cardiovascular diseases according to the cardiologist?
options: A. By taking expensive medication.
B. By sleeping ten hours a day.
C. By avoiding all outdoor activities.
D. By exercising and eating a balanced diet.
boss.explain: 【解析】心臟科醫生指出「如果病患規律運動並維持均衡飲食 (exercised regularly and maintained a balanced diet)」，罹患心血管疾病的風險就會大幅降低。故選 (D)。

boss.desc: 【短文】Art Review: The new contemporary gallery has sparked mixed reactions. One renowned critic wrote that the artist had captured the essence of modern loneliness perfectly through his abstract sculptures. However, some traditionalists found the pieces confusing. Q: How did the renowned critic feel about the abstract sculptures?
options: A. They captured modern loneliness perfectly.
B. They were confusing and poorly made.
C. They were too expensive to purchase.
D. They copied traditional masterpieces.
boss.explain: 【解析】文中寫道著名評論家認為藝術家「had captured the essence of modern loneliness perfectly (完美捕捉了現代孤獨的本質)」，故選 (A)。覺得令人困惑的是傳統派人士，並非該評論家。

boss.desc: 【短文】Cultural Exhibition: The local museum is hosting a showcase of 19th-century portraits. The curator stated during the opening that if the museum had not secured funding from anonymous donors, they would never have been able to restore these delicate works. Q: What made the restoration of the portraits possible?
options: A. Ticket sales from the previous year.
B. Funding from anonymous donors.
C. Government grants for the arts.
D. Volunteer work from local artists.
boss.explain: 【解析】策展人表示「如果沒有獲得匿名捐贈者的資金 (had not secured funding from anonymous donors)，就永遠無法修復這些作品」，代表是這筆資金讓修復成為可能，選 (B)。

boss.desc: 【短文】Consumer Rights Notice: Be aware of deceptive online subscriptions. The consumer protection agency warned that many users had signed up for free trials, only to be charged hidden monthly fees later because they didn't read the fine print. Q: Why were many users charged hidden fees?
options: A. They lost their credit cards.
B. They bought illegal products.
C. They did not read the fine print.
D. They requested premium services.
boss.explain: 【解析】機構警告許多用戶被收取隱藏費用的原因是「because they didn't read the fine print (因為他們沒有閱讀附帶的附屬細則/小字說明)」，故選 (C)。

boss.desc: 【短文】Legal Brief: A landmark verdict was reached today regarding workplace discrimination. The judge declared that if the company had implemented a fair evaluation system, the dispute would not have escalated into a massive class-action lawsuit. Q: What could have prevented the massive lawsuit?
options: A. Firing the involved employees.
B. Ignoring the complaints entirely.
C. Hiring a more expensive lawyer.
D. Implementing a fair evaluation system.
boss.explain: 【解析】法官聲明「如果公司落實了公平的評估系統 (had implemented a fair evaluation system)，爭議就不會升級為大規模訴訟」。因此公平的評估系統本可防止這場訴訟，選 (D)。

boss.desc: 【短文】Workplace Forum: Remote teams often struggle with cohesion. A team leader shared his experience, stating that his team had struggled with communication until they introduced daily virtual check-ins. Now, everyone feels much more connected. Q: What improved the team's communication?
options: A. Daily virtual check-ins.
B. In-person weekly meetings.
C. A new software update.
D. Firing uncooperative members.
boss.explain: 【解析】團隊領袖分享經驗，提到直到他們「引進了每日虛擬報到/會議 (introduced daily virtual check-ins)」後，溝通才獲得改善，大家覺得更有連結。故選 (A)。

boss.desc: 【短文】Environmental Policy: Last year's emission targets were not met. An analyst argued that if the administration enforced stricter penalties on heavy polluters, corporations would take sustainability much more seriously. Currently, the fines are too low to make an impact. Q: What does the analyst suggest to make corporations take sustainability seriously?
options: A. Offering them financial rewards.
B. Enforcing stricter penalties.
C. Providing free consulting.
D. Ignoring their current emissions.
boss.explain: 【解析】分析師認為「如果政府對重度汙染者執行更嚴格的罰則 (enforced stricter penalties)，企業就會更認真對待永續發展」。因此建議的方法是 (B)。

boss.desc: 請唸出單字：成就
請唸出單字：含意
請唸出單字：有說服力的
請唸出單字：令人印象深刻的
請唸出：表達深深的遺憾
請唸出：總結報告
請唸出：否認指控
請唸出：面對挑戰
請唸出短句：如果他有問我也會同意。
boss.ans: IF HE HAD ASKED I WOULD HAVE AGREED
boss.speak: if he had asked i would have agreed

boss.desc: 請唸出短句：她證實她已經離開公司了。
boss.ans: SHE CONFIRMED SHE HAD LEFT THE COMPANY
boss.speak: she confirmed she had left the company

boss.desc: 請唸出短句：經理說他已經審查過了。
boss.ans: THE MANAGER SAID HE HAD REVIEWED IT
boss.speak: the manager said he had reviewed it

boss.desc: 請唸出短句：他們宣布活動已經結束了。
boss.ans: THEY ANNOUNCED THE EVENT HAD ALREADY ENDED
boss.speak: they announced the event had already ended

boss.desc: 請拼出：資格；條件
填空題：Q U _ L _ F _ C A T I O N (資格；條件)
填空題：O B J _ C T _ V _ (目標；目的)
填空題：P A R T _ C _ P _ N T (參與者)
請拼出：完成；實現
請拼出：不便；麻煩
填空題：I N C _ N V _ N _ E N C E (不便；麻煩)
請拼出：不滿意的
填空題：D _ S S _ T _ S F I E D (不滿意的)
填空題：C R _ T _ C _ S M (批評；評論)
請拼出：推薦；建議
填空題：R E C _ M M _ N D _ T I O N (推薦；建議)
填空題：U N _ C C _ P T _ B L E (不能接受的)
🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The mediator noted that if neither party had harbored such deep-seated resentment, reaching a settlement would have been straightforward.
options: A. 調解員指出，若是雙方沒有懷著如此根深蒂固的怨恨，達成和解本來會很簡單。
B. 調解員認為，因為雙方已經放下了過去的仇恨，所以很快就達成了共識。
C. 調解員抱怨雙方的怨恨太深，導致即使簽了和解書也無法真正解決問題。
D. 調解員表示，只要雙方願意各退一步，未來的談判就能順利進行。
boss.explain: 原句「The mediator noted that if neither party had harbored such deep-seated resentment, reaching a settlement would have been straightforward.」這是一個複雜的第三類條件句，選項 A 完全翻譯出其假設語氣。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: She disclosed to the press that the executive board had deliberately concealed the hazardous working conditions.
options: A. That revelation will surely prompt a government investigation.
B. The working conditions are expected to improve next year.
C. Press conferences are usually held in the main lobby.
D. She works as a safety inspector for the government.
boss.explain: 原句「She disclosed to the press that the executive board had deliberately concealed the hazardous working conditions.」（她向媒體披露董事會故意隱瞞了危險的工作環境）。選項 A「這個爆料肯定會引發政府調查」最符合這個嚴重情況。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: If the central bank were to hike interest rates again, the local housing market would inevitably stagnate.
options: A. 如果央行再次調升利率，當地的房市將不可避免地陷入停滯。
B. 只要央行不調升利率，當地的房市就能夠繼續保持繁榮。
C. 因為央行已經調降了利率，當地的房地產市場正在逐漸復甦。
D. 央行警告，房市的停滯將會導致整體經濟面臨崩潰的危機。
boss.explain: 原句「If the central bank were to hike interest rates again, the local housing market would inevitably stagnate.」這是對未來的假設（were to），選項 A 為正確翻譯。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: He admitted that his inherent prejudice against certain cultures had severely compromised the negotiation process.
options: A. 他承認他對某些文化的固有偏見，嚴重損害了談判過程。
B. 他指責對方因為文化偏見而故意拖延了整個談判的進度。
C. 他認為只要消除文化差異，國際談判的過程就會更加順利。
D. 他否認自己的判斷曾經受到任何文化刻板印象的影響。
boss.explain: 原句「He admitted that his inherent prejudice against certain cultures had severely compromised the negotiation process.」。inherent prejudice 意為「固有偏見」，compromise 在此為「損害」，選項 A 正確。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: If you had prioritized your psychological well-being, you wouldn't have suffered a nervous breakdown.
options: A. I know. I should have listened to the counselor's advice earlier.
B. The psychology department is currently accepting new students.
C. You should try to work harder to achieve your career goals.
D. Mental health is a very important topic in modern society.
boss.explain: 原句「If you had prioritized your psychological well-being, you wouldn't have suffered a nervous breakdown.」（如果你把心理健康放在首位，你就不會精神崩潰了）。選項 A「我知道。我早該聽諮商師的建議」最適合。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The financial analyst projected that if the merger had gone through, a monopoly would have been inevitable.
options: A. 財務分析師預測，如果當初合併案通過，壟斷將是不可避免的。
B. 分析師認為，因為合併案失敗，市場才免於被大企業壟斷。
C. 分析師警告，如果兩家公司決定合併，他們將面臨反壟斷調查。
D. 財務分析師表示，這場合併案的目的是為了打破市場的壟斷。
boss.explain: 原句「The financial analyst projected that if the merger had gone through, a monopoly would have been inevitable.」這是一個與過去事實相反的假設，選項 A 完全表達出其含意。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: The spokesperson maintained that the corporation had always strictly adhered to environmental regulations.
options: A. Yet, the leaked documents clearly contradict her statement.
B. The environmental agency is located downtown.
C. She is known for her strict adherence to personal diets.
D. Corporate rules are usually very complicated to read.
boss.explain: 原句「The spokesperson maintained that the corporation had always strictly adhered to environmental regulations.」（發言人堅稱該公司一直嚴格遵守環保法規）。選項 A「然而，洩漏的文件明顯與她的聲明相悖」符合高階邏輯對話。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: Had the property appraiser identified the structural flaws, the bank would have immediately revoked the mortgage offer.
options: A. 要是房產估價師有發現結構瑕疵，銀行就會立刻撤回房貸報價。
B. 因為估價師發現了結構瑕疵，銀行拒絕了我們的房貸申請。
C. 儘管房屋有結構問題，銀行最終還是決定核准這筆貸款。
D. 如果房子沒有結構瑕疵，估價師就會給出更高的市場估值。
boss.explain: 原句「Had the property appraiser identified the structural flaws, the bank would have immediately revoked the mortgage offer.」這是一個倒裝的第三類條件句（省略 if），選項 A 翻譯正確。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: She explained that the subtle nuances of the local dialect had completely baffled the foreign delegates.
options: A. Interpreters often struggle with those subtle cultural contexts too.
B. The delegates arrived at the airport early this morning.
C. The local dialect is spoken by millions of people.
D. The conference room was beautifully decorated.
boss.explain: 原句「She explained that the subtle nuances of the local dialect had completely baffled the foreign delegates.」（她解釋說當地語言中微妙的細微差別讓外國代表完全摸不著頭緒）。選項 A「口譯員通常也對那些微妙的文化語境感到棘手」是最合理的回應。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: If the committee were to scrutinize the budget proposal, they would undoubtedly find numerous irregularities.
options: A. 如果委員會仔細審查預算提案，他們無疑會發現許多違規之處。
B. 委員會因為發現了預算提案中的諸多違規，所以退回了該案。
C. 只要提案沒有違規，委員會就會在明天的會議上無條件通過。
D. 委員會表示這份預算提案非常完美，沒有任何需要修改的地方。
boss.explain: 原句「If the committee were to scrutinize the budget proposal, they would undoubtedly find numerous irregularities.」這是對未來/現在的假設，選項 A 正確。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: He claimed that the constant barrage of negative feedback had eroded his self-esteem over time.
options: A. Therapy could help him rebuild his confidence after such an ordeal.
B. He should try to give more constructive feedback to others.
C. The feedback form can be downloaded from our website.
D. Self-esteem is essential for personal development.
boss.explain: 原句「He claimed that the constant barrage of negative feedback had eroded his self-esteem over time.」（他聲稱不斷的負面回饋久而久之侵蝕了他的自尊）。選項 A「心理治療可以幫助他在經歷這樣的煎熬後重建自信」最為體貼且合適。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: Had she not meticulously prepared for the cross-cultural negotiations, the language barrier would have derailed the entire project.
options: A. 若非她為跨文化談判做了無微不至的準備，語言隔閡早就會讓整個專案泡湯了。
B. 儘管她為跨文化談判做了充分準備，語言障礙還是導致了專案的失敗。
C. 因為她沒有認真準備，談判過程中的語言隔閡毀了這個專案。
D. 只要解決了語言障礙，跨文化談判就不需要提前做太多準備。
boss.explain: 原句「Had she not meticulously prepared for the cross-cultural negotiations, the language barrier would have derailed the entire project.」是倒裝的第三類條件句，選項 A 為精準翻譯。

boss.desc: 【短文】Tech News: As artificial intelligence continues to evolve, employees must focus on skills that machines lack, such as empathy and creative problem-solving. A recent survey revealed that most companies plan to retrain their staff rather than replace them. Q: What is the main idea of this news?
options: A. AI will completely replace human workers soon.
B. Machines are now capable of showing empathy.
C. Companies will fire employees who lack AI skills.
D. Workers should develop human-centric skills as AI advances.
boss.explain: 文章提到隨著 AI 發展，員工必須專注於機器缺乏的技能，如「同理心與創意解決問題」，且公司計畫重新培訓員工而非取代他們。選項 D (隨著 AI 進步，勞工應發展以人為本的技能) 最符合主旨。

boss.desc: 【短文】Memo: The transition to the new automated payroll system was smoother than expected. The IT team had fixed all the critical bugs before the official launch date, so no employee experienced a delay in receiving their salary. Q: What is true about the critical bugs?
options: A. They were fixed prior to the system's launch.
B. They caused a delay in salary payments.
C. They appeared after the official launch.
D. They were ignored by the IT team.
boss.explain: 短文中使用了過去完成式「had fixed... before the official launch date」，表示這些嚴重的系統錯誤在正式發布之前就已經被修復了，與選項 A 相符。

boss.desc: 【短文】Business Review: The startup created a brilliant business model on paper. However, they failed because they did not ___ their plans effectively in the real market. If they had hired experienced managers, the outcome might have been different. Q: Which word best fills in the blank?
options: A. excuse
B. execute
C. exclude
D. exhaust
boss.explain: 句意為「這家新創公司在紙上建立了一個出色的商業模式。然而他們失敗了，因為他們沒有在實際市場中有效地『執行』計畫」。execute 意為「執行」，最符合語境。excuse 為藉口/原諒，exclude 為排除，exhaust 為耗盡。

boss.desc: 【短文】Press Release: During the briefing, the health minister assured the public that the new vaccine had passed all safety trials. He announced that the distribution would begin the following month, prioritizing frontline workers. Q: What did the minister say about the distribution?
options: A. It had already been completed.
B. It would be delayed for another month.
C. It would start next month for essential staff.
D. It had failed the safety trials.
boss.explain: 部長在簡報中表示疫苗分發將在下個月開始 (would begin the following month)，並優先考慮第一線人員 (prioritizing frontline workers)。這與選項 C 中「下個月開始針對重要員工發放」的敘述完全相符。

boss.desc: 【短文】Medical Journal: When a highly contagious disease is detected, it is vital to ___ the infected individuals from the healthy population as quickly as possible. This action prevents the medical system from becoming overwhelmed. Q: Which word best fills in the blank?
options: A. insulate
B. invest
C. import
D. isolate
boss.explain: 句意為「當發現高傳染性疾病時，盡快將受感染者與健康人群『隔離』至關重要」。isolate 意為「隔離、孤立」，為公衛領域常見用字。insulate 指（使）隔熱/隔音，invest 為投資，import 為進口。

boss.desc: 【短文】Tourism Report: The island's economy had relied solely on mass tourism before the pandemic struck. When global travel stopped, the local government realized they had made a mistake and subsequently began promoting digital nomad visas to diversify their income. Q: What was the island's economic situation before the pandemic?
options: A. It depended heavily on a large volume of tourists.
B. It was already popular among digital nomads.
C. It had a highly diversified source of income.
D. It completely banned international visitors.
boss.explain: 文中「had relied solely on mass tourism before the pandemic struck」使用過去完成式，強調疫情前島上經濟「完全依賴大眾旅遊（大量遊客）」，因此 A 是正確推論。疫情後才開始推廣數位遊牧簽證來實現收入多元化。

boss.desc: 【短文】Agency Memo: As the travel industry shifts toward online booking, our agency must ___ its core customer base by offering highly personalized services that websites cannot offer. Q: Which word best fills in the blank?
options: A. refrain
B. retain
C. remain
D. resign
boss.explain: 句意為「隨著旅遊業轉向線上預訂，我們的機構必須透過提供網站無法提供的高度客製化服務來『保留』核心客群」。retain 意為「保留、留住」。refrain 為克制，remain 為保持/留下，resign 為辭職。

boss.desc: 【短文】News Report: The CEO of the beverage company faced a scandal yesterday. He denied that he had known about the contaminated water source, claiming that the quality control team had assured him everything was perfectly fine. Q: What did the quality control team allegedly do?
options: A. They contaminated the water source deliberately.
B. They reported the issue to the public immediately.
C. They told the CEO that there were no problems.
D. They refused to speak to the media.
boss.explain: 執行長聲稱品管團隊之前向他保證過一切都沒問題 (had assured him everything was perfectly fine)。選項 C 說他們告訴執行長沒有問題，與文本相符。

boss.desc: 【短文】Food Safety Blog: Trust is built on honesty. Brands that are ___ about their supply chains and manufacturing processes tend to enjoy stronger customer loyalty in the long run. Consumers appreciate knowing exactly where their food comes from. Q: Which word best fills in the blank?
options: A. transient
B. tolerant
C. traditional
D. transparent
boss.explain: 文章主旨在談誠實與信任。句意為「對於供應鏈和製造過程保持『透明』的品牌，通常享有更強的顧客忠誠度」。transparent 意為「透明的、公開誠實的」。transient 為短暫的，tolerant 為寬容的，traditional 為傳統的。

boss.desc: 【短文】Urban Planning Journal: Car-free zones have been implemented in several European capitals. Although local shop owners initially feared a drop in sales, recent data shows that foot traffic and retail revenue have actually increased since cars were banned. Q: What is the main finding regarding car-free zones?
options: A. They cause local businesses to lose money.
B. They increase the number of traffic accidents.
C. They are strongly opposed by all residents.
D. They lead to higher retail sales and more visitors.
boss.explain: 文章指出雖然店家起初擔心銷售下降，但數據顯示在無車區實施後，人潮 (foot traffic) 與零售收入 (retail revenue) 實際上都增加了。因此答案為 D。

boss.desc: 【短文】Commuter Notice: The express train service was suspended yesterday morning. The railway authority explained that a heavy storm had damaged the overhead power lines during the night. Normal service resumed after crews repaired the lines. Q: What happened during the night?
options: A. A severe storm broke the power lines.
B. The maintenance crew suspended the service.
C. The express train crashed into a tree.
D. Passengers complained about the weather.
boss.explain: 短文中鐵路局解釋「a heavy storm had damaged the overhead power lines during the night」（一場嚴重的風暴在夜間破壞了高架電纜）。選項 A 的 broke the power lines 與 damaged 意義相同。

boss.desc: 【短文】City Gazette: With the expansion of the light rail network, residents living in the suburbs can now enjoy a faster and more reliable ___ to the city center. This improvement has greatly boosted property values in those areas. Q: Which word best fills in the blank?
options: A. consume
B. commute
C. combine
D. compete
boss.explain: 句意為「隨著輕軌網路擴張，住在郊區的居民現在可以享受更快速、可靠的『通勤』前往市中心」。commute 作名詞指通勤路程。consume 為消費，combine 為結合，compete 為競爭。

boss.desc: 請唸出單字：波動
請唸出單字：反駁
請唸出單字：大幅地
請唸出單字：比例
請唸出：委婉拒絕這個提議
請唸出：經歷大幅下跌
請唸出：要求緊急更新
請唸出：表達她深切的擔憂
請唸出短句：如果我們當時有嘗試我們就會贏
boss.ans: IF WE HAD TRIED WE WOULD HAVE WON
boss.speak: if we had tried we would have won

boss.desc: 請唸出短句：如果我們當時有邀請她就會來
boss.ans: SHE WOULD HAVE COME IF WE HAD ASKED
boss.speak: she would have come if we had asked

boss.desc: 請唸出短句：在我們採取行動前銷售額已經下降了
boss.ans: SALES HAD DROPPED BEFORE WE TOOK ACTION
boss.speak: sales had dropped before we took action

boss.desc: 請唸出短句：經理警告說價格已經上漲了
boss.ans: THE MANAGER WARNED THAT PRICES HAD RISEN
boss.speak: the manager warned that prices had risen

boss.desc: 請拼出：疏忽
填空題：O V _ R S _ G _ T (疏忽)
請拼出：宣傳；公佈
填空題：P U B L _ C _ Z _ (宣傳；公佈)
請拼出：爭議
填空題：C O N T R _ V _ R S _ (爭議)
請拼出：共識
填空題：C _ N S _ N S _ S (共識)
請拼出：全體一致的
填空題：U N _ N _ M _ U S (全體一致的)
請拼出：代表
填空題：R _ P R _ S _ N T A T I V E (代表)
🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The manager noted that his lack of punctuality had affected his assessment.
options: A. 經理認為他的評估結果不受遲到影響。
B. 經理提醒他下次評估時務必要準時。
C. 經理表示他的表現優秀，完全彌補了不守時。
D. 經理指出他不守時的問題影響了他的評估。
boss.explain: 這句話的意思是「經理指出他不守時的問題已經影響了他的評估。」（The manager noted that his lack of punctuality had affected his assessment.），punctuality 是守時。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: If the criteria were more flexible, we would attract diverse talent.
options: A. 因為標準很有彈性，我們已經吸引了許多人才。
B. 我們不想改變標準，因為那樣會流失人才。
C. 如果標準更有彈性，我們就能吸引多元的人才。
D. 就算標準再怎麼有彈性，也很難吸引到人才。
boss.explain: 這句話的意思是「如果標準更有彈性，我們就能吸引多元的人才。」（If the criteria were more flexible, we would attract diverse talent.），這表示目前的標準還不夠有彈性。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The agent said she had already emailed the updated itinerary.
options: A. 專員說她會盡快把更新版的行程寄出。
B. 專員說她已經將更新版的行程用電子郵件寄出了。
C. 專員表示更新版的行程還在確認中。
D. 專員忘記把更新版的行程寄給客戶了。
boss.explain: 這句話的意思是「專員說她已經將更新版的行程用電子郵件寄出了。」（The agent said she had already emailed the updated itinerary.），使用了過去完成式代表在說話前已寄出。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: If the premises were open to the public, the congestion would worsen.
options: A. 因為場地對大眾開放，所以目前非常壅塞。
B. 如果這個場地對大眾開放，壅塞情況將會惡化。
C. 場地不對外開放是為了解決目前的壅塞。
D. 即使場地對外開放，壅塞情況也不會改變。
boss.explain: 這句話的意思是「如果這個場地對大眾開放，壅塞情況將會惡化。」（If the premises were open to the public, the congestion would worsen.），為假設情況，表示目前並未對外開放。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: He argued that the genetic data had proven his theory.
options: A. 他認為基因數據與他的理論互相矛盾。
B. 他懷疑那些基因數據的真實性。
C. 他正在尋找能證實他理論的基因數據。
D. 他主張那些基因數據已經證實了他的理論。
boss.explain: 這句話的意思是「他主張那些基因數據已經證實了他的理論。」（He argued that the genetic data had proven his theory.），genetic 為基因的，data 數據。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: If the farming methods were sustainable, the ecological impact would be minimal.
options: A. 由於耕作方式符合永續原則，對生態完全沒有影響。
B. 如果耕作方式是永續的，對生態的影響就會降到最低。
C. 即使採用永續的耕作方式，生態影響依然很大。
D. 傳統耕作方式比永續耕作方式更不影響生態。
boss.explain: 這句話的意思是「如果耕作方式是永續的，對生態的影響就會降到最低。」（If the farming methods were sustainable, the ecological impact would be minimal.），這表示目前的耕作方式可能不夠永續。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: They mentioned that the latest regulation had complicated the lawsuit.
options: A. 他們認為最新的規定有助於早日結束訴訟。
B. 他們表示這場訴訟促成了最新規定的頒布。
C. 他們提到最新的規定讓這場訴訟變得更加複雜。
D. 他們抱怨最新的規定完全不適用於這場訴訟。
boss.explain: 這句話的意思是「他們提到最新的規定讓這場訴訟變得更加複雜。」（They mentioned that the latest regulation had complicated the lawsuit.），complicate 當動詞為使複雜化。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: If we had noticed the hidden clause, we would not have signed.
options: A. 因為我們注意到了隱藏條款，所以拒絕簽名。
B. 如果我們當時有注意到那個隱藏條款，我們就不會簽名了。
C. 我們雖然看到了隱藏條款，但還是簽了名。
D. 那個隱藏條款對我們是否簽名沒有任何影響。
boss.explain: 這句話的意思是「如果我們當時有注意到那個隱藏條款，我們就不會簽名了。」（If we had noticed the hidden clause, we would not have signed.），代表當下並未注意到。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: They realized that the local ordinance had forbidden commercial activities.
options: A. 他們發現地方法令其實是鼓勵商業活動的。
B. 他們希望地方法令能放寬對商業活動的限制。
C. 他們因為違反地方法令進行商業活動而受罰。
D. 他們意識到地方法令已經禁止了商業活動。
boss.explain: 這句話的意思是「他們意識到地方法令已經禁止了商業活動。」（They realized that the local ordinance had forbidden commercial activities.），ordinance 指地方法令或條例。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: If the commute were shorter, people would have more free time.
options: A. 因為通勤時間變短了，大家現在有很多空閒時間。
B. 人們為了縮短通勤時間，犧牲了自己的空閒時間。
C. 如果通勤時間更短，人們就會有更多的空閒時間。
D. 無論通勤時間長短，大家的空閒時間都不會改變。
boss.explain: 這句話的意思是「如果通勤時間更短，人們就會有更多的空閒時間。」（If the commute were shorter, people would have more free time.），表示大家目前的通勤時間其實偏長。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: What did the judge say about the intellectual property dispute?
options: A. They usually commute by the local subway.
B. He ruled that it was a clear breach of copyright.
C. The ecological environment is very vulnerable.
D. I think the infrastructure is too old.
boss.explain: 原句意為「法官對這起智慧財產權糾紛說了什麼？」；(B) 回應「他裁定這是一起明顯的侵犯版權案件。」最為合理。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: If you were unhappy with the zoning changes, how would you appeal?
options: A. I would file a formal grievance with the city council.
B. I have already restored the entire park.
C. The itinerary was modified due to rain.
D. She testified about the sustainable farming.
boss.explain: 原句意為「如果你對土地重劃（區劃變更）不滿意，你會如何申訴？」；(A) 回應「我會向市議會提出正式申訴。」符合語境。

boss.desc: 【短文】Sustainability Report: The packaging division manager addressed the shareholders yesterday. He mentioned that the firm had explored several biodegradable materials before they ultimately settled on a corn-based solution. This transition has greatly reduced their plastic waste over the last two quarters. Q: What had the firm done before choosing the corn-based solution?
options: A. They had investigated various biodegradable options.
B. They had increased their plastic production significantly.
C. They had reported a massive loss to the shareholders.
D. They had stopped packaging their products entirely.
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：短文指出經理提及在決定使用玉米基材前，公司已探索(had explored)過幾種生物可分解材質，選項 A 為同義改寫。

boss.desc: 【短文】Climate Activism Review: The global dependency on fossil fuels remains a critical issue. An expert recently argued that if more multinational corporations adopted renewable energy voluntarily, global carbon emissions would drop significantly, mitigating the harshest effects of climate change. Q: According to the expert, what is the required condition for a significant drop in emissions?
options: A. Eliminating all multinational corporations immediately.
B. Forcing citizens to reduce their personal carbon footprints.
C. Waiting for governments to draft new climate legislations.
D. More corporations choosing to use renewable energy.
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：文章的條件句表示「如果更多跨國企業採用再生能源(adopted renewable energy)，全球碳排放將顯著下降」，故選 D。

boss.desc: 【短文】Corporate Press Release: Following the recent public relations crisis, the firm is trying to rebuild its reputation. The official spokesperson explained that the company had already launched a new ethical sourcing initiative to guarantee fair labor conditions across all their supply chains. Q: What did the spokesperson explain?
options: A. The company had started a project to ensure fair labor.
B. The company was facing a massive labor strike.
C. The company had fired the previous supply chain manager.
D. The company intended to ignore the public relations crisis.
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：發言人解釋公司「已啟動新的道德採購計畫來確保公平的勞動條件」，選項 A 的 started a project to ensure fair labor 符合文意。

boss.desc: 【短文】Sports Medicine Journal: Advanced gear can make a difference in competitive swimming. The research team discovered that the athletes who had worn the newly designed hydrodynamic suits shaved precious seconds off their personal records during the trials. Q: What was discovered about the athletes in the new suits?
options: A. They suffered more muscular injuries than others.
B. They complained about the hydrodynamic design.
C. They achieved faster times than they previously had.
D. They refused to wear the suits during the final trials.
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：文章提到穿新泳衣的運動員「在個人紀錄上削去了寶貴的秒數(shaved precious seconds off)」，意指游得更快，故選 C。

boss.desc: 【短文】Athletic Training Guide: Listening to one's body is fundamental to long-term success. The manual states that if athletes ignored the early warning signs of extreme fatigue, they would risk suffering from chronic injuries that could prematurely end their professional careers. Q: What might happen if athletes do not pay attention to their fatigue?
options: A. They might sustain long-lasting physical damage.
B. They would easily set new world records.
C. Their professional careers would become much longer.
D. They could quickly recover without any medical help.
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：如果忽略疲勞警訊，會有遭受慢性傷害(chronic injuries)的風險，這等同於選項 A 的「長期持續的身體損傷」。

boss.desc: 【短文】Health Seminar Notes: There are many myths surrounding pre-workout routines. During the lecture, the renowned sports scientist clarified that static stretching before a heavy weightlifting session did not always prevent injury, completely contrary to popular belief among amateur gym-goers. Q: What did the scientist say about static stretching?
options: A. It is the only way to build muscle mass safely.
B. It does not guarantee protection against injuries.
C. It is strictly forbidden for all amateur gym-goers.
D. It always prevents injuries if done correctly.
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：科學家澄清靜態伸展「不見得總能防止受傷(did not always prevent injury)」，即選項 B「不保證免於受傷」。

boss.desc: 【短文】Immigration Policy Review: The historical context of the new bill is often overlooked. By the time the comprehensive immigration reform was finally passed in the senate, thousands of families had already waited for their visa approvals in uncertainty for over a decade. Q: What was the situation for many families prior to the bill's passage?
options: A. They had been waiting a long time for their visas.
B. They had already returned to their home countries.
C. They had quickly received their citizenship status.
D. They had been working illegally without any visas.
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：在法案通過前，數千個家庭「已經為了簽證核准等待超過十年(had already waited... for over a decade)」，故選 A。

boss.desc: 【短文】Sociology Essay Excerpt: Isolation rarely leads to progress. The academic paper argues that if modern societies embraced cultural differences rather than suppressing them, they would experience a much richer exchange of diverse art, cuisine, and innovative philosophical ideas. Q: What is the main argument of this excerpt?
options: A. Suppressing cultural differences is necessary for progress.
B. Societies should isolate themselves to protect their art.
C. Innovation is impossible in a highly diverse environment.
D. Welcoming diversity brings valuable cultural benefits.
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：文章主張如果社會能擁抱文化差異，就能獲得更豐富的藝術、美食與哲學思想交流，這對應到選項 D 的「歡迎多元能帶來有價值的文化益處」。

boss.desc: 【短文】Author Interview: In her critically acclaimed new memoir, the novelist explores the complexities of growing up as a second-generation immigrant. She wrote that she had felt constantly caught between two distinct identities during her turbulent teenage years. Q: How did the author describe her teenage years in the memoir?
options: A. She felt entirely disconnected from her parents' culture.
B. She felt torn between two different cultural identities.
C. She found it very easy to blend into the local society.
D. She was never aware of any cultural differences.
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：作者寫道她在青少年時期感到「一直夾在兩種不同的身分認同之間(caught between two distinct identities)」，選項 B 為同義表述。

boss.desc: 【短文】Startup Success Story: The path to success is rarely a straight line. The successful entrepreneur explained at the conference that she had drafted dozens of flawed business plans before she finally found a truly viable strategy for her e-commerce platform. Q: What did the entrepreneur do before finding a viable strategy?
options: A. She secured funding from a wealthy angel investor.
B. She wrote many unsuccessful business plans.
C. She launched multiple successful e-commerce platforms.
D. She hired a team of highly experienced managers.
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：短文提到她在找到可行策略前，已經起草了數十份有缺陷的商業計畫(drafted dozens of flawed business plans)，故選 B。

boss.desc: 【短文】Business Case Study: The sudden collapse of the promising tech firm serves as a cautionary tale. Analysts point out that if the co-founders communicated more transparently with one another, the internal conflicts that ruined the company would not have escalated so quickly. Q: According to the analysts, what could have prevented the rapid escalation of conflicts?
options: A. Hiring more external consultants.
B. Firing the aggressive co-founders.
C. Better and more open communication.
D. Securing a larger amount of seed money.
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：分析師指出「如果共同創辦人之間有更透明的溝通(communicated more transparently)」，內部衝突就不會升級得那麼快，故選 C。

boss.desc: 【短文】Financial Advisory Report: A recent audit of the new startup revealed alarming spending habits. The financial consultant warned the founders that the enterprise would run out of cash entirely within six months if they didn't immediately cut all unnecessary operational expenses. Q: What was the consultant's warning based on?
options: A. The founders were planning to sell the company soon.
B. The startup was generating too much profit to manage.
C. The team had successfully raised another round of funding.
D. The company was spending money too quickly and wastefully.
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：顧問警告如果不削減開支，六個月內就會燒光現金(run out of cash)，這表示公司花錢太快且浪費，故選 D。

🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: We are currently looking for a sustainable alternative to plastic packaging.
options: A. 我們正在尋找更便宜的紙張供應商。
B. 我們正在尋找能快速分解的化學物質。
C. 我們正在尋找塑膠包裝的永續替代方案。
D. 我們正在尋找提高生產效率的新機器。
boss.explain: 英文原句：We are currently looking for a sustainable alternative to plastic packaging. 意思：我們正在尋找塑膠包裝的永續替代方案。alternative 指「替代方案」。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: If the factory stopped dumping chemicals, the water quality would improve rapidly.
options: A. 如果政府提高罰款，工廠就不會再違法排放。
B. 如果居民減少用水，水庫的存量就會增加。
C. 如果公司引進新設備，產量就會大幅提升。
D. 如果工廠停止傾倒化學物質，水質會迅速改善。
boss.explain: 英文原句：If the factory stopped dumping chemicals, the water quality would improve rapidly. 意思：如果工廠停止傾倒化學物質，水質會迅速改善。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The language barrier was the biggest challenge I faced in Germany.
options: A. 語言障礙是我在德國面臨的最大挑戰。
B. 飲食習慣是我在法國遇到最大的問題。
C. 文化衝擊是我在日本感受最深的事情。
D. 交通不便是他在美國生活最大的困擾。
boss.explain: 英文原句：The language barrier was the biggest challenge I faced in Germany. 意思：語言障礙是我在德國面臨的最大挑戰。barrier 指「障礙；隔閡」。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: He admitted that he had felt incredibly homesick during his first semester.
options: A. 他坦承在入學考試時感到非常緊張。
B. 他承認在第一學期感到極度想家。
C. 他透露在準備畢業論文時壓力很大。
D. 他抱怨在學校宿舍裡一直睡不好。
boss.explain: 英文原句：He admitted that he had felt incredibly homesick during his first semester. 意思：他承認在第一學期感到極度想家。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: If she hadn't secured that scholarship, she wouldn't have gone to London.
options: A. The university had accepted her application yesterday.
B. He told me that his luggage had been lost at the airport.
C. True, living expenses there are just too high to afford.
D. If you studied harder, you would pass the exam.
boss.explain: 英文原句：If she hadn't secured that scholarship, she wouldn't have gone to London. 意思：如果她當初沒有拿到那筆獎學金，她就不會去倫敦了。選項 C「沒錯，那裡的生活費實在高到難以負擔」符合情境。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: She mentioned that learning the local slang had helped her make new friends.
options: A. 她說參加社團活動讓她很快融入群體。
B. 她認為主動開口說話是交朋友的關鍵。
C. 她指出了解當地歷史能避免許多誤會。
D. 她提到學習當地俚語幫助她交到了新朋友。
boss.explain: 英文原句：She mentioned that learning the local slang had helped her make new friends. 意思：她提到學習當地俚語幫助她交到了新朋友。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: After living in Tokyo for three years, she became fluent in Japanese.
options: A. 在東京住了三年後，她的日文變得非常流利。
B. 在紐約住了五年後，他的英文口音完全改變了。
C. 在巴黎待了半年後，她習慣了當地的生活步調。
D. 在倫敦讀完碩士後，他決定留在當地工作。
boss.explain: 英文原句：After living in Tokyo for three years, she became fluent in Japanese. 意思：在東京住了三年後，她的日文變得非常流利。fluent 指「流利的」。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: If I had practiced speaking more, my accent wouldn't have been so obvious.
options: A. The flight had already departed when I arrived.
B. You still sound perfectly natural and easy to understand to me.
C. If she were the teacher, she would assign more homework.
D. He asked if the final exam would be difficult.
boss.explain: 英文原句：If I had practiced speaking more, my accent wouldn't have been so obvious. 意思：如果我當初多練習口說，我的口音就不會這麼明顯了。選項 B「對我來說，你聽起來還是非常自然且容易理解的」是最佳安慰語。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: They observed that the diverse workforce had sparked many creative ideas.
options: A. 他們發現跨部門合作減少了溝通上的摩擦。
B. 他們認為嚴格的管理制度限制了員工的潛力。
C. 他們觀察到多元的勞動力激發了許多創意。
D. 他們指出遠距工作模式提高了整體的效率。
boss.explain: 英文原句：They observed that the diverse workforce had sparked many creative ideas. 意思：他們觀察到多元的勞動力激發了許多創意。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: He told his parents that he had successfully adapted to the new lifestyle.
options: A. The internet connection was really unstable today.
B. If I had known, I would have bought him a gift.
C. She mentioned that the project was highly successful.
D. That must be a huge relief for his family.
boss.explain: 英文原句：He told his parents that he had successfully adapted to the new lifestyle. 意思：他告訴父母他已經成功適應了新的生活方式。選項 D「那對他的家人來說一定是一大安慰」最為合適。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: Having overseas work experience is a big advantage for this position.
options: A. 擁有海外工作經驗對這個職位來說是一大優勢。
B. 具備流利的外語能力是應徵這個職位的基本條件。
C. 能夠適應高壓環境是這個職缺最看重的特質。
D. 熟悉跨國法規對這份工作而言非常重要。
boss.explain: 英文原句：Having overseas work experience is a big advantage for this position. 意思：擁有海外工作經驗對這個職位來說是一大優勢。overseas 指「海外的」。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: If you embraced the differences, you would find living abroad very rewarding.
options: A. 如果你學會了獨立，你就不會覺得孤單。
B. 如果你擁抱這些差異，你會發現旅居國外非常有收穫。
C. 如果你提早做好規劃，你的留學生活會順利很多。
D. 如果你結交當地朋友，你的語言能力會進步很快。
boss.explain: 英文原句：If you embraced the differences, you would find living abroad very rewarding. 意思：如果你擁抱這些差異，你會發現旅居國外非常有收穫。

boss.desc: 【短文】Ethics Training Guide: Maintaining a positive corporate culture requires continuous effort. If the firm ___ strict ethical guidelines consistently, it would face fewer lawsuits from disgruntled clients. Q: Which word or phrase best fills in the blank?
options: A. upholds
B. has upheld
C. to uphold
D. upheld
boss.explain: 本題測驗短文中的假設語氣填空。主要子句為 would face (would + 原形動詞)，表示與現在事實相反，If 條件句需使用過去式動詞 upheld，故選 (D)。

boss.desc: 【短文】Business Journal: A manager recently awarded a lucrative contract to a firm owned by his brother. Although he claimed that the bidding process was completely fair, critics argue that this obvious conflict of interest compromises the integrity of the entire organization. Q: What does the text suggest about the manager's decision?
options: A. It is highly inappropriate and raises ethical concerns.
B. It was the only way to save the organization from bankruptcy.
C. It proves that the bidding process was conducted fairly.
D. It will ultimately increase the profits of the firm.
boss.explain: 本題測驗推論能力。文章指出將合約給自己兄弟的公司是「明顯的利益衝突 (obvious conflict of interest)」且損害組織的操守 (compromises the integrity)，因此這決定是高度不適當且引發道德疑慮的 (A)。

boss.desc: 【短文】Science Blog: Colonizing other planets is no longer just science fiction. If humanity ___ a self-sustaining colony on Mars, it would secure the long-term survival of our species in case of a global catastrophe on Earth. Q: Which word best fills in the blank?
options: A. establishes
B. established
C. has established
D. had established
boss.explain: 本題測驗假設語氣填空。主要子句為 would secure，表示針對未來或現在的不確定想像，If 子句應使用過去式 established (第二類條件句)。

boss.desc: 【短文】Astronaut Training Manual: Surviving in microgravity takes immense physical and mental endurance. During yesterday's simulation, several candidates panicked when the life support system went offline. As a result, they were immediately disqualified from the upcoming mission. Q: Why were the candidates disqualified?
options: A. They failed to operate the microgravity equipment properly.
B. They suffered from severe physical injuries during training.
C. They lost their composure during a simulated emergency.
D. They refused to repair the offline life support system.
boss.explain: 本題測驗短文推論。文中指出候選人因為在維生系統模擬故障時「恐慌 (panicked)」而被取消資格，這等同於 (C) 失去沉著/冷靜 (lost their composure)。

boss.desc: 【短文】Policy Review: The current financial strain on the healthcare system was predictable. If the politicians ___ decisive action sooner, the economic crisis regarding eldercare would have been easily avoided. Q: Which phrase best fills in the blank?
options: A. take
B. are taking
C. took
D. had taken
boss.explain: 本題測驗與過去事實相反的假設語氣。主要子句為 would have been avoided，條件句必須用過去完成式 had taken 來表示過去未發生的動作。

boss.desc: 【短文】Urban Living Journal: Intergenerational housing is gaining popularity. In these shared living spaces, university students receive cheaper rent in exchange for helping older residents with chores. This setup not only reduces costs but also bridges the gap between different age groups. Q: What is a key benefit of this housing arrangement?
options: A. It fosters mutual support across different generations.
B. It completely eliminates the need for professional nursing homes.
C. It provides university students with free healthcare services.
D. It allows older residents to enroll in university courses for free.
boss.explain: 本題測驗細節理解。文章提到學生幫忙做家事換取低廉租金，這不但降低成本還能彌合年齡代溝 (bridges the gap)，與 (A) 促進不同世代間的互助 語意最相符。

boss.desc: 【短文】Fashion Forward Magazine: The concept of rental fashion is revolutionizing the industry. If more people ___ formal clothes for special occasions instead of buying them, the overall textile waste in landfills would drop drastically. Q: Which word best fills in the blank?
options: A. rent
B. rented
C. have rented
D. had rented
boss.explain: 本題測驗假設語氣。主要子句為 would drop (與現在/未來事實相反的假設)，因此 If 子句動詞需使用過去式 rented。

boss.desc: 【短文】Design Monthly: Upcycling takes recycling a step further. Instead of breaking down materials to their base form, upcycling involves creatively transforming old products—like turning worn-out jeans into stylish tote bags—giving them a higher value than the original item. Q: How does upcycling differ from traditional recycling?
options: A. It requires more energy and expensive machinery.
B. It only applies to items that cannot be broken down.
C. It increases the value of the discarded materials through creativity.
D. It is exclusively used for producing luxury denim products.
boss.explain: 本題測驗短文細節。文中提到升級改造 (upcycling) 不只是將材料分解，而是透過創意將舊物轉化，賦予它們比原物更高的價值 (giving them a higher value)，對應 (C)。

boss.desc: 【對話-時態】A: "Did you manage to buy that vintage leather jacket online?" B: "No, someone else ___ it before I even reached the checkout page."
options: A. purchases
B. is purchasing
C. has purchased
D. had purchased
boss.explain: 本題測驗過去完成式。我到達結帳頁面 (reached) 為過去式，而「別人買走」這件事發生在那之前，因此必須使用過去完成式 had purchased。

boss.desc: 【短文】Wellness Blog: Taking a digital detox can reset your mental state. Looking back at her experience, Jane realized that if she ___ the controversial app, she would not have regained her peace of mind so quickly. Q: Which phrase best fills in the blank?
options: A. didn't delete
B. doesn't delete
C. hasn't deleted
D. had not deleted
boss.explain: 本題測驗與過去事實相反的假設語氣。主要子句為 would not have regained，條件句需用過去完成式 had not deleted (如果當時沒有刪除)。

boss.desc: 【短文】Psychology Today: The Fear of Missing Out (FOMO) is amplified by digital connectivity. When people see peers posting about exciting events, they often feel inadequate or excluded. This constant comparison fuels a cycle of dissatisfaction that is hard to break. Q: What psychological effect does the text describe?
options: A. Feeling left out and dissatisfied after seeing others' highlight reels.
B. The joy of connecting with friends through online event pages.
C. The relief of staying home instead of attending crowded parties.
D. The fear of losing personal data on unsecure networks.
boss.explain: 本題測驗主旨推論。文章描述人們在網路上看到同儕貼出精彩活動時會感到不足或被排擠 (feel inadequate or excluded)，並引發不滿的循環，這與 (A) 感到被冷落與不滿 的描述一致。

boss.desc: 【對話-間接引語】A: "Why is Sarah completely offline this week?" B: "She mentioned that the flood of negative comments ___ her too much stress lately."
options: A. causes
B. had caused
C. is causing
D. will cause
boss.explain: 本題測驗間接引語時態。mentioned 為過去式，大量的負面留言造成她的壓力發生在此之前 (或一直持續到她提及的時候)，在間接引語中需退一步使用過去完成式 had caused 最符合文法規範。

boss.desc: 請唸出短句：他們指出成本已經增加了
boss.ans: THEY NOTED THAT COSTS HAD INCREASED
boss.speak: they noted that costs had increased

boss.desc: 請唸出短句：文章陳述通貨膨脹已達頂峰
boss.ans: THE ARTICLE STATED INFLATION HAD PEAKED
boss.speak: the article stated inflation had peaked

boss.desc: 請唸出短句：專家警告情況會變更糟
boss.ans: EXPERTS WARNED IT WOULD GET WORSE
boss.speak: experts warned it would get worse

boss.desc: 填空題：I T _ N E R _ R Y (行程)
填空題：P R _ F I C _ E N T (精通的)
填空題：I N V _ S T _ G A T _ (調查)
請拼出：替代品；更換
填空題：R E P L _ C _ M _ N T (替代品；更換)
請拼出：此外
填空題：F U R T H _ R M _ R _ (此外)
請拼出：然而；不過
填空題：N _ V _ R T H E L _ S S (然而；不過)
請拼出：應負責任的
填空題：A C C _ U N T _ B L _ (應負責任的)
請拼出：精通的
🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: The auditor asked if the accounting department had allocated the funds properly.
options: A. Yes, they told us the funds will be cut.
B. I heard the audit is scheduled for next year.
C. Yes, she confirmed that every penny had been tracked.
D. No, the department does not need more funds.
boss.explain: 原句：審計員詢問會計部是否已經妥善分配了資金。回應C：「是的，她確認每一分錢都有追蹤紀錄。」最合理。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: If you were the chief financial officer, how would you handle this bankruptcy threat?
options: A. I would have declared bankruptcy earlier.
B. I would restructure our debt immediately to avoid it.
C. I will ask the officer for more financial advice.
D. The bankruptcy has already been filed by the court.
boss.explain: 原句：如果你是財務長，你會如何處理這次破產危機？ (If 2 假設語氣)。回應B：「我會立即重組我們的債務以避免破產。」最符合條件句的語境與時態。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: Had the broker warned us about the market volatility, we wouldn't have lost so much capital.
options: A. 即使經紀人警告過市場波動，我們依然會損失資金。
B. 如果我們損失了更多資金，經紀人就會警告市場波動。
C. 經紀人警告過我們市場的波動，所以我們避開了損失。
D. 如果經紀人曾警告過市場波動，我們就不會損失這麼多資金。
boss.explain: Had the broker warned us... 等同於 If the broker had warned us...（與過去事實相反的假設）。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: If you experienced unexpected side effects from the pills, would you stop taking them immediately?
options: A. Definitely. I would consult my doctor before taking another dose.
B. I had already stopped taking the pills yesterday.
C. Yes, the side effects were completely unexpected.
D. If I were you, I will buy those pills from the pharmacy.
boss.explain: 原句：如果你吃了藥後出現意想不到的副作用，你會立刻停藥嗎？ (If 2 假設語氣)。回應A：「絕對會。在吃下一劑之前我會先諮詢醫生。」最符合。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: Had the laboratory analyzed the blood sample earlier, they would have detected the virus.
options: A. 即使實驗室提早化驗，也很難偵測到這種病毒。
B. 實驗室提早化驗了血液樣本，因此成功攔截了病毒。
C. 如果實驗室提早化驗血液樣本，他們就會發現病毒。
D. 因為實驗室尚未化驗樣本，所以還無法確定是否感染病毒。
boss.explain: Had the laboratory analyzed... 等同於 If the laboratory had analyzed...（與過去事實相反的假設）。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: If the academic journal required a shorter abstract, how would you summarize your findings?
options: A. I would focus only on the core methodology and the final conclusion.
B. I would have shortened the abstract last week.
C. The journal requires a much longer abstract for this submission.
D. If I were the editor, I will reject the paper.
boss.explain: 原句：如果學術期刊要求更短的摘要，你會如何總結你的發現？ (If 2 假設語氣)。回應A：「我會只專注於核心方法論和最終結論。」最合理。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: Had the university granted the ethical approval, we would have proceeded with the human trials.
options: A. 大學已經批准了倫理審查，所以我們正在進行人體試驗。
B. 如果大學批准了倫理審查，我們就會繼續進行人體試驗。
C. 即使大學批准了倫理審查，我們也不會進行人體試驗。
D. 如果我們進行人體試驗，大學就會批准倫理審查。
boss.explain: Had the university granted... 等同於 If the university had granted...（如果當時大學批准了，我們當時就會繼續進行）。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: If the historical heritage site were located in the renewed zone, would they tear it down?
options: A. They have already torn down the commercial buildings.
B. I would have demolished the site if I had the authority.
C. Yes, the heritage site was built more than a century ago.
D. No, the preservation laws would strictly forbid them from destroying it.
boss.explain: 原句：如果這座歷史遺址位在都更區，他們會把它拆除嗎？ (If 2 假設語氣)。回應D：「不會，保存法規會嚴格禁止他們破壞它。」最合理。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: Had the engineers discovered the structural flaw earlier, the skyscraper would not have collapsed.
options: A. 工程師早就發現了結構缺陷，因此避免了摩天大樓倒塌。
B. 就算工程師早點發現結構缺陷，摩天大樓還是會倒塌。
C. 因為摩天大樓倒塌了，工程師才開始尋找結構缺陷。
D. 如果工程師早點發現結構缺陷，這棟摩天大樓就不會倒塌。
boss.explain: Had the engineers discovered... 等同於 If the engineers had discovered...（與過去事實相反：如果當時早點發現，就不會倒塌）。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: If you managed a grassroots charity, how would you recruit more dedicated volunteers?
options: A. I would leverage social media to share our inspiring stories.
B. I would have recruited them during the summer break.
C. The charity has enough volunteers for the upcoming event.
D. I will ask the manager to fire the lazy volunteers.
boss.explain: 原句：如果你管理一個草根慈善機構，你會如何招募更多有奉獻精神的志工？ (If 2 假設語氣)。回應A：「我會利用社群媒體來分享我們激勵人心的故事。」最合理。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: Had the international humanitarian aid arrived sooner, the epidemic would not have spread so widely.
options: A. 國際人道救援提早抵達了，所以疫情沒有蔓延得很廣。
B. 如果國際人道救援早點抵達，疫情就不會蔓延得這麼廣。
C. 即使國際人道救援早點抵達，疫情還是會廣泛蔓延。
D. 因為疫情廣泛蔓延，國際人道救援才決定提早抵達。
boss.explain: Had the international humanitarian aid arrived... 等同於 If the international humanitarian aid had arrived...（與過去事實相反）。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: They mentioned that the philanthropy foundation had decided to withdraw its financial support.
options: A. Yes, the foundation has always been very supportive of our work.
B. The financial support was approved by the board of directors.
C. That's devastating. Did they say what had prompted this sudden decision?
D. No, they didn't want to provide any financial support in the first place.
boss.explain: 原句：他們提到這個慈善基金會已經決定撤回資金支持。回應C：「這太令人震驚了。他們有說是什麼促成了這個突然的決定嗎？」最合理。

boss.desc: 【間接引語】The PR spokesperson assured the angry public that the offensive online advertisements ___ removed the day before.
options: A. are
B. have been
C. had been
D. will be
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：間接引語中，時間副詞 yesterday 變為 the day before，而原本的過去式動詞需退一步變為過去完成式 had been。

boss.desc: 【短文】Media Watchdog: Some influencers have been accused of misleading their audience. In a recent interview, an industry expert claimed that if content creators were legally required to disclose sponsored posts clearly, consumers would not be easily manipulated by disguised advertising. Q: What does the expert believe would prevent consumer manipulation?
options: A. Banning all forms of advertising
B. Clear legal disclosure of sponsorships
C. Increasing the number of influencers
D. Lowering the price of products
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：專家主張如果創作者在法律上被要求清楚揭露贊助貼文，消費者就不會被輕易操縱。

boss.desc: 【間接引語】The software developer explained to the committee that the massive new patch ___ several critical bugs in the system.
options: A. would fix
B. fixes
C. is fixing
D. will fix
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：主要動詞 explained 為過去式，故名詞子句中的 will fix 須配合時態退化為 would fix。

boss.desc: 【間接引語】The principal formally announced that the school ___ a cutting-edge virtual reality program the previous semester.
options: A. was testing
B. tests
C. had tested
D. has tested
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：由 the previous semester 可知原本是過去式，在間接引語中退化為過去完成式。

boss.desc: 【短文】EdTech Review: Gamification in learning is highly debated. While some teachers argue it makes learning fun, a senior educator warned that if schools relied solely on games, students would lose the ability to focus on deep, unentertaining academic texts. Q: What is the senior educator's concern?
options: A. Games are too expensive to buy
B. Students might struggle with serious reading
C. Teachers do not know how to play games
D. Gamification makes classrooms too loud
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：資深教育者警告若過度依賴遊戲，學生將失去專注於枯燥且具深度的學術文本的能力。

boss.desc: 【間接引語】The tour guide mentioned that the ancient marble temple ___ completely destroyed by a massive earthquake centuries ago.
options: A. had been
B. has been
C. is
D. will be
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：導遊「過去」提及一件「更早之前」發生的歷史事件，子句需用過去完成式。

boss.desc: 【間接引語】The archaeology professor confidently claimed that his research team ___ a hidden pharaoh's tomb the week before.
options: A. discover
B. will discover
C. are discovering
D. had discovered
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：the week before 代表原本句中的時間為 last week（過去式），因此引述時須改為過去完成式。

boss.desc: 【短文】History Monthly: The fall of the Roman Empire remains a complex topic. While barbarian invasions are often blamed, a prominent historian noted that internal political corruption had weakened the state's foundation long before the final external attacks occurred. Q: What weakened the state according to the historian?
options: A. A lack of barbarian invasions
B. Internal political corruption
C. The discovery of a hidden tomb
D. An unexpected earthquake
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：歷史學家指出，內部的政治腐敗在外部攻擊發生前就已經削弱了國家的根基。

boss.desc: 【間接引語】The automobile manufacturer publicly stated that their latest self-driving model ___ a perfect five-star safety rating.
options: A. had achieved
B. has achieved
C. is achieving
D. achieves
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：stated 為過去式，說明過去已經達成的成就，子句中時態須退化為過去完成式。

boss.desc: 【間接引語】The cybersecurity official urgently warned the committee that the autonomous vehicle's software ___ highly vulnerable to remote hacking.
options: A. might be
B. may be
C. is
D. will be
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：主要子句動詞 warned 為過去式，附屬子句的助動詞 may 須改為過去式 might。

boss.desc: 【間接引語】The environmental activist passionately argued that modern consumers ___ far too much food every single holiday season.
options: A. wasted
B. waste
C. are wasting
D. have wasted
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：在間接引述過去的言論時，若不視為不變的真理，原句的現在簡單式 waste 需退化為過去式 wasted。

boss.desc: 【間接引語】The head chef firmly promised the manager that his kitchen ___ a strict zero-waste policy by the following year.
options: A. will adopt
B. would adopt
C. adopts
D. has adopted
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：承諾未來的動作，原本的 will adopt 配合 promised 轉為過去未來式 would adopt。

boss.desc: 【短文】Supply Chain Report: Supermarkets often reject perfectly good produce based on strict cosmetic standards. An analyst reported that if these retailers lowered their aesthetic expectations, the volume of agricultural waste would plummet instantly, benefiting both farmers and the environment. Q: Why is perfectly good produce rejected?
options: A. It tastes awful
B. It fails to meet aesthetic standards
C. It is too expensive to transport
D. It is severely contaminated
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：文中提及超市常因為嚴格的外觀（化妝/美學）標準而拒絕原本完好的農產品。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: The insurance adjuster asked if the roof had been leaking before the storm.
options: A. The storm is coming soon.
B. Yes, the roof is painted blue.
C. He adjusted the volume.
D. No, it was completely fine before.
boss.explain: 英文原句：The insurance adjuster asked if the roof had been leaking before the storm.（保險理賠員詢問在暴風雨來臨前，屋頂是否就已經在漏水了。）選項 D「沒有，之前完全沒問題」回答了理賠員的詢問。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The representative noted that the contract had explicitly excluded flood damage.
options: A. 代表指出合約包含了所有的天災損害。
B. 代表指出合約已經明確排除了洪水損害。
C. 代表提到合約因為洪水而被迫終止。
D. 代表說合約的細節被洪水弄模糊了。
boss.explain: 英文原句：The representative noted that the contract had explicitly excluded flood damage.（代表指出合約已經明確排除了洪水損害。）explicitly 意為明確地。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: If the startup had been more profitable, the buyout would have cost millions more.
options: A. 如果這家新創更賺錢，他們就不會被收購。
B. 如果這家新創虧損，收購價就會少幾百萬。
C. 如果這家新創規模更大，買家就會放棄。
D. 如果這家新創更有利潤，收購價就會多出數百萬。
boss.explain: 英文原句：If the startup had been more profitable, the buyout would have cost millions more.（如果這家新創更有利潤，收購價就會多出數百萬。）buyout 意為收購。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The consultant argued that if they had focused on synergy, the integration would have been smoother.
options: A. 顧問認為如果他們不關注綜效，整合就會失敗。
B. 顧問認為他們已經達成綜效，所以整合很順利。
C. 顧問認為如果他們當時注重綜效，整合過程就會更順利。
D. 顧問認為整合過程太快，導致綜效無法發揮。
boss.explain: 英文原句：The consultant argued that if they had focused on synergy, the integration would have been smoother.（顧問認為如果他們當時注重綜效，整合過程就會更順利。）synergy 為協同作用/綜效。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: Critics warned that the merger had established complete market dominance.
options: A. 評論家警告合併案將會導致市場崩盤。
B. 評論家警告合併案已經徹底失敗。
C. 評論家警告市場正在拒絕這場合併。
D. 評論家警告這場合併已經確立了完全的市場主導地位。
boss.explain: 英文原句：Critics warned that the merger had established complete market dominance.（評論家警告這場合併已經確立了完全的市場主導地位。）dominance 意為主導地位。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The tourist noted that the construction noise next door had been completely unbearable.
options: A. 遊客指出隔壁的施工噪音已經完全令人無法忍受。
B. 遊客指出隔壁的建築物看起來非常危險。
C. 遊客表示隔壁的施工人員非常不友善。
D. 遊客表示他沒有聽到隔壁有任何噪音。
boss.explain: 英文原句：The tourist noted that the construction noise next door had been completely unbearable.（遊客指出隔壁的施工噪音已經完全令人無法忍受。）unbearable 意為無法忍受的。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: She told the manager that the poor ventilation had triggered her allergies.
options: A. She runs very fast.
B. I will have the air conditioning checked right away.
C. The manager is out of the office.
D. Yes, she is allergic to peanuts.
boss.explain: 英文原句：She told the manager that the poor ventilation had triggered her allergies.（她告訴經理，不良的通風引發了她的過敏。）選項 B「我馬上派人檢查空調」為合適的處理方式。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: She realized that her corporate job had never been truly fulfilling.
options: A. 她意識到她的企業工作非常有成就感。
B. 她發現她的企業工作薪水很高。
C. 她意識到她的企業工作從來沒有真正讓她感到滿足。
D. 她意識到她永遠無法勝任這份企業工作。
boss.explain: 英文原句：She realized that her corporate job had never been truly fulfilling.（她意識到她的企業工作從來沒有真正讓她感到滿足。）fulfilling 意為令人滿足的、有成就感的。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: He confessed that ignoring his intuition had been his biggest mistake.
options: A. The mistake was fixed quickly.
B. He doesn't know how to cook.
C. My tuition fee is due tomorrow.
D. Indeed, trusting your gut feeling is crucial.
boss.explain: 英文原句：He confessed that ignoring his intuition had been his biggest mistake.（他坦承忽略自己的直覺是他最大的錯誤。）選項 D「確實，相信直覺很關鍵」是正確的同理回應。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: If the striker were less aggressive, he wouldn't receive so many penalty cards.
options: A. 如果前鋒不那麼積極，他就無法進球。
B. 如果前鋒更有攻擊性，他就會收到更多罰單。
C. 如果前鋒速度變慢，他就不會被罰出場。
D. 如果這位前鋒不要那麼有攻擊性，他就不會收到這麼多罰牌。
boss.explain: 英文原句：If the striker were less aggressive, he wouldn't receive so many penalty cards.（如果這位前鋒不要那麼有攻擊性，他就不會收到這麼多罰牌。）aggressive 意為具攻擊性的。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: He observed that the unexpected injury had completely ruined their momentum.
options: A. 他觀察到這場意外的受傷徹底破壞了他們的氣勢。
B. 他觀察到受傷的球員已經恢復了體力。
C. 他觀察到這場比賽因為天氣而被迫取消。
D. 他觀察到球隊在受傷後反而變得更團結。
boss.explain: 英文原句：He observed that the unexpected injury had completely ruined their momentum.（他觀察到這場意外的受傷徹底破壞了他們的氣勢。）momentum 意為氣勢、動力。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: The panel argued that the final decision had been highly controversial.
options: A. The panel is painted green.
B. Many fans are still protesting that referee's call online.
C. They easily agreed on everything.
D. The decision was very quick and boring.
boss.explain: 英文原句：The panel argued that the final decision had been highly controversial.（專家小組認為最後的裁決極具爭議。）選項 B「許多球迷仍在網路上抗議裁判的那個判決」符合爭議性的語境。

boss.desc: 【時態】The pharmaceutical company ___ billions in the neural implant project before they finally realized the technology was essentially flawed.
options: A. invests
B. has invested
C. was investing
D. had invested
boss.explain: 正確答案是 D。句意：製藥公司在最終意識到這項技術存在根本缺陷之前，已經在神經植入項目上投資了數十億美元。在過去動作 realized 之前發生的行為，必須使用過去完成式 had invested。

boss.desc: 【假設語氣】But for the financial support from UNESCO, the ancient city walls ___ completely into ruin during the devastating earthquake last decade.
options: A. would have collapsed
B. will collapse
C. had collapsed
D. would collapse
boss.explain: 正確答案是 A。But for 意為「要不是有...」，可引導假設語氣。因為事情發生在「上個十年 (last decade)」，這是對過去事實的假設（第三類條件句），主要子句應使用 would have + p.p.。若無資助，城牆早就會坍塌了。

boss.desc: 【間接引語】During the press conference, the CEO firmly denied that the management ___ intentionally over the gender pay gap report earlier that year.
options: A. glosses
B. had glossed
C. is glossing
D. will gloss
boss.explain: 正確答案是 B。CEO 否認（denied，過去式）了一件發生在那年更早（earlier that year）的事情。轉述比過去更早發生的事情，子句須使用過去完成式 had glossed (掩飾)。

boss.desc: 【短文-字彙】Climate Report: The continuous desertification of arable land forces rural communities to flee. Without immediate agricultural interventions, the region will face a massive humanitarian crisis as millions of people become ___ dependent on international food aid. Q: Which word best fills in the blank?
options: A. smoothly
B. visually
C. HEAVILY
D. narrowly
boss.explain: 正確答案是 C (嚴重地 / 高度地)。句意：...數百萬人將「嚴重依賴」國際糧食援助。become heavily dependent on 為常見搭配詞，表示依賴程度極高。A (平滑地)、B (視覺上) 不符文意。

boss.desc: 【短文-主旨】Entertainment Weekly: The digital era has drastically shifted how musicians earn money. Since algorithms largely determine what listeners hear, artists are now writing shorter songs with catchy hooks within the first ten seconds. This ensures the track is not skipped, thus securing a streaming payout. Q: What is the primary focus of the text?
options: A. How to buy cheap concert tickets online.
B. How streaming algorithms affect songwriting.
C. Why vinyl records are becoming popular again.
D. Why musicians should avoid digital platforms.
boss.explain: 正確答案是 B。短文描述因為演算法決定了聽眾聽什麼，音樂人現在將歌曲寫得更短並在開頭放入洗腦旋律以確保能獲得分潤。這討論了串流演算法如何影響詞曲創作。

boss.desc: 【短文-推論】Health Tech Today: Remote patient monitoring systems have saved countless lives. A rural doctor reported that if he hadn't received real-time data from a patient's smart watch, he wouldn't have dispatched the ambulance in time to prevent a fatal heart attack. He added that the system had already proven its worth twice that month. Q: What can be inferred about the rural doctor's opinion on smart watches?
options: A. They are too complicated for elderly patients to use.
B. They often provide inaccurate health data.
C. They should be banned in rural hospitals.
D. They are essential tools for emergency medical response.
boss.explain: 正確答案是 D。醫生表示如果沒有智慧手錶的數據，他就無法及時派出救護車預防心臟病發，並補充該系統已證明了它的價值。這推論出他認為智慧手錶是緊急醫療應變的重要工具。

boss.desc: 【對話-時態】A: "Was the local community consulted about the new resort construction?" B: "No, the developers ___ the land clearance before the villagers even knew about the project."
options: A. had begun
B. begin
C. began
D. have begun
boss.explain: 正確答案是 A。句意：開發商在村民甚至還不知道該專案（過去式 knew）之前，就已經開始了土地清理作業。表示過去時間點之前已經發生的動作，需使用過去完成式 had begun。

boss.desc: 【字彙】Creating a truly inclusive environment requires actively dismantling the ___ that often exist unconsciously in people's minds regarding gender and race.
options: A. cables
B. vitamins
C. BIASES
D. lyrics
boss.explain: 正確答案是 C (偏見)。句意：創造一個真正包容的環境需要積極消除人們心中潛意識裡常存在的關於性別與種族的「偏見」。dismantle biases 是指消除偏見。

boss.desc: 【短文-語法】Environmental Digest: The ice caps are melting at an unprecedented rate. A leading climatologist warned that if global leaders ___ stricter carbon emission laws a decade ago, we would not be facing such extreme coastal erosion today. Q: Which phrase best fills in the blank?
options: A. enforce
B. had enforced
C. will enforce
D. are enforcing
boss.explain: 正確答案是 B。這是一個混合條件句。If 子句描述與「十年前（過去）」事實相反的假設，需用過去完成式 had enforced；而主要子句 (would not be facing) 描述對「今日（現在）」造成的影響。

boss.desc: 【間接引語】The copyright lawyer explained to the jury that the defendant ___ the melody from an obscure 1980s pop song without permission.
options: A. samples
B. is sampling
C. will sample
D. had sampled
boss.explain: 正確答案是 D。律師向陪審團解釋（過去式 explained）的事情，發生在解釋之前（被告非法取樣旋律）。在間接引語中，過去發生的事退一步變為過去完成式 had sampled。

boss.desc: 【短文-字彙】Ethics Journal: Using artificial intelligence to predict patient life expectancy raises serious moral questions. If an algorithm determines a patient has a low chance of survival, insurance companies might unfairly ___ their medical coverage to save costs. Q: Which word best fills in the blank?
options: A. WITHDRAW
B. celebrate
C. swallow
D. translate
boss.explain: 正確答案是 A (撤回 / 取消)。句意：保險公司可能會不公平地取消他們的醫療保險以節省成本。withdraw coverage 意思是取消或撤回保障。B (慶祝)、C (吞嚥) 完全不合邏輯。

boss.desc: 【短文-細節】Diversity Bulletin: Accommodating neurodiverse employees is essential for innovation. The memo stated that the company had redesigned its open-plan office because the loud, chaotic environment had severely negatively affected the concentration of staff members on the autism spectrum. Q: Why did the company redesign its open-plan office?
options: A. To fit more desks into a smaller space.
B. To create a space for daily music performances.
C. To reduce the noise that distracted certain employees.
D. To save money on electricity and heating.
boss.explain: 正確答案是 C。短文提到重新設計辦公室的原因是「吵雜、混亂的環境嚴重負面影響了自閉症譜系員工的專注力」。因此目的在於減少使特定員工分心的噪音。
